aama le pani pugdo ra poshilo khana khanu parchha: dal, saag, dudh, anda, masu ki gedagudi, ra phal. din bhari pani ra jhol piunus. aaram ra nidra pani jaruri chha, ghar ka aru sadasya le sahayog garnus. kunai aushadhi khanu parda doctor lai dudh khuwaune kura bhannus.
weight ghataune chakki khanu thik ho?

doctor ko salah bina weight ghataune chakki nakhanus, kehi ma mutu ra pet lai hani garne kura hunasakchha. "1 mahina ma 10 kg" bhanne vigyapan ma bharosa nagarnus. khana ko matra, chini ra tel ghataune ani niyamit hidne nai surakshit bato ho. dherai taul bhaye doctor ki dietitian sanga yojana banaunus.
cholesterol badhi aayo report ma

doctor le diyeko salah ra aushadhi niyamit palnus. tareko khana, ghiu, chillo masu ra packet ko khaja kam garnus. tarkari, phal, gedagudi ra jaun jasta resha bhayeko khana badhaunus. din ma 30 minet hidnus ra churot chhodnus. kehi mahina pachhi pheri jaanch garaunus.
khutta ko aunla ma achanak sujan ra dukhai, uric acid re

doctor le jaanch garera bhaneko bhaye unko aushadhi ra salah palnus. pani dherai piunus ra raksi, dherai masu ra bhutan jasta kura kam garnus. dukheko jodi lai aaram ra chiso sek dinus. afai dukhai ko aushadhi lamo samaya nakhanus, doctor sanga sodhnus.
ragat kam chha re, k khane?

ragat ko kami (anemia) bhaye doctor le karan herera aushadhi dinchhan, pahila tyo palnus. hariyo saag, gedagudi, masu, anda ra kalo chana jasta aayron bhayeko khana khanus. kagati, amala jasta vitamin C le aayron sosna madat garchha. khana sangai chiya nakhanus, kehi samaya pachhi khanus.
swimming pachhi kaan dukhchha

swimming pachhi taauko dhalayera kaan bata pani nikalnus ra sukha kapada le bahira matra puchhnus. kaan bhitra cotton bud naghusarnus. aagadi swimming garda ear plug lagauna sakinchha. dukhai badhyo, pip aayo ki sunna kam bhayo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
khutta bata gandha aauchha

har din sabun le khutta ra aunla ko bich dhunus ra ramrari sukaunus. kapas ko moja lagaunus ra din din fernus. jutta lai ghaam ma sukaunus ra 2 jodi palo palo lagaunus. aunla ko bich chilaune ki chhala uthne bhaye fungus hunasakchha, pharmacist ki doctor sanga sodhnus.
khutta sunniyo, kina hola?

dherai bera ubhida ki basda halka sunnine kahile kahi hunchha, khutta mathi rakhera aaram garda ghatchha. tara dubai khutta lagatar sunnine, saas phulne ki ek khutta matra sunnine, rato ra dukhne bhaye doctor dekhaunus. mutu, mirgaula jasta karan pani hunasakchha, jaanch jaruri hunchha.
ghar ma kasai le churot khanchha, bachcha lai asar?

arko ko churot ko dhuwa le pani bachcha ko phokso ra kaan ma hani garchha. ghar bhitra ra gadi ma churot nakhane niyam banaunus. churot khane le bahira khanus ra pachhi haat dhunus. chhodna sahayog magnu bhaye swasthya sanstha ma sodhna sakinchha.
man ko rog ko upachar garda manchhe le pagal bhanchhan bhanne dar

man ko swasthya pani sharir ko swasthya jastai ho, upachar khojnu himmat ko kaam ho. doctor ra counsellor ko kura gopya rahanchha. bharosa ko ek jana manchhe lai matra bhanera suru garna sakinchha. samaj ko dar le upachar nachhodnus, tapai ko jiwan mahatwapurna chha.
bihana khali pet hidnu ramro ki khaja khayera?

dherai jaso swastha manchhe lai bihana halka hidaai khali pet pani thik hunchha. tara chakkar lagne, sugar ko rog bhayeko ki lamo samaya hidne bhaye halka kehi khayera hidnus, jastai kera. pani piera nikalnus. afno sharir ko sanket sunnus.
dori naachne (skipping) exercise ramro ho?

skipping le mutu ra khutta ko lagi ramro exercise hunchha, thorai samaya ma. suru ma 1 minet skip ra 1 minet aaram, 5-10 palta garnus. naram jutta lagayera samtal thau ma garnus. ghuda ra kurkucha ma dukhai bhaye ghataunus ra doctor sanga sodhnus.
khana pachhi hidnu ramro?

khana pachhi 10-15 minet bistarai hidnu pachnu ra sugar santulit garna ramro maninchha. dherai chhito ki daudne kaam bhari khana pachhi nagarnus. raati ko khana pachhi halka hidaai le nidra pani ramro hunasakchha.
dal bhat kati khane, mota hunchha bhanne dar

dal bhat aafai naramro haina, matra mukhya ho. thal ma bhat chautho bhag, dal ra tarkari aadha, ra salad rakhnus. bhat ko dohoro nalinu ra tarkari badhaunu sajilo upaya ho. ani din ma kehi samaya hidnu pani nabirsanus.
sugar ko rog chha, phal khana milchha?

dherai jaso sugar ko rogi le pani ek palta ma sano matra phal khana sakchhan, juice bhanda pura phal ramro. mitho ra dherai pakeko phal ek palta ma dherai nakhanus. tara afno sugar ko awastha anusar doctor ki dietitian sanga matra ra kisim pakka garnus.
bachcha bihana khaja nakhai school jaanchha

raati nai khaja ko tayari garnus, jastai umaleko anda, roti ra tarkari. bachcha lai chhaneko 2-3 sajilo bikalpa dinus, afai chhanda khana man garchha. 15 minet agadi uthaunus, hatar ma bhok lagdaina. kehi nakhaye halka dudh ra kera matra bhaye pani dinus.
chhito chhito khana khane baani chha

sano gaas linus ra har gaas ramrari chapaunus. khana khanda phone ra TV banda garnus. bich bich ma chamcha thal ma rakhnus. 15-20 minet lagayera khanda pet bharieko thaha hunchha ra badhi khana pardaina.
pahilo palta bank khata kholne, k chahinchha?

dherai jaso nagarikta ko praman patra (ki aru parichaya patra), photo ra thegana ko jankari chahinchha, bank anusar alikati farak hunchha. pahila bank ma phone ki website bata kagaj ko list bujhnus. khata kholepachhi mobile banking ra ATM ko PIN gopya rakhnus.
ATM ko PIN birsiye

afno bank ko shakha ma parichaya patra lagera jaanus ki bank ko helpline ma sampark garnus, naya PIN banauna milchha. kehi bank ma app bata pani milchha. naya PIN janmamiti jasto sajilo narakhnus ra kahi lekhera card sangai narakhnus.
talab ko 50/30/20 bhaneko k ho?

talab ko 50% jaruri kharcha (bhada, khana, bill), 30% man pareko kharcha (ghumne, kinmel) ra 20% bachat ma chhuttyaune tarika ho. yo pakka niyam haina, tapai ko awastha anusar milauna sakinchha. sabai bhanda mahatwapurna kura, bachat ko bhag talab aaune bittikai chhuttyaunu ho.
EMI ma saman kinda k dhyan dine?

EMI ko jamma rakam ra nagad mol tulana garnus, byaj kati thapinchha thaha hunchha. mahina ko sabai EMI talab ko thulo bhag na hos, 20-30% bhitra rakhnus. kista chhutyo bhane jarimana ra credit kharab hunchha. jaruri saman ko lagi matra EMI linus.
ghar bhada ma basne ki loan liyera kinne?

dubai ko faida chha. kinda ghar afno hunchha tara loan ko kista lamo samaya tirnu parchha. kinnu agadi kamti 20-30% rakam afno haat ma, ra kista talab ko 30-40% bhanda badhi nahune hernus. jagir ra basai ko thau pakka nabhaye bhada ma basnu nai sajilo hunasakchha.
budhyauli ko lagi bachat kahile bata suru garne?

jati chhito suru garyo, utti sano rakam le pani thulo kosh banchha. jagir suru bhaye dekhi nai mahina ko sano rakam chhuttai rakhnus. sanchaya kosh ra nagarik lagani jasta yojana bujhnus. jankaar sanga salah lidai lamo samaya ko lagani ko bato chhannus.
buwa aama ko swasthya bima garnu parchha?

budhyauli ma upachar ko kharcha badhchha, tyasaile swasthya bima le thulo sahara dinchha. sarkari swasthya bima karyakram ra niji bima dubai ko barema bujhnus. k k samettinchha, kati premium ra purano rog samettinchha ki bhanne padhnus. dherai company tulana garera matra chhannus.
chiya ra khaja ma dherai paisa janchha

ek hapta samma sano kharcha pani lekhnus, jamma dekhda chhakka parinchha. ghar bata chiya ra khaja bokne garnus. hapta ma 1-2 din matra bahira khane niyam rakhnus. bachayeko paisa euta khutruke ma halnus, mahina ko ant ma gannus.
bazaar ma mol molai kasari garne?

pahila 2-3 pasal ma mol sodhnus, uchit mol thaha hunchha. namra bhayera "ali ghatau na" bhannus, ris garera haina. dherai saman ekai thau bata kinda chhut magna sajilo hunchha. mol nimilye dhanyabad bhanera arko pasal jaanus.
purano furniture kinda k herne?

kath ma kira lageko, dhulo jhareko ki pwal bhayeko chha ki hernus. jod ra khutta hallinchha ki thichera jaanch garnus. sofa ki gaddi ma dhusi ra kira hernus. mol naya ko tulana ma uchit bhaye matra kinnus, ani ghar lyaera ramrari safa garnus.
chiya pasal lai cafe banauna chahanchhu

pahila tapai ko grahak ko maag bujhnus: coffee, khaja ki basne thau? sano sudhar bata suru garnus, jastai sapha basne thau ra 2-3 naya peya. sabai paisa ek palta nahali nafa herdai badhaunus. sarsafai ra ramro byabahar le nai grahak farkanchhan.
online tuition padhaune soch, kasari suru?

tapai ramro bhayeko euta subject ra kaksha chhannus. sathi ra aafantu ko bachcha bata suru garera anubhav ra feedback linus. video call ko app, sapha awaj ra sano whiteboard pugchha. class ko samaya, fee ra niyam spasta lekhnus, ani ramro padhaai le nai naya bidyarthi lyauchha.
photography lai byabasaya banauna sakinchha?

sakinchha, tara pahila ramro portfolio chahinchha: bihe, karyakram ki product ko photo. sathi ra aafantu ko karyakram ma kam mol ma kaam garera anubhav linus. facebook ra instagram ma ramro photo niyamit rakhnus. samaya mai photo dinu ra imandar mol nai grahak badhaune upaya ho.
ghar mai achar banayera bechne

sarsafai sabai bhanda mahatwapurna: sapha haat, sapha bhaado ra sukha thau. achar ko swad ekai rakhnus ra jar ma naam, miti ra samagri lekhnus. pahila chhimeki ra sathi lai bechera feedback linus. thulo matra ma bechna sthaniya palika bata darta ra anumati bujhnus.
kukhura ko dana mahango bhayo, nafa ghatyo

dana khera nalagos bhanera ramro bhaado prayog garnus, dherai dana phalinchha. kukhura ko taul ra dana ko hisab rakhnus. najik ka kisan sanga milera thok ma dana kinda sasto parchha. pashu sewa karyalaya sanga sodhera sthaniya dana milaune tarika pani bujhnus.
grahak lai pheri pheri aauna kasari lagaune?

grahak ko naam samjhanus ra ramro byabahar garnus. gunastar sadhai ekai rakhnus. niyamit grahak lai sano chhut ki "10 palta kine 1 free" jasto card dinus. gunaso aaye chhito sunera samadhan garnus, dherai grahak yahi kura le farkanchhan.
kam paisa ma byabasaya ko prachar kasari garne?

santushta grahak le arko lai bhanne nai sabai bhanda sasto prachar ho. facebook page ra tiktok ma ramro photo ra chhoto video rakhnus. sthaniya samuha ma sanket dinus. pasal ko board ra sapha dekhine ghar le pani manchhe tanchha.
pahilo palta karmachari rakhdai chhu

kaam ko jimmewari, samaya ra talab lekhit ma spasta garnus. pahilo kehi hapta sikaune samaya dinus. talab samaya mai dinus, yasle bharosa banauchha. niyam ra kanun bare, jastai bida ra suvidha, jankaar ki sambandhit karyalaya ma bujhnus.
mero pasal najik arko tyastai pasal khulyo

aatinus, pratispardha le pani sudhar garna sikauchha. tapai ko bisheshata k ho sochnus: ramro byabahar, ramro saman ki sasto mol. purana grahak sanga sambandha baliyo banaunus. mol ghataera noksan garnu bhanda sewa ra gunastar ma dhyan dinus.
saman dine supplier sadhai dhilo garchha

supplier sanga spasta kura garnus: kahile samma pugne pakka ho. 1-2 jana arko supplier pani khojera rakhnus. jaruri saman ko alikati stock pahila nai rakhnus. lekhit order ra miti rakhda pachhi samasya kam hunchha.
phone ghari ghari hang hunchha

phone restart garnus ra storage kamti 15-20% khali rakhnus. dherai app ek palta nakholnus ra purano app hataunus. software ra app update garnus. tyo pani nabhaye mahatwapurna data backup garera factory reset ko barema sochna sakinchha.
app update garnu jaruri chha?

ho, update ma suraksha ko kamjori sudharieko hunchha. update le naya suvidha ra galti ko sudhar pani lyauchha. data bachauna update wifi ma matra garne setting rakhnus. tara update official store bata matra garnus, link bata haina.
sim card haraayo

turuntai sim company ko helpline ma phone garera sim block garaunus. bank ra wallet ko OTP yahi number ma aaune bhayekale bank lai pani bataunus. company ko office ma parichaya patra lagera ekai number ko naya sim lina milchha. tyo number sanga jodiyeka account ko password badalnus.
mero email ko password kasai le badalyo

email ko "account recovery" ma gayera recovery phone ki email bata account farkaunus. farkiye pachhi turuntai naya baliyo password rakhnus ra 2-step verification on garnus. account ma recovery jankari ra connected app jaanch garnus. tyahi password aru account ma pani chha bhane sabai badalnus.
wifi ko password kasto rakhne?

kamti 12 akshar ko, sano thulo akshar, ank ra chinha milayera rakhnus. ghar ko naam, phone number ki 12345678 jasto sajilo password narakhnus. router ko admin password pani badalnus. kahile kahi kasle kasle jodeko chha router ma hernus.
bachcha le phone ma naramro video dekhla bhanne dar

phone ra youtube ma parental control ra restricted mode on garnus. bachcha ko lagi chhuttai account banaunus. phone chalaune samaya ra thau tokdinus, jastai baithak ma matra. naramro kura dekhe dar nagari tapai lai bhanna sikaunus, gali garne haina, bujhaune.
online exam dina k tayari garne?

exam agadi nai internet, camera, mic ra login jaanch garnus. charger jodera ra phone ko notification banda garera basnus. shanta thau ra ujyalo chhannus. internet gayo bhane k garne bhanne niyam pahila nai sodhera rakhnus.
laptop ma chiya poklyo

turuntai laptop banda garnus ra charger nikalnus. laptop lai ulto (V akar ma) rakhera pani bahira bagna dinus, sukha kapada le bahira puchhnus. kamti 24-48 ghanta on nagarnus ra hair dryer ko taato hawa nalagaunus. chiya ma chini hunchha, sakesamma chhito service centre lagnus.
phone ma screenshot kasari linchhan?

dherai jaso phone ma power button ra volume ghataune button sangai thichda screenshot aauchha. kehi phone ma 3 aunla le screen tala tannda pani hunchha. iPhone ma model anusar side button ra volume up sangai thichnus. screenshot photo gallery ma save hunchha.
phone ko battery phulyo jasto, back cover uthyo

phone turuntai prayog garna ra charge garna roknus, phuleko battery le aago lagna sakchha. thichnus nai, phodnu hunna. phone lai sukha ra aago bata tadha thau ma rakhnus. sakesamma chhito service centre ma lagera battery fernus.
sasto charger chalaunda kehi hunchha?

sasto ra naqali charger le battery bigarna, phone taato banauna ra kahile kahi aago lagauna sakchha. phone ko company ko ki bharosa ko brand ko charger prayog garnus. charger ko taar phuteko bhaye nachalaunus. charge garda phone takiya muni narakhnus.
raati bhari phone charge ma rakhda naramro?

aajkal ka phone le pura charge bhayepachhi aafai roknchha, tara taato hune thau ma narakhnus. bistara ma ki takiya muni rakhera charge nagarnus. sakchhu bhane sutne kotha bahira charge garnus, nidra pani ramro hunchha. kehi phone ma battery jogaune charging setting pani hunchha.
nakkali website kasari chinne?

website ko naam ko spelling dhyan le hernus, sano farak pani hunchha. thulo chhut ra "aaja matra" jasto hatar garaune kura ma shanka garnus. bank ki wallet ko login link message bata nakholnus, app ki afai type gareko website bata matra kholnus. shanka lage company ko aadhikarik number ma sodhnus.
QR code le payment garda k dhyan dine?

tirnu agadi app ma aaune naam ra rakam pasal ko naam sanga milchha ki hernus. paisa "paunu" ko lagi QR scan garnu pardaina, yasto bhanne thagi hunasakchha. bhuktani pachhi rasid ki message aayo ki hernus. pasale lai pani screen dekhaunus.
promotion ko lagi kasari bhanne?

pahila afno kaam ko upalabdhi ra liyeko thap jimmewari lekhnus. manager sanga meeting magera "mero career agadi badhauna k chahinchha?" bhanera sodhnus. unle bhaneko kura ko yojana banaunus ra 3-6 mahina pachhi pheri kura garnus. ris ki dhamki bhanda tathya ra dhairya le kaam garchha.
office ma pata pata dhilo pugchhu

bato ma lagne samaya ma 15 minet thapera hisab garnus. raati nai lugaa, jhola ra khaja tayar rakhnus. alarm 15 minet agadi rakhnus ra bihana phone nahernus. dhilo hune awastha aaye agadi nai manager lai khabar garnus.
sahakarmi sanga jhagada bhayo

ris shanta bhayepachhi eklai kura garnus, sabai ko agadi haina. "tapai le galti garnu bhayo" bhanda "tyo kura ma malai asajilo lagyo" bhanne tarika ramro. kaam ko kura ma dhyan dinus, byaktigat kura namilaunus. samadhan nabhaye manager ko madat linus.
bidesh ko kaam ko video interview chha

internet, camera ra awaj pahila nai jaanch garnus. shanta, ujyalo thau ra sadharan pristhabhumi chhannus. camera ma hernus, screen ma haina, ani bistarai spasta bolnus. CV ra kagaj chheu mai rakhnus ra samaya ko farak (time zone) dhyan dinus.
teacher ko job ma demo class dinu chha

15-20 minet ko euta sano bishaya chhannus ra suru, bich ra antya spasta banaunus. bidyarthi lai prashna sodhne ra sahabhagi garaune tarika rakhnus. board ma sapha lekhnus ra samaya ko dhyan dinus. ghar ma sathi lai bidyarthi banayera abhyas garnus.
nurse ko kaam ma raati ko shift le thakaayo

shift pachhi ko nidra lai pura mahatwa dinus, andhyaro ra shanta kotha ma sutnus. shift ma pani ra halka khana bokera janus, mithai ra chiya matra le thakai badhchha. chhutti ko din pani dherai samaya nabadlinus. dherai thakai ra udasi lagatar rahe supervisor ra doctor sanga kura garnus.
driver ko kaam garchhu, lamo yatra ma nidra lagchha

nidra lageko bela gadi chalaunu ekdam khatarnak ho, surakshit thau ma rokera 15-20 minet sutnus. yatra agadi ramro nidra linus ra 2 ghanta ma rokera aaram garnus. bhari khana khanda nidra badhchha, halka khanus. kahile pani nasha garera nachalaunus.
freelancing suru garna chahanchhu

pahila euta sip chhannus: lekhne, design, video edit ki programming. 3-4 wata namuna kaam banayera portfolio banaunus. suru ma sano kaam sasto ma garera review linus. kaam suru garnu agadi paisa magne grahak ra "registration fee" magne platform bata satark rahanus.
boss ko risayeko email aayo, kasari reply garne?

turuntai ris ma reply nalekhnus, 15-30 minet parkhanus. email ma bhaneka kura ko tathya sahit chhoto jawaf lekhnus: k bhayo, aba k gardai hunuhunchha ra kahile samma. maafi magnu parne bhaye sidha magnus. jaruri bhaye phone ki pratyaksha kura garna samaya magnus.
english bolne sathi kaha paaune?

college ki tol ma english sikdai gareka sathi sanga hapta ma 2 palta english matra bolne samaya banaunus. english club ra library ka karyakram ma judnus. online bhasa satne app pani prayog garna sakinchha, tara personal jankari surakshit rakhnus. ghar ma pani bhai bahini sanga khel jastai english bolna sakinchha.
english ma "v" ra "w" ko uchcharan milaudina

"v" bhanda mathi ko daat le tala ko oth halka chhunus ra awaj nikalnus, jastai "very". "w" ma dubai oth golo banaunus, daat le oth nachhoi, jastai "water". "very well", "wet van" jasta jodi 10 palta bistarai bhannus. aina herda farak dekhinchha.
english ma phrasal verb dherai garo

sabai ek palta nasiknus, din ma 2-3 wata matra, udaharan sahit. "get up", "look for", "give up" jasta dherai prayog hune bata suru garnus. afno jiwan sanga jodera vakya banaunus: "I get up at 6." padhda ra herda bhetieka phrasal verb copy ma tipnus.
english ma paragraph lekhna sikaunus
pahilo vakya ma mukhya kura bhannus, jastai "My village is beautiful." tyas pachhi 3-4 vakya ma karan ra udaharan dinus. antim vakya ma kura sameta. lekhepachhi spelling ra full stop jaanch garnus.
english gaana bata english sikna milchha?
milchha, gaana le shabda ra uchcharan sikna ramro madat garchha. bistarai gaine gaana chhannus ra lyrics herdai sunnus. naya shabda tipnus ra arth bujhnus. sangai gaaunda bolne lay pani sudhrinchha.
english ma diary lekhda k lekhne?

din ko 3-5 sajilo kura: k khaye, kaha gaye, k ramro lagyo. "Today I ..." bata suru garnus. galti ko chinta nagari lekhnus, hapta ma ek palta purano diary padhera sudharnus. 1 mahina pachhi farak aafai dekhinchha.
sathi le mero barema jhuto kura phailayo

ris lagnu swabhabik ho, tara ris ma jawaf diye kura jhan phailinchha. shanta bhayera tyo sathi sanga eklai kura garnus ra kina garyo sodhnus. najik ka sathi lai sachcha kura shanta bhayera bhannus. kura gambhir bhaye, jastai school ma, teacher ko madat linus.
euta sathi sanga basda sadhai naramro lagchha, toxic jasto

jasko sangat ma sadhai sano mahsus hunchha, hepai hunchha ki dabab dinchha, tyo sambandha ma sima chahinchha. pahila spasta bhannus k kura man pardaina. sudhar nabhaye bistarai samaya ghataunus. tapai lai ramro mahsus garaune sathi ma samaya badhaunus.
bhai sanga jhagada bhayo, milna man chha

pahila tapai bolnus, sano hune haina. "hijo maile ris garera bhane, sorry" bhannus. uslai man parne kura, jastai sangai khel ki khaja, le bolchal sajilai suru hunchha. jhagada ko kura sanga shanta bela ma matra kura garnus.
buwa le sathi sanga bahira jaana dinu hunna

buwa ko chinta tapai ko suraksha ko lagi ho. kaha, kasko sanga ra kahile samma farkine spasta bhannus ra sathi ko phone number dinus. samaya mai farkera bharosa banaunus. bistarai bharosa badhepachhi swatantrata pani badhchha.
boyfriend le mero phone check garchha, shanka garchha

sambandha ma bharosa ra sammaan dubai chahinchha. shanta bela ma spasta bhannus ki phone check garne ra shanka garne baani le tapai lai asajilo lagchha. shanka ko karan k ho sodhnus ra imandar kura garnus. niyantran, dhamki ki dar lagne byabahar bhaye tyo surakshit sambandha haina, bharosa ko manchhe sanga kura garnus.
bihe ko lagi keti herna jaane, nervous

nervous hunu swabhabik ho, uni pani nervous hunchhan. sapha ra sadharan lugaa lagaunus ra samaya mai pugnus. sodhne prashna sochera jaanus: ruchi, padhai, kaam ra bhawishya ko yojana. sunne ra sammaan garne byabahar nai pahilo bhet ma sabai bhanda ramro chhap ho.
sasura ghar bata pahuna aaudai, tayari kasari?

kotha ra toilet sapha garnus ra pahuna ko lagi bistara tayar rakhnus. unko man parne khana sodhera pakaunus. aaunda swagat garnus ra ghar ka sadasya sanga parichaya garaunus. dherai tension nalinus, maya ra sammaan nai mukhya ho.
shriman le ghar ko kaam ma madat gardainan

shanta bela ma kura garnus: "ghar ko kaam dherai bhayo, malai thakai lagchha, kehi kaam baadau?" kun kaam unle garne spasta tokdinus, jastai bhaada majhne ki bachcha school puryaune. gareko kaam ko kadar garnus, bistarai baani banchha. jhagada ko bela haina, sahayog magne tarika le kura garnus.
shrimati bidesh ma kaam garchhin, bachcha herne ma eklai

eklai bachcha ra ghar sambhalnu thulo kaam ho, tapai ramro gardai hunuhunchha. ek din ko routine banaunus ra bachcha lai umer anusar sano kaam sikaunus. aafantu ki chhimeki bata sahayog magna lajja nagarnus. shrimati sanga niyamit video call garera bachcha ko kura sangai milaunus.
chhori andhyaro dekhi darauchhe

andhyaro ko dar bachcha ma samanya ho, haso nagarnus. kotha ma sano batti (night lamp) rakhnus. sutnu agadi katha ra shanta samaya dinus. "kotha ma kehi chhaina" bhanera bistarai sangai herna sakinchha, ra himmat dekhaye prashamsa garnus.
7 barsha ko chhora le raati ochhyan bhijauchha

yo umer ma kahile kahi hunu samanya ho, gali ra lajja nadinus. sutnu agadi pisab garna lagaunus ra beluka pachhi dherai pani nadinus. sukha raat bhaye prashamsa garnus. bar bar hunchha, achanak suru bhayo ki dukhai ra jworo sanga bhaye bachcha ko doctor dekhaunus.
chhora school jaana mandaina, runchha

pahila karan bujhnus: sathi, teacher, padhai ki kehi dar. teacher sanga kura garnus, school ma k bhairahechha thaha hunchha. bihana ko routine shanta ra samaya mai rakhnus. lamo samaya rahyo ki bachcha dherai dar ra udasi ma chha bhane bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
16 barsha ko chhora bike magchha

kanun anusar license ko umer napugi bike chalaunu galat ra khatarnak dubai ho. kina chahiyo bujhnus ra cycle jasto surakshit bikalpa dinus. license ko umer pugepachhi talim ra helmet sahit matra chalauna dine shart rakhnus. sathi ko dabab ko barema pani kura garnus.
hajurama ko dementia, kasari herchah garne?

dherai dhairya chahinchha, unle bisreko kura ma gali nagarnus. dainik kaam ko sajilo routine ra ghar ma surakshit vatavaran banaunus, jastai chuline saman tadha. unlai chineko gaana, photo ra katha le shanti dinchha. doctor sanga niyamit jaanch ra herchah garne lai pani aaram ko samaya chahinchha.
chhimeki sanga jagga ko sima ko jhagada

ris ma bhanda tathya ma kura garnus: lalpurja, naksa ra kitta number. napi karyalaya bata sima napi garauna sakinchha. samaj ka bharosa ka manchhe ki wada karyalaya ma milapatra ko lagi jaana sakinchha. kanuni kura ma wakil sanga salah linus.
sathi le bank loan ma guarantor (jamani) basna bhanyo

jamani basnu bhaneko sathi le natire tapai le tirnu parne jimmewari ho. sathi ko aamdani ra loan tirne kshamata ramro sanga bujhnus. tapai le tirna sakne rakam bhanda thulo bhaye nabasnus. "nai" bhannu pani mitrata ko apamaan haina.
teacher sanga class ma badtamiji gare, sorry kasari bhanne?

class pachhi teacher lai eklai bhetnus ra sidhai bhannus: "sir/miss, maile tyo din galat byabahar gare, maaf garnus." bahana nathapnus. aagadi ko class ma ramro byabahar le nai tapai ko sorry pakka dekhinchha.
chad ma aafantu le sadhai hepera kura garchhan

chad ko ramailo bigrina nadina shanta rahanus ra chhoto, namra jawaf dinus. tyasta kura ma dherai bahas nagarnus, bishaya badalnus. ramro sambandha bhayeka aafantu sanga samaya badhi bitaunus. dherai bhaye ghar ka thulo manchhe lai bhannus.
school, tuition, khel ra homework, samaya pugdaina

hapta ko taalika banaunus ra har kaam ko samaya tokdinus. tuition ma padheko kura usai din dohoryaunus, pachhi dherai samaya lagdaina. khel nachhodnus, tara exam najik ghataunus. sutne samaya nachhodnus, thakeko dimag le kaam dhilo hunchha.
office ma meeting dherai, kaam garna samaya hudaina

din ko kehi ghanta "meeting nahune samaya" ko rup ma calendar ma block garnus. har meeting ko agenda maganus ra jaruri nabhayeko ma namra bhayera nabasnus. chhoto meeting ko prastav garnus, jastai 30 ko satta 15 minet. meeting ko notes chhito lekhera kaam ma farkinus.
2 wata kaam garchhu, thakai lagyo

dui kaam ko samaya ra yatra spasta taalika banaunus, ra hapta ma kamti 1 din aaram rakhnus. khana ra nidra nachhodnus. dui kaam kina chahiyo, kati samaya samma, bhanne lakshya rakhnus. thakai le swasthya bigrina thalyo bhane ek kaam ghataune ki aamdani ko arko bato sochnus.
bill tirna sadhai birsinchhu

bill tirne miti phone ko calendar ma reminder rakhnus. sakesamma app bata automatic bhuktani ko suvidha linus. mahina ko euta nishchit din sabai bill tirne baani banaunus. tireko rasid ek folder ma rakhnus.
bihe ko tayari 6 mahina chha, kasari plan garne?

pahila jamma budget ra pahuna ko sankhya tay garnus. 4-6 mahina agadi venue ra photographer jasta thau book garnus. 2-3 mahina agadi lugaa ra nimto. antim mahina ma sano kaam ko list ra jimmewari parivar ma baadnus. har hapta progress hernus.
chilli chicken kasari banaune?

chicken lai nun, besar, soy sauce ra alikati corn flour ma 20 minet rakhnus. tel ma chicken rato hunjel bhutera jhiknus. tyahi tel ma lasun, adhuwa, pyaj ra capsicum thulo aago ma 2 minet bhutnus. soy sauce, chilli sauce ra chicken halera chalaunus, mathi hariyo pyaj.
aalu parautha kasari banaune?

aalu umalera pisnus ra nun, khursani, jeera ra hariyo dhaniya milaunus. gahu ko pitho ko naram dalla banayera bich ma aalu ko masala rakhnus ra bandh garnus. bistarai beldai patlo parautha banaunus. tawa ma dubai tira ghiu ki tel lagayera sunaulo hunjel sekna.
jhol momo ko jhol kasari banaune?

golbheda polera ki umalera bhuteko til, lasun, khursani ra alikati timur sanga pisnus. pani ki masu ko jhol halera patlo banaunus ra nun milaunus. mathi tel ma methi ra besar jhaanera halnus. taato momo mathi jhol halera khanus.
sel roti ko pitho kasari tayar garne?

chamal raati bhari bhijayera bihana sukha jasto gari pisnus. tyasma chini, ghiu ra alikati dudh ki pani milayera bakla ghol banaunus. ghol 1-2 ghanta rakhnus. tel ramrari taato bhayepachhi matra golo ghumayera halnus.
yomari kasari banaune?
chamal ko pitho taato pani le naram muchhnus. sano dalla lai haat le khokro, maachha ko akar jasto banaunus. bhitra chaku ra til ko masala bharera mukh band garnus. 15-20 minet baph ma pakaunus.
ghar mai ghiu kasari banaune?

dudh ko malai ki makhan ek bhaado ma jamma garnus. sano aago ma bistarai pakaunus ra bela bela chalaunus. makhan pagliera pahelo ghiu chhuttinchha ra tala khairo kura baschha. ramro basna aaepachhi aago banda garnus ra chiso bhayepachhi chhannus.
machha kasari sapha garne?

chakku ko ulto bhag le puchhar bata taauko tira bokra (scales) ragadera hataunus. pet chirera bhitra ko kura nikalnus ra sapha pani le dhunus. kalejo jasto kalo bhag ramrari hataunus. haat ra bhaado sabun le dhunus, gandha hatna kagati prayog garna sakinchha.
anda kati minet umalne?

pani umlepachhi anda halnus. naram pahelo bhag chahiye 6-7 minet, pura kada chahiye 10-12 minet. pakepachhi chiso pani ma rakhnus, bokra sajilai chhutchha. dherai bera umalda pahelo bhag ko warpar hariyo rang aauchha.
bachcha ko tiffin ma k dine?

roti ra tarkari, chiura ra aalu, umaleko anda, sandwich ki phal ramro bikalpa hun. bachcha lai man parne 2-3 kura palo palo dinus. packet ko chauchau ra chips har din nadinus. tiffin box sapha ra pani ko bottle sangai dinus.
pokhara bata jomsom jeep ma jaane, k dhyan dine?

bato lamo ra kachchi chha, bihana chhito chhutne jeep chhannus. bomit hune bhaye aushadhi ra halka khaja boknus. barsha ma pahiro ko khabar bujhnus. mathi chiso ra hawa hunchha, nyano lugaa ra chashma haat ko jhola mai rakhnus.
bardiya safari jaane, k jankari chahinchha?

darta bhayeko guide sanga matra jungle bhitra jaanus ra unko nirdeshan palnus. halka rang ko lugaa lagaunus ra shanta rahanus, janawar halla le bhagchhan. lamkhutte bhagaune cream ra pani boknus. janawar ko najik jaana ki khana dina kahile pani nakhojnus.
janakpur jaane train ma jaana milchha?

janakpur ra jaynagar bich rail sewa chalchha bhanne jankari chha, tara samaya ra ticket ko niyam badalina sakchha. jaanu agadi station ki samachar bata samaya taalika bujhnus. bheed hune bhayekale chhito pugnus ra saman ko dhyan dinus.
banda (strike) ko bela yatra garnu parne bhayo

sakesamma yatra sarnus, banda ko bela sadak ma khatara hunasakchha. jaanai parne bhaye samachar ra sthaniya manchhe bata awastha bujhnus. pani, khaja ra phone charge sangai rakhnus. bheed ra jhadap bhayeko thau bata tadha rahanus.
trek ma k k aushadhi boknu?

afno niyamit aushadhi pura yatra bhanda badhi din ko boknus. sano first aid: patti, antiseptic, jeevan jal, ra doctor le salah diyeka sadharan aushadhi. lekh ko aushadhi linu agadi doctor sanga salah linus. aushadhi pani nachhirne bag ma rakhnus.
pahilo palta jahaj chadhdai chhu, k garne?

domestic flight ma 1 ghanta, antarrashtriya ma 3 ghanta agadi airport pugnus. ticket ra parichaya patra haat ma rakhnus. haat ko jhola ma tarul padartha ra dhaardar saman ko niyam bujhnus. udda kaan bandh bhaye chewing gum chapaune ki nilne garnus.
pahiro gayeko thau tarnu paryo

sakesamma pahiro ko thau tarnu bhanda parkhanus, mathi bata dhunga khasna sakchha. tarnai parne bhaye ek ek jana, chhito tara shanta bhayera, mathi herdai tarnus. barsha ko bela ra raati kahile pani natarnus. sthaniya manchhe ko salah sunnus.
porter lai kasari ramro byabahar garne?

uchit jyala ra khana basai sunishchit garnus. dherai bhari naboknus, pratyek jana ko lagi uchit taul ko sima rakhnus. chiso ko lagi lugaa ra jutta chha ki hernus. lekh lagda porter lai pani tala jharna dinus, sabai ko jiwan baraabar mahatwapurna ho.
exam ko result kharab aayo, ghar ma kasari bhanne?

lukaunu bhanda chhito ra shanta bhayera bhannu ramro, pachhi thaha paunda jhan naramro hunchha. "yo palta ramro bhayena, kun subject ma kamjor bhaye ra aba k garchhu" bhanne yojana sangai bhannus. aama buwa ris garna sakchhan, tara dherai jaso pachhi bujhchhan. arko palta ko lagi sahayog magnus.
class ma presentation dina dar le pet dukhchha

dar le pet dukhnu samanya ho, sharir le tanab dekhaeko ho. 2-3 din agadi bata ghar ma pura presentation abhyas garnus. presentation agadi bistarai gahiro saas linus ra pani piunus. pahilo 30 second tayar rakhnus, suru bhayepachhi dar ghatchha.
padhda dherai kura ek palta yaad garna khojchhu, kei pani hudaina

dimag ek palta ma thorai kura matra ramro sanga rakhchha. euta chapter lai 3-4 sano bhag ma todnus ra euta bhag pakka bhayepachhi matra arko. bhag sakepachhi afai sodhnus, kitab nahereri bhannus. sano tukra ma sikda dherai kura lamo samaya yaad rahanchha.
ma left handed chhu, lekhda haat dherai phohor hunchha

kagaj lai ali dahine tira tedo rakhnus, haat le lekheko masi nachhoos. chhito sukne kalam ki pencil prayog garnus. haat ko tala rumal ki kagaj rakhda pani phohor kam hunchha. bayan haat le lekhnu ekdam samanya ho, chinta nagarnus.
padhai ko lagi table kursi chhaina, ochhyan ma padhchhu

ochhyan ma padhda nidra chhito lagchha ra dhaad dukhchha. sano pidha ra baksa ko table banaunus, ki bhuin ma sukul bichhayera bhitta ma dhaad lagayera basnus. kitab ali uchai ma rakhnus. padhne thau ra sutne thau chhuttai bhaye dimag lai padhai ko sanket milchha.
bihana uthda taauko dukhchha

raati ko nidra kam ki dherai, pani ko kami, ki dherai bera screen herne baani le pani hunasakchha. sutnu agadi pani piunus ra phone tadha rakhnus. bihana ko khaja nachhodnus. sadhai taauko dukhne, ghurai sangai ki dherai dukhne bhaye doctor sanga jaanch garaunus.
raati bhari khoki le nidra lagdaina

takiya ali uchai garera sutnus ra kotha ko hawa sapha rakhnus. taato pani ma mahu ra adhuwa piunus, sutnu agadi pani baph linus. dhuwa ra dhulo bata tadha rahanus. khoki 2 hapta bhanda badhi rahyo, jworo, saas phulne ki khakar ma ragat bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
jiu ma pasina dherai aauchha, lajja lagchha

din ma 1-2 palta nuhaunus ra kapas jasta hawa chhirne lugaa lagaunus. kaakhi ma antiperspirant prayog garna sakinchha. piro khana ra dherai chiya coffee le pasina badhauna sakchha. achanak dherai pasina, taul ghatne ki mutu dhadkine sangai bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
budhi aama lai kabjiyat bhaihalchha

din bhari thorai thorai pani piune baani lagaunus. bhat sangai saag, tarkari, phal ra jaun jasta resha dinus. din ma halka hidaai garna sahayog garnus. lamo samaya samma kabjiyat, pet dukhne ki ragat dekhiye doctor dekhaunus, aushadhi afai nadinus.
baby lai pahilo khana kahile dine?

dherai jaso 6 mahina pachhi aama ko dudh sangai naram khana suru garne sallah dinchhan, jastai jaulo ra lito. ek palta ma ek naya khana thapnus ra 2-3 din herera matra arko. nun ra chini nathapnus. bachcha ko swasthya karmi sanga taalika bujhnus.
tihar ma mithai dherai khanchhau, sugar ko rogi buwa

buwa ko lagi chini kam bhayeko bikalpa banaunus, jastai phal, bhuteko chana ra nun-mirch ko khaja. mithai khanai paryo bhane khana sangai sano tukra matra. sugar niyamit jaanch garna sahayog garnus ra aushadhi samaya mai khana samjhaunus.
dhan ropain ma din bhari jhuke ra kammar dukhyo

kaam ko bich bich ma ubhiyera kammar pachhadi tira bistarai jhukaunus ra hidnus. beluka taato sek ra halka malish le aaram dinchha. arko din kaam suru garnu agadi jiu tanne halka exercise garnus. dukhai khutta samma jharyo ki lamo samaya rahyo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
khet ma kaam garda haat ma chhala uthyo

kaam garda panja lagaunus, khas gari kodalo ra hasiya prayog garda. chhala uthyo bhane sapha pani le dhoyera chhopnus ra pota nafodnus. raati haat ma tel ki cream lagaunus. ghau ma pip ki sujan aaye health post ma dekhaunus.
bachcha haru mobile ma game khelera ris garchhan

game ko samaya ra niyam pahila nai tay garnus, jastai homework pachhi 30 minet. samaya sakina 5 minet agadi suchana dinus, achanak khosna bhanda sajilo hunchha. niyam palda prashamsa garnus. ris dherai badhe ki padhai ra nidra bigre game ko samaya jhan ghataunus.
ghar ma sabai le aafno phone matra herchhan, gaff hudaina

khana ko samaya "phone nachalaune samaya" banaunus, sabai le phone ek thau ma rakhne. hapta ma ek beluka parivar sanga khel, katha ki sangai pakaune samaya rakhnus. thulo manchhe le suru garnu parchha, bachcha le herera sikchhan.
naya sahar ma kotha khojdai chhu, dalal le paisa magyo

dalal lai paisa dinu agadi kotha afai hernus ra gharbeti sanga pratyaksha kura garnus. advance ra commission ko rasid linus. kotha nadekhai paisa napathaunus. sakesamma chineko manchhe bata ki gharbeti sanga sidhai kotha khojnus.
gharbeti le advance firta dina mandaina

samjhauta ma advance ko niyam k lekheko chha hernus. kotha ramro awastha ma chhodera photo khichnus. shanta bhayera lekhit ma anurodh garnus. milena bhane wada karyalaya ma milapatra ko lagi jaana sakinchha.
kamai thorai, ghar ko kharcha dherai, k garne?

pahila sabai kharcha lekhera jaruri ra najaruri chhuttyaunus. najaruri kharcha ghataunus ra sasto bikalpa khojnus, jastai ghar ko khana. kamai badhaune sano bato pani sochnus: thap sip, sano part-time kaam ki ghar bata garne kaam. sapat bata kharcha chalaune baani nabasaunus.
sano pasal kholda bank loan ki aafantu sanga?

aafantu sanga linda byaj kam hunasakchha tara sambandha bigrine dar pani hunchha, lekhit samjhauta garnus. bank ma byaj lagchha tara niyam spasta hunchha. jun linu bhaye pani tirne yojana pahila banaunus. sakesamma sano bata suru garera loan kam linus.
dherai sahakari ma sadasya chhu, hisab birsinchhu

sabai sahakari ko naam, khata number, bachat ra rin ko bibaran ek copy ma lekhnus. mahina ko ant ma passbook update garaunus. dherai sahakari bhanda 1-2 ramro sahakari ma matra kaam garnu sajilo hunchha. kagaj surakshit thau ma rakhnus.
online bata kineko saman ramro aayena

pahila company ko return ra refund ko niyam padhnus. saman ra packing ko photo ra video rakhnus. customer service ma lekhit gunaso dinus. cash on delivery ra ramro review bhayeko pasal bata kinda yasto samasya kam hunchha.
kasai le mero naam ma loan liyo jasto, k garne?

turuntai sambandhit bank ma gayera bujhnus ra lekhit ujuri dinus. afno parichaya patra ko copy kaha kaha diyeko chha samjhanus. prahari ma pani ujuri garnus. aagadi parichaya patra ko copy ma "kun kaam ko lagi" bhanera lekhera matra dinus.
wifi chalauda phone taato hunchha

video herda ki game khelda phone taato hunu samanya ho, tara dherai taato bhaye prayog roknus. charge gardai game nakhelnus. phone ko cover nikalera chiso thau ma rakhnus. sadhai dherai taato hunchha bhane service centre ma jaanch garaunus.
computer ma document save garna birsiye, sabai gayo

word jasta program ma "recover" ko suvidha hunchha, pheri kholda auto-saved file khojnus. aagadi "autosave" on garnus ra kaam gardai bela bela Ctrl + S thichnus. mahatwapurna file ko copy pen drive ki cloud ma rakhnus.
bachcha lai online ma ajnabi sanga kura nagarna kasari sikaune?

sajilo niyam sikaunus: ajnabi lai naam, school, thegana ra photo nadine. kasai le gopya rakhna bhanyo ki dar lagne kura garyo bhane turuntai aama buwa lai bhanne. game ra app ma chat banda garnus. bachcha le bhanda gali nagarnus, nabhaye arko palta bhandainan.
paila paila interview ma pani "kehi prashna chha?" bhanchhan, k sodhne?

1-2 prashna tayar rakhnus: "yo kaam ma pahilo 3 mahina ma k garnu parchha?" ki "team kasto chha?" talab ko kura pahilo interview ma bhanda pachhi sodhnu ramro. prashna sodhda tapai lai kaam ma sachchai ruchi chha bhanne dekhinchha.
kaam ma sadhai thakai ra man nalagne

kina man lagdaina sochnus: kaam ko bojh, sambandha, ki kaam nai man naparne? sano parivartan, jastai naya sip sikne ki naya jimmewari magne, le farak parna sakchha. kaam bahira ko jiwan, jastai khel, sathi ra nidra, lai pani samaya dinus. lamo samaya rahe manager sanga ki career badalne bare sochnus.
hamro team ma euta manchhe kaam gardaina, sabai bojh malai

kaam ko bhagbanda spasta lekhit garnus ra meeting ma sabai ko agadi tay garnus. usko kaam ko kura byaktigat nabhai kaam ko rup ma bhannus. samasya rahirahe manager lai tathya sahit bhannus. afno kaam ko record rakhnus.
english ma afno parichaya kasari dine?

sajilo dhancha: "My name is ... . I am from ... . I am studying/working as ... . In my free time, I like ... ." yo 4-5 vakya lai abhyas garnus ra afno anusar milaunus. bistarai muskurayera bolnus. sunne le sodheko prashna ko pani chhoto uttar tayar rakhnus.
english kitab padhda dherai shabda dictionary ma herna parchha, thakai lagchha
har shabda nahernus, pura vakya bata arth anuman garnus. 1 pana ma 2-3 wata dohorine shabda matra hernus. ali sajilo kitab chhannus, jasma 90% shabda bujhinchha. bistarai garo kitab tira jaanus.
sathi haru sanga bahira jaana paisa chhaina, lajja lagchha

imandar bhayera sathi lai bhannus: "yo hapta budget kam chha." sasto ra ramailo bikalpa sujhaunus, jastai park ma hidne, ghar ma khana pakayera khane. sachcha sathi le bujhchhan. afno budget anusar chalnu buddhimani ho.
aama buwa ko bihe ko anniversary ma k garne?

sano tara man bata gareko kura sabai bhanda ramro: unko purano photo jamma garera album, ghar mai mitho khana, ki parivar sanga sano bhoj. bachcha haru le chithi lekhera dinda unlai dherai khusi lagchha. mahango upahar bhanda samaya ra maya mahatwapurna.
dherai bolne manchhe sanga kasari bidaa magne?

namra tara spasta bhannus: "tapai sanga kura garda ramro lagyo, aba malai kaam ma jaanu chha." ubhiyera ki saman samatera sanket dinus. "pachhi kura garaula" bhanera muskurayera bidaa magnus. sammaan sanga bhanda kasai lai naramro lagdaina.
ghar ma pahuna aaudai, dherai kaam chha, kasari milaune?

ek din agadi nai bazaar ra safai ko kaam sakaunus. khana ko menu sajilo rakhnus ra kehi kura agadi nai tayar garnus, jastai achar ra tarkari kaatne. parivar ka sadasya lai kaam baadnus. pahuna sanga basne samaya pani rakhnus, sab kaam eklai nagarnus.
bachcha ko janmadin party ko plan

bachcha ko umer anusar sano ra ramailo rakhnus, 5-10 jana sathi pugchha. ghar mai khel, gaana ra cake rakhnus. khana sajilo ra bachcha lai man parne banaunus. bachcha ko suraksha ko lagi thulo manchhe sangai rahanus.
ramro tarkari ko biu kaha bata linne?

najik ko krishi karyalaya, sahakari ki bharosa ko krishi pasal bata linus. packet ma kampani ko naam, miti ra ugne pratishat hernus. thulo matra kinnu agadi sano matra ropera herna sakinchha. aafno ramro bot bata biu jogaune sip pani siknus.
gaun ma makai ma kira lagyo

kira lageko bot ra paat chhuttyaunus ra kheti sapha rakhnus. krishi praabidhik ki krishi karyalaya ma kira ko photo lagera sodhnus, sahi upaya bataunchhan. bish prayog garnu parda sahi matra, panja ra mask prayog garnus. bish ko bhaado bachcha bata tadha rakhnus.
bakhra lai khoki lagyo

bakhra lai sukha, hawa aaune tara chiso nachhirne khor ma rakhnus. birami bakhra lai aru bata chhuttyaunus. sapha pani ra ramro ghans dinus. pashu chikitsak ki pashu sewa karyalaya ma chhito sampark garnus, afai mahango aushadhi nadinus.
gaai ko dudh ghatyo

pugdo hariyo ghans, dana ra sapha pani dinus. khor sapha ra aaram dayak rakhnus, tanab le pani dudh ghatchha. birami ka lakshan, jastai jworo ki thun ma sujan, chha ki hernus. pashu chikitsak sanga salah linus.
manchhe ko naam chhito birsinchhu

naam sunne bittikai kura ma ek palta dohoryaunus: "namaste ramesh ji, bhetera khusi lagyo." naam lai kunai chineko kura sanga jodnus, jastai "ramesh, mero mama jastai". kura sakepachhi phone ma naam ra kaha bhetieko lekhnus. naam bisaye "maaf garnus, naam pheri bhannu na" bhannu pani thik ho.
ghar ko gamla ko bot sukdai gayo

mato ma aunla 2 cm ghusarera hernus: sukha bhaye matra pani dinus, dherai pani le jara kuhinchha. gamla ko tala pani nikalne pwal chha ki hernus. bot lai pugdo ujyalo ra ghaam chahinchha, tara kehi bot lai sidhai ghaam man pardaina. pahelo paat hataunus ra mahina ma ek palta alikati mal dinus.
phone ko screen sapha kasari garne?

phone banda garera naram microfiber kapada ki chashma puchhne kapada le bistarai puchhnus. kapada ma alikati pani matra halnus, phone ma sidhai pani nahalnus. sanitizer ra dherai rasayan bhayeko safa garne kura screen ko coating bigarna sakchha. charging port ma pani napasos.
garmi ma ghar ekdam taato hunchha

diuso ghaam lagne jhyal ma parda ki chhaya rakhnus ra bihana beluka chiso bela jhyal kholnus. chhana ma seto rang ki ghaam pharkaune kura le bhitra ko taap ghataunchha. ghar warpar rukh ra lahara ropnu lamo samaya ko ramro upaya. pani dherai piunus ra halka kapas ko lugaa lagaunus.
hiundo ma ghar ekdam chiso hunchha

jhyal ra dhoka ko pwal bata chiso hawa pasna nadina kapada ki tape le bandh garnus. diuso ghaam lagne jhyal kholera ghaam bhitra aauna dinus ra beluka mota parda lagaunus. bhuin ma gundri ki carpet bichhyaunus. aago ki heater kotha bhitra chalaunda hawa aaune banaunus, banda kotha ma sutnu khatarnak.
ghar ma lamkhutte dherai

ghar warpar jamek pani hataunus: gamla ko thal, tyre, bhaado. jhyal ma jali lagaunus ra sutda jhul prayog garnus. beluka dhoka jhyal banda rakhnus. lamkhutte bhagaune cream ki coil prayog garda kotha ma hawa aaune rakhnus.
garmi ma khana chhito bigrinchha, pet kharab hune dar

pakaeko khana 2 ghanta bhanda badhi bahira narakhnus, fridge ma rakhnus. dudh, dahi, masu ra bhat khanu agadi gandha ra swad jaanchnus. bacheko khana ramrari tataera matra khanus. pani umaleko ki shuddha garera matra piunus ra khana agadi haat dhunus.
sano bachcha pani najik kasari surakshit rakhne?

bachcha pani najik hunda ek chhin pani eklai nachhodnus, thorai pani ma pani dubna sakchha. ghar ko baltin ra tanki chhopera rakhnus. khola, pokhari ra kuwa warpar bar lagaunus. ali thulo bhaye pauri sikaunus, tara pauri jaane le pani thulo manchhe ko herchah chahinchha.
lamo samaya bijuli jaane bhayo, kasari tayari garne?

phone ra power bank pura charge garera rakhnus. torch, batti ra matches ek thau ma rakhnus. fridge ko dhoka bar bar nakholnus, chiso lamo rahanchha. pani bharera rakhnus ra jaruri aushadhi ko byabastha garnus.
kasai lai dhanyabad ko chithi kasari lekhne?

suru ma unko naam ra sidhai dhanyabad: "tapai le gareko sahayog ko lagi dherai dhanyabad." ani unle k garnu bhayo ra tyasle tapai lai kasari madat garyo bhanne 1-2 vakya. antya ma shubhakamana ra afno naam. chhoto ra man bata lekheko chithi sabai bhanda mitho hunchha.
jagir gayo, k garne thaha chhaina

pahila afulai ali samaya dinus, yo garo samaya ho ra tapai ko galti nahuna pani sakchha. mahina ko jaruri kharcha herera bachat kati samaya chalchha hisab garnus. CV update garnus ra chineko manchhe lai kaam khojdai chhu bhanera bhannus. naya sip sikne yo samaya pani hunasakchha.
mero kukur mare, ekdam dukha lagyo

pet marda pariwar ko sadasya gumaye jastai dukha hunchha, runu ra udas hunu swabhabik ho. usko yaad ma photo ki sano samjhana rakhnus. bachcha bhaye unlai pani sajilo bhasha ma bujhaunus ra unko bhawana sunnus. samaya sangai dukha halka hunchha.
ris uthda turuntai shant kasari hune?

tyahi bela bolna chhodnus ra 5 palta bistarai gahiro saas linus. chiso pani piunus ki anuhar dhunus. sambhav bhaye 5-10 minet bahira hidnus. shanta bhayepachhi matra kura garnus, ris ma gareko nirnaya pachhi pachhutauna sakinchha.
halla ma office ma kaam ma dhyan dina sakdina

earphone ma bina shabda ko halka sangeet ki "white noise" sunnus. sakesamma shanta kotha ki kuna khojnus. garo kaam bihana chhito ki halla kam hune bela garnus. sahakarmi lai namra bhayera halla kam garna anurodh garna pani sakinchha.
byabasaya ma noksan bhayo, aba k garne?

pahila sabai hisab herera noksan kaha bhayo bujhnus: mol, kharcha ki grahak ko kami. sapat bhaye kun pahila tirne yojana banaunus. sikeko kura lekhnus, arko suruwat ma kaam lagchha. ek palta asafal hunu le tapai asafal byabasayi bhaneko haina.
40 barsha ma bachat suru garna dhilo bhayo?

dhilo bhayo bhanera nachhodnus, aaja suru garnu sabai bhanda ramro samaya ho. talab ko 15-20% bachat lakshya rakhnus ra kharcha ghataune thau khojnus. sapat bhaye pahila mahango byaj ko sapat tirnus. budhyauli ko lagi niyamit lagani ko barema jankaar sanga salah linus.
doctor kaha jaanda k k sodhne birsinchhu

jaanu agadi lakshan, kahile dekhi, k le badhchha ra hal khane aushadhi ko list kagaj ma lekhnus. sodhna chahane prashna pani lekhnus. doctor le bhaneko kura tyahi lekhnus ki sangai jaane manchhe lai lekhna lagaunus. bujhena bhane pheri sodhnus, sodhnu tapai ko adhikar ho.
aushadhi ko patta ma k k padhne?

aushadhi ko naam, matra (jastai 500 mg), kahile kahile khane ra expiry date hernus. "khana pachhi" ki "khali pet" lekheko chha ki padhnus. bachcha ko aushadhi ma umer ra taul anusar matra hunchha. bujhena bhane pharmacist lai sodhnus, anuman ma nakhanus.
ghar mai pressure naapne machine kinne?

pressure ko rog bhayeka ko lagi ghar ma naapne machine kaam lagchha. naapnu agadi 5 minet shanta basnus ra ekai samaya ma naapnus. nattija lekhera doctor lai dekhaunus. machine ko nattija le matra aushadhi badalnus, doctor ko salah bina haina.
trek ko budget kasari banaune?

permit, yatayat, lodge, khana, guide ra porter ko kharcha chhuttai lekhnus. din ko kharcha mathi tira badhdai janchha, mathi ko lagi badhi rakhnus. jamma ma 15-20% aakasmik kharcha thapnus. nagad paisa pugdo boknus kinabhane mathi ATM hudaina.
trek ko guide kasari chhanne?

darta bhayeko agency ki license bhayeko guide chhannus. pahila kura garera unko anubhav, bato ko gyan ra prathamik upachar ko talim sodhnus. jyala, khana basai ra bima ko kura lekhit tay garnus. aru yatri ko review ra sifarish pani hernus.
kukur lai sangai lagera yatra garne?

kukur ko khop ra swasthya kagaj sangai rakhnus. bus ki gadi ko niyam pahila bujhnus, sabai le kukur lana dindainan. pani, khana, dori ra phohor uthaune poko boknus. lamo yatra ma bela bela rokera hidna dinus.
yatra ma halka jhola kasari banaune?

har din ko lagi naya lugaa haina, 2-3 jodi lugaa dhoera lagaune gari linus. sano bottle ma sabun, shampoo ra toothpaste linus. "kahile kahi chahinchha ki" bhanne saman nalinus. bhari jutta lagayera hidnus, jhola ma haina.
pahad ko bato ma bus ma jaanda dar lagchha

sakesamma ujyalo ma yatra garnus ra ramro awastha ko bus chhannus. agadi ko seat ma basda bomit ra dar dubai kam hunchha. driver le dherai chhito chalaye ki phone ma kura gare namra bhayera bhannus. dherai bheed ra chhat ma manchhe bhayeko bus ma nachadhnus.
raati bus bato ma bigriyo, k garne?

bus bhitra ki samuha sangai rahanus, eklai andhyaro ma nahidnus. phone ko charge bachaunus ra parivar lai awastha bataunus. driver ra conductor sanga kati samaya lagchha bujhnus. aakasmik awastha bhaye 100 ma prahari lai phone garnus.
jatra ma dherai bheed, kasari surakshit rahane?

bheed ko bich ma bhanda chheu tira rahanus ra bhaagne bato samjhanus. bachcha ko haat samatnus ra phone number unko khalti ma rakhnus. jhola agadi rakhnus ra mulyawan saman ghar mai chhodnus. dhakkamukki suru bhaye bheed ko disha sanga bistarai sarnus, ulto nadaudnus.
bato ko kukur dekhi dar lagchha

kukur dekhda nadaudnus ra shanta bhayera bistarai hidnus. kukur ko sidha aankha ma nahernus ra haat najik naghumaunus. kukur najik aaye ubhinus ra jhola agadi rakhnus. tokyo bhane ghau sabun pani le 15 minet dhoyera rabies ko khop ko lagi swasthya sanstha jaanus.
mandir ma bandar le khana khosyo

bandar bhayeko thau ma khana ra plastic ko jhola dekhine gari naboknus. bandar sanga aankha milayera nahernus ra jiskaunus nai haina. bandar najik aaye shanta bhayera hatnus, khana dina nakhojnus. bandar le chot lagayo bhane ghau dhoyera turuntai swasthya sanstha jaanus.
mauri le tokyo

chhala ma mauri ko kanda chha bhane nang ki card le ragadera nikalnus, chimta le thichera haina. sabun pani le dhunus ra chiso sek dinus. saas pherna garo, anuhar ra ghaati sunnine ki chakkar lagne bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus, yo gambhir allergy hunasakchha.
bachcha ko naak banda, sutna sakdaina

kotha ma baph ko lagi taato pani ko bhaado tadha rakhnus, bachcha lai sidhai baph nadinus. nun pani ko naak ko thopa (saline) pharmacist sanga sodhera prayog garna sakinchha. takiya ali uchai rakhnus. saas pherna garo, uchho jworo ki khana nakhane bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
diary lekhne baani kasari suru garne?

din ma 5 minet matra, sutnu agadi lekhne niyam banaunus. "aaja k bhayo, k sikye, k ramro lagyo" jasta 3 prashna ko uttar lekhnus. sabai din lamo lekhnu pardaina. euta sano notebook sadhai ochhyan chheu rakhnus.
nang tokne baani chhodna sakdina

kahile tokchhu bhanera hernus, dherai jaso tanab ki bore hunda. nang chhoto kaatera rakhnus. haat lai kehi kaam dinus, jastai sano ball thichne. tokna man lagda gahiro saas linus. nang ma tito swad ko nail polish lagaune upaya pani kaam lagchha.
naya phone kinna kun kura herne?

tapai ko prayog anusar chhannus: photo, game ki sadharan kaam. battery, storage (kamti 64-128 GB) ra RAM hernus. company ko update kati barsha dinchha bhanne pani mahatwapurna. bharosa ko pasal bata bill ra warranty sahit kinnus.
bachcha ko lagi school kasari chhanne?

padhaai ko gunastar, shikshak ko byabahar ra kaksha ma bidyarthi sankhya hernus. ghar bata duri ra yatayat ko suraksha bujhnus. fee ra aru lukeko kharcha sodhnus. sakesamma tyahi padhne bachcha ka aama buwa sanga anubhav sodhnus.
kishor chhora lai sharir ko parivartan ko barema kasari bhanne?

sajilo, sidha ra imandar bhasha ma umer anusar kura garnus, lajja ko kura banaunus nai haina. "yo sabai lai hunchha, samanya ho" bhanera dhukka dinus. prashna sodhna dinus ra thaha nabhaye "sangai bujhaula" bhannus. bharosa yogya kitab ki swasthya karmi ko sahayog pani linu sakinchha.
chhori lai exam ko dherai tension chha

pahila uslai sunnus, "tension nali" bhanda "garo lageko bujhchhu" bhannus. padhai ko sajilo taalika banauna sahayog garnus ra nidra ra khana ma dhyan dinus. result bhanda prayas ko prashamsa garnus. tension le khana nidra bigarirahe teacher ki counsellor sanga kura garnus.
chori bhayo bhane prahari lai kasari khabar garne?

aakasmik bhaye 100 ma phone garnus. najik ko prahari karyalaya ma gayera lekhit ujuri dinus: k harayo, kahile, kaha ra shanka lagne kura. harayeko saman ko photo, bill ra serial number bhaye sangai lyaunus. ujuri ko copy afu sanga rakhnus.
rahadani (passport) banauna kasari?

rahadani ko niyam ra kagaj samaya sangai badalina sakchha, tyasaile rahadani bibhag ko aadhikarik website ma bujhnus. dherai jaso nagarikta ko praman patra ra online form chahinchha. form bharda naam ra janma miti nagarikta sanga milchha ki jaanch garnus. dalal lai paisa dinu bhanda afai prakriya bujhnus.
gunaso ko chithi kasari lekhne?

suru ma ko lai lekhdai hunuhunchha ra bishaya spasta lekhnus. k samasya bhayo, kahile ra kaha, tathya sahit chhoto ma lekhnus. tapai k samadhan chahanu hunchha bhanne spasta bhannus. namra bhasha prayog garnus ra afno naam, sampark number lekhnus.
bank ma kaam garna dar lagchha, k sodhne thaha hudaina

bank ma "sodhpuchh" ki "customer service" desk ma gayera sidhai bhannus: "malai yo kaam garnu chha, k garnu parchha?" form bujhena bhane sahayog magnus, unko kaam nai yahi ho. jaanu agadi chahine kagaj phone garera sodhnus. pin ra password kasai lai nadinus, bank karmachari lai pani.
ghumna jaana paisa kasari jamma garne?

yatra ko jamma kharcha anuman garnus ra kati mahina ma jamma garne tay garnus. jastai 30000 ko yatra 6 mahina ma bhaye mahina ko 5000. chhuttai "yatra kosh" ko khata ki khutruke banaunus. chiya-nasta jasto sano kharcha ghataera tyahi ma halnus.
padhai ra prem sambandha kasari balance garne?

dubai mahatwapurna hunasakchhan, tara padhai ko samaya tokera rakhnus. ek arka ko padhai ra lakshya ko sammaan garnus, sangai padhna pani sakinchha. phone ma ghanta ghanta kura garda padhai bigrinchha, kura garne samaya tokdinus. sambandha le tanab dinchha bhane imandar kura garnus.
college ma senior le ragging garchhan

ragging galat ho, sahanu pardaina. turuntai teacher, college prashasan ki bharosa ko senior lai bhannus. sangai sathi haru sanga rahanus ra k bhayo lekhera rakhnus. dhamki ki hinsa bhaye prahari ma ujuri garna sakinchha.
hostel ma mero saman chori hunchha
mulyawan saman tala lagaune daraj ki box ma rakhnus. phone ra paisa ochhyan ma chhodera nabahirinus. saman ma naam lekhnus. hostel warden lai bhannus ra chori ko samaya ra saman ko list dinus.
roommate le kotha sapha gardaina

shanta bela ma kura garnus: "kotha sapha bhaye dubai lai ramro lagchha, kaam baadau?" sarsafai ko taalika banaunus, ko le kahile k garne. sano sudhar ko pani prashamsa garnus. pheri pani samasya bhaye hostel ki gharbeti sanga kura garnus.
ramro pahilo chhap (first impression) kasari banaune?

samaya mai pugnus ra sapha lugaa lagaunus. muskurayera namaste garnus ra naam samjhanus. afu bhanda badhi arko ko kura sunnus ra prashna sodhnus. phone ma dhyan nadinus, samne ko manchhe lai pura dhyan dinus.
debate pratiyogita ma kasari ramro garne?

bishaya ko dubai pakshya padhnus, ani matra afno tarka banaunus. 3 wata baliyo tarka, udaharan ra tathya sahit tayar garnus. bolda spasta ra bistarai bolnus, chichyaunu pardaina. arko pakshya ko kura dhyan le sunnus ra tyasko jawaf tayar rakhnus.
science fair ko lagi project idea chahiyo

sajilo ra kaam lagne bishaya chhannus: pani shuddha garne sano filter, ghar ko phohor bata compost, ki solar ko sano model. project ko "prashna, tarika, nattija" spasta lekhnus. afai banayeko ra bujheko project nai ramro, mahango haina.
pauri sikna chahanchhu, ulto dar lagchha

talim prapta shikshak ra surakshit pool ma matra siknus, khola ma eklai haina. suru ma uthne ra saas line abhyas garnus, ani khutta chalaune. life jacket ra kinara najik bata suru garnus. dar lagnu swabhabik ho, bistarai bharosa aauchha.
gadi chalauna sikdai chhu, dar lagchha

talim prapta prashikshak sanga ra khali, surakshit thau ma abhyas garnus. clutch, brake ra accelerator bistarai chalauna siknus. mirror herne ra indicator dine baani suru dekhi nai basaunus. hatar nagarnus, har din thorai abhyas le bharosa badhchha.
pahilo palta pahuna lai khana pakaune, dar lagchha

naya recipe try nagarnus, ramrari aaune 2-3 kura matra pakaunus. ek din agadi nai tarkari kaatne ra masala tayar rakhnus. dal bhat tarkari ra achar jasto sadharan khana pani maya le pakaye sabai lai man parchha. pakaunda chakhdai nun milaunus.
online interview ma camera ma herna garo

camera lai screen ko mathi aankha ko sidha uchai ma rakhnus. bolda camera ko lens ma hernus, anuhar herdina bhanne lagchha tara sunne lai sidhai boleko jasto lagchha. lens ko chheu ma sano sticker rakhda yaad hunchha. ghar mai sathi sanga abhyas garnus.
kaam ma naya software sikna garo lagyo

pahila sabai bhanda dherai prayog hune 3-4 kaam matra siknus. sikeko step lekhera rakhnus. sahakarmi sanga 15 minet dekhaidina anurodh garnus. youtube ko chhoto video ra software ko "help" bhag pani kaam lagchha. har din thorai prayog garda chhito sikinchha.
sahakarmi le mero idea afno bhanera bhanyo

aagadi afno idea email ma lekhera manager lai pathaune baani rakhnus, record rahanchha. meeting ma afno kura afai spasta bhannus. sahakarmi sanga shanta bhayera eklai kura garnus. bar bar bhaye manager lai tathya sahit bhannus.
kaam ma dherai galti hunchha, manager risaunchhan

kaam sakepachhi pathaunu agadi ek palta jaanch garne checklist banaunus. galti kun kisim ko chha hernus ra tyasko karan khojnus: hatar, ki bujhai ko kami. manager sanga sodhnus: "kun kura ma badhi dhyan dinu?" sudhar ko yojana dekhauda bharosa badhchha.
dherai email aauchha, kasari milaune?

din ma 2-3 palta matra email herne samaya tokdinus. turuntai jawaf dina milne email 2 minet ma sakaunus, baki ko lagi samaya rakhnus. folder ra label banayera milaunus. nachaine newsletter bata unsubscribe garnus.
bihana ko samaya sabai bhanda productive banaune kasari?

raati nai bholi ko 3 mukhya kaam lekhnus. bihana uthne bittikai phone nahernus, pahila pani piune ra halka chalan garnus. sabai bhanda garo kaam bihana ko pahilo 1-2 ghanta ma garnus. email ra message pachhi herna sakinchha.
padhaune teacher hu, kamjor bidyarthi lai kasari sahayog garne?

kun aadhar ko kura chhutyo pahila thaha paunus, sano test ki sodhera. sajilo bata suru garera sano safalta dinus. kaksha pachhi 10-15 minet thap samaya dina sakinchha. gali bhanda prashamsa ra dhairya le dherai kaam garchha, aama buwa sanga pani sampark rakhnus.
tuition padhaune fee kati rakhne?

tyo thau ma aru le kati liraheka chhan bujhnus. kaksha, subject ra samaya anusar fee farak hunchha. suru ma uchit fee rakhera ramro nattija dekhaunus, pachhi badhauna sakinchha. fee ko niyam, jastai mahina ko suru ma tirne, spasta bhannus.
gaun ma sano pasal ma kun saman rakhne?

dainik chahine saman bata suru garnus: chamal, dal, tel, nun, chini, sabun ra biscuit. gaun ka manchhe lai k kinna bazaar jaanu parchha sodhnus, tyo saman rakhnus. sano matra ma lyaunus ra kun bikchha hernus. hisab ko copy rakhnus.
mero pasal ko saman ko stock kasari herne?

euta copy ma har saman ko naam, aayeko matra ra bikeko lekhnus. hapta ma ek palta pasal ma bhayeko saman gannus. chhito sakine saman pahila nai order garnus. lamo samaya nabikeko saman sasto ma bechera sakaunus.
kheti ma pani ko kami chha

thopa sinchai (drip) ra mulching le pani dherai bachauchha. barsha ko pani pokhari ki tanki ma jamma garnus. kam pani chahine baali, jastai kodo ki makai, lagauna sochnus. bihana sabere ki beluka pani dinus, diuso ghaam ma pani chhito udchha.
mausam le baali nashta bhayo

krishi bima gareko bhaye bima company ra sthaniya krishi karyalaya lai turuntai khabar garnus. noksan ko photo ra bibaran rakhnus. sthaniya palika ko rahat ra sahayog ko barema sodhnus. aru kisan sanga milera arko baali ko yojana banaunus.
bhaisi kinda k herne?

bhaisi ko umer, swasthya ra dudh dine kshamata hernus, sakesamma dudh duhera herna magnus. aankha, nak, khutta ra chhala sapha ra swastha chha ki hernus. khop ra swasthya ko kagaj sodhnus. bharosa ko kisan ki pashu chikitsak sanga sangai gayera kinnus.
gaun bata shahar sarera kaam khojne, k tayari?

pahila najik ko aafantu ki sathi sanga basne thau ko byabastha garnus. CV ra nagarikta jasta kagaj ko copy tayar rakhnus. 1-2 mahina ko kharcha ko lagi bachat linus. ramro kaam napaunjel sano kaam pani suru garnus, ra thagi ko kaam ko vigyapan bata satark rahanus.
hamro gaun ma school ko library chhaina

shikshak, abhibhavak ra gaun ka manchhe milera purano kitab jamma garna sakinchha. euta kotha ki daraj ma sano library suru garnus. bidyarthi lai palo palo library herne jimmewari dinus. sthaniya palika ra sanstha haru sanga kitab ko sahayog magnus.
chhimeki ko bachcha lai kut pit hunchha jasto lagchha

bachcha ko suraksha sabai bhanda mahatwapurna ho. dekheko ki suneko kura miti sahit lekhnus. wada karyalaya, prahari (100) ki bal adhikar ka sanstha lai khabar garnus. aafai jhagada garna najaanus, tara bachcha lai sahayog garna chup nabasnus.
budhi aama lai ghar ma laddi chot laagchha bhanne dar

bhuin ma chiplo gundri ra taar hataunus ra raati bato ma sano batti rakhnus. bathroom ma samatne dandi ra chiplo nahune mat rakhnus. bharyang ma ujyalo ra raling rakhnus. aama lai aaram ko jutta lagaunus ra niyamit hidaai garna sahayog garnus.
ghar ko bijuli ko taar purano bhayo, dar lagchha

taar ko kabhar phuteko, switch taato hune ki batti jhimkiyeko dekhiye licensed electrician lai turuntai dekhaunus. ek socket ma dherai plug nalagaunus. bhijeko haat le switch nachhunus. MCB ki fuse sahi chha ki jaanch garaunus.
bachcha ko janmadin ma bolaeko sathi ko aama buwa sanga kasari kura garne?

nimto dinda miti, samaya, thau ra kahile samma bhanne spasta bhannus. bachcha lai kasari lyaune lane bhanne kura milaunus. kunai khana ko allergy chha ki sodhnus. kaam ko phone number dinus, sampark sajilo hunchha.
dherai sathi ko bihe, upahar ko paisa pugdaina

sabai bihe ma mahango upahar dinu pardaina, upasthiti nai mahatwapurna. mahina ko budget ma "upahar" bhanne chhuttai rakam rakhnus. sano tara kaam lagne upahar, jastai photo frame, chhannus. najik ka sathi ma ali badhi ra aru ma shubhakamana patra pani pugchha.
bachcha ko lagi sasto khelauna ghar mai banaune?

purano box bata ghar, gadi ki robot banauna sakinchha. kagaj ko dunga, kite ra puppet banaunus. ghar ko bhaado ra chamcha bata sangeet ko khel garna sakinchha. bachcha sangai banauda ramailo ra sikai dubai hunchha.
buwa aama lai mobile banking sikaunu chha

pahila sajilo kaam, jastai balance herne, sikaunus. PIN ra OTP kasai lai nadine kura bar bar bhannus. sano rakam pathaune abhyas sangai garnus. shanka lagne message ki phone aaye tapai lai sodhna bhannus.
online class ma bachcha le game kheldai basirahechha

online class ko bela bachcha lai tapai le dekhne thau ma basaunus. arko app ra game ko notification banda garnus ra chahine app matra kholnus. class pachhi k sikyo bhanera sodhnus. teacher sanga pani sampark rakhnus.
hamro tole ma chori badhyo, k garne?

chhimeki sanga milera tole ko surakshya samiti banaunus ra raati ko ujyalo badhaunus. shanka lagne manchhe dekhe prahari lai khabar garnus. ghar ko dhoka ra jhyal ma ramro tala lagaunus. chhimeki bich phone number baadnus.
ghar bahira jaanda bijuli ko saman k garne?
lamo samaya bahira jaanda geyser, heater ra TV ko plug nikalnus. gas ko regulator banda garnus. fridge ma khana kam rakhnus. ghar ko sabai jhyal dhoka banda gari chhimeki lai bhannus.
bihe pachhi naya ghar ma kasari milne?

suru ma ghar ko niyam ra chalan herera sikna samaya linus. sabai sanga namra byabahar ra sano kaam ma madat garnus. asajilo kura bhaye shanta bhayera shrimaan ki shrimati sanga kura garnus. afno pahichan ra sathi ko sambandha pani jogaunus.
shrimaan shrimati bich kura kam bhayo

din ma 15-20 minet phone bina sangai basne samaya rakhnus, chiya khanda ki hidda. ek arka ko din ko barema sodhnus ra dhyan le sunnus. sano kaam ma kadar bhannus: "dhanyabad". kahile kahi sangai naya kura garnus, jastai ghumna jaane.
bachcha ko pahilo school ko din, aama nai dar

aama ko dar swabhabik ho. pahilo din samaya mai pugnus, chhoto ra khusi bidaai garnus, lamo samaya narokinus. bachcha le runa sakchha, dherai jaso kehi bera ma shant hunchhan. beluka school ko ramailo kura sodhnus.
dherai sochera nidra lagdaina, bholi presentation

sutnu agadi presentation ko mukhya bunda ek pana ma lekhera "tayar chha" bhanne bharosa dinus. phone tadha rakhnus ra 4-7-8 jasto saas ko abhyas garnus: 4 second bhitra, 7 rokne, 8 bahira. nidra nalage pani ochhyan ma aankha banda gari aaram garnus, sharir lai aaram milchha.
mero chhora lai sathi chhaina school ma

chhora sanga kura garnus: kun bachcha sanga khelna man parchha? tyo bachcha lai ghar ma khelna bolaune bandobast garna sakinchha. khel, gaana ki kala ko club ma bhag lina protsahan dinus. teacher sanga pani kura garnus, school ma kasto chha thaha hunchha.
ma jhuto bolchhu bhanera sathi le bharosa gardaina

bharosa pheri banauna samaya lagchha. aba dekhi sano kura ma pani sachcho bolnus, ra bhaneko kaam samaya mai garnus. galti bhaye sidhai swikarnus. sathi lai bhannus: "ma sudhrina khojdai chhu", ani kaam le dekhaunus.
sathi ko ghar ma pahilo palta khana khana jaane

samaya mai pugnus ra sakesamma sano upahar, jastai phal ki mithai, lagnus. ghar ko thulo lai namaste garnus. khana ko prashamsa garnus ra thal sapha garna madat garna sodhnus. jaane bela dhanyabad bhannus.
paisa sapat diyeko sathi le phone uthaudaina

message ma namra tara spasta lekhnus: "tyo paisa ko barema kura garna man chha, kahile milchha?" kista ma firta garna sujhaw dinus. sambandha ra paisa dubai ko lagi lekhit samjhauta ramro hunchha. thulo rakam bhaye kanuni salah ko barema sochna sakinchha.
whatsapp group ma dherai message, dimag kharab

jaruri nabhayeko group mute garnus. group ko notification banda garera din ma ek palta matra hernus. nachahine group bata namra bhayera niklanus. photo ra video automatic download banda garnus, storage pani bachchha.
social media ma sadhai naramro khabar herda chinta badhchha

samachar herne samaya din ma 1-2 palta matra tokdinus. bharosa yogya samachar ko srot matra hernus. sutnu agadi samachar nahernus. chinta lagda ahile garna milne sano kaam ma dhyan dinus, jastai pariwar sanga samaya.
kitab padhna man chha tara kun padhne?

tapai lai ruchi lagne bishaya bata suru garnus: katha, jiwani, itihas ki sip sikne kitab. chhoto ra sajilo kitab bata suru garda baani banchha. sathi ki library ma sifarish sodhnus. pahilo 20 pana padhda man naparye arko kitab linu thik ho.
bachcha haru lai kitab padhne baani kasari?

sutnu agadi 10 minet sangai katha padhne niyam banaunus. bachcha ko ruchi ko chitra bhayeko kitab chhannus. ghar ma kitab dekhine thau ma rakhnus ra tapai pani bachcha ko agadi padhnus. library ma sangai jaane din banaunus.
thakai le kaam pachhi exercise garna man lagdaina

kaam bata farkine bittikai lugaa ferera 10 minet ko halka hidaai bata suru garnus. sakesamma bihana chhoto exercise garnus, beluka thakai hudaina. sathi sanga sangai garda josh aauchha. 10 minet pani kehi nagarnu bhanda dherai ramro.
jado ma bihana hidna kasari jaane?

raati nai nyano lugaa, topi ra panja tayar rakhnus. ghar bhitra 5 minet jiu tanne garera matra bahira niklanus. bihana ko sabai bhanda chiso samaya nabhai ghaam aaye pachhi pani hidna sakinchha. sathi sanga plan garda chhodna man lagdaina.
padhai ko lagi bihana 4 baje uthne ki raati 12 samma padhne?

duitai ko satta pugne nidra sahit niyamit samaya ramro. 10-11 baje sutera 5-6 baje uthnu dherai jaso lai sajilo hunchha. bihana dimag taja hune bela garo subject padhnus. raati dherai jagda bholi ko dhyan bigrinchha.
kaksha ma dherai bolne sathi le padhna dinna

namra bhayera bhannus: "aaja ma padhai ma dhyan dina khojdai chhu, pachhi kura garaula." sambhav bhaye teacher sanga basne thau badalna anurodh garnus. break ko samaya ma sathi sanga gaff garnus, mitrata pani rahanchha.
computer class ma sabai bhanda pachhadi chhu

ghar ma computer nabhaye library ki cyber ma hapta ma 2-3 ghanta abhyas garnus. class ma sikeko step copy ma lekhnus. ekai kaam 3 palta dohoryaunus, haat basdai janchha. teacher lai thap abhyas ko kaam magnus.
exam ma sabai prashna aauchha tara lekhda dherai samaya lagchha

lamo uttar agadi 30 second ma bunda tipnus, ani lekhnus, bichma sochna samaya bachchha. ank anusar uttar ko lambai milaunus, 2 ank ko prashna ma pura pana nalekhnus. ghar ma ghadi rakhera lekhne abhyas garnus. handwriting sapha tara sano rakhnus.
dherai padhda taauko gahrungo hunchha

har 40-50 minet ma 5-10 minet aaram garnus, uthera hidnus ra pani piunus. ujyalo ra hawa aaune kotha ma padhnus. raati ramro nidra linus ra khana nachhodnus. taauko dukhai bar bar ki dherai bhaye aankha ra swasthya jaanch garaunus.
hiundo ma haat khutta phutchha

haat khutta dhoepachhi turuntai sukha puchhera tel ki cream lagaunus. raati kurkucha ma vaseline lagayera moja lagaunus. dherai taato pani le nadhunus, chhala jhan sukchha. ragat aaune gari phuteko ki sankraman bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
budhi aama ko daat chhaina, k khana dine?

naram ra pachna sajilo khana dinus: khichadi, dal bhat ko naram mix, jaulo, dahi, umaleko tarkari ra phal ko lito. masu ra saag pakayera sano tukra ma kaatnus. daat ko lagi dentist sanga nakkali daat ko barema pani sodhna sakinchha.
bachcha le kehi nilla bhanne dar, sano saman ghar ma dherai

sikka, button, battery ra sano khelauna bachcha ko pahunch bata mathi rakhnus. khas gari button battery nilda ekdam khatarnak hunchha. bhuin bela bela sapha garnus. bachcha le kehi nilyo jasto lage ra saas pherna garo bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus.
dheri chiso peya piunchhu, chhodne kasari?

ek palta mai chhodnu bhanda ghataudai jaanus: din ko 2 bata 1, ani hapta ma 2-3. chiso peya ko satta chiso pani ma kagati ki phal ko ras. ghar ma stock narakhnus. pani ko bottle sangai rakhda pyas lagda pani nai piinchha.
ghar ma sabai lai rugha lagyo, kasari phailina rokne?

birami le khokda ra hachhyau garda rumal ki kuhino le mukh chhopnus. haat bela bela sabun le dhunus. birami ko gilas, towel ra takiya chhuttai rakhnus. kotha ma hawa aaune banaunus ra birami lai aaram garna dinus.
aankha ma kehi kira pasyo jasto

aankha nakanyaunus. sapha pani ko dhaaro le aankha bistarai pakhalnus, aankha jhimkaudai. mathi ko pareli lai tala ko pareli mathi tanera chhodda pani niklina sakchha. niskiyena, dukhai ki dhamilo bhaye aankha ko doctor dekhaunus.
haat ma kanda bijhyo

haat sabun pani le dhunus. sapha chimta le kanda ko bahira ko tuppo samatera jun disha bata pasyo ulto disha ma tannus. pachhi antiseptic lagaunus. kanda bhitra gahiro chha, niskidaina ki rato sunniyo bhane health post jaanus.
bachcha lai chiso le kaan dukhchha

jado ma bahira jaanda kaan chhopne topi lagaunus. kaan ma tel ki kunai chij nahalnus. kaan bata pip, jworo ki dukhai badhe doctor dekhaunus. bachcha le kaan bar bar chhunchha ki runchha bhane pani jaanch garaunus.
raati khutta chiso hunchha, nidra lagdaina

sutnu agadi manta pani ma khutta 10 minet dubaunus ani sukha puchhera moja lagaunus. ochhyan ma taato pani ko bottle rakhna sakinchha, tara chhala sidhai nachhoos. din bhari alikati hidnus, ragat sanchar ramro hunchha. sadhai chiso, sunnine ki rang badline bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
bachcha ko nang kati chhito katne?

bachcha ko nang hapta ma 1-2 palta katne, khutta ko ali kam. bachcha sutda ki nuhaye pachhi nang naram hunda katna sajilo hunchha. bachcha ko lagi banako sano nail cutter prayog garnus. nang ko chheu ma rato ra sujan bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
ma 50 barsha pugen, kun kun swasthya jaanch garaunu parchha?

dherai jaso le pressure, sugar, cholesterol, aankha ra daat ko jaanch niyamit garaunu ramro maninchha. mahila le stan ra paathegha ko jaanch ko barema pani doctor sanga sodhnus. barsha ma ek palta general check-up garaunus. kun jaanch kahile bhanne afno doctor sanga yojana banaunus.
ma dherai lajja manne, sabai le majak garchhan

lajja manne swabhab pani ramro guna ho, tara majak le dukhaunchha bhane spasta bhannus: "yo majak malai man pardaina." afu jasto ruchi bhayeka sathi khojnus. sano lakshya rakhnus, jastai din ma ek jana sanga naya kura garne. bistarai bharosa badhchha.
sabai kura ma "sorry" bhanchhu, baani chhodna man chha

galti nabhayeko kura ma sorry ko satta "dhanyabad" bhanne abhyas garnus, jastai "parkhanu bhayo, dhanyabad". bolnu agadi 2 second sochnus: "yo mero galti ho?" afno kura bhanna ra madat magna pani adhikar ho, maaf magnu pardaina.
kasai le kehi bhanda turuntai runa aauchha

bhawuk hunu kamjori haina, sambedanshil hunu ho. runa man lagda gahiro saas linus ra pani piunus. turuntai jawaf dina pardaina, "ek chhin sochera bhanchhu" bhanna sakinchha. bar bar dherai dukhi hune bhaye bharosa ko manchhe ki counsellor sanga kura garnus.
dherai manchhe ko agadi khana khana lajja lagchha

suru ma chineko sathi sanga khanus, bistarai sajilo hunchha. afno thal ma dhyan dinus, sabai le afnai khana ma dhyan dinchhan, tapai lai hereko hudaina. sano gaas linus ra bistarai khanus. yo dar dherai jana lai hunchha.
sathi le sadhai paisa tirna mero palo bhanchha

suru mai "aaja afno afno tirau" bhanne niyam bhannus. bill aauda shanta bhayera bhannus: "hijo maile tireko thiyo, aaja timi tira hai." bar bar yestai bhaye sangai bahira jaane kam garnus. spasta kura le mitrata bigrindaina.
bihe ma bolaunu bhayena, aafantu le risayo

sakesamma chhito unlai bhetera ki phone garera imandar karan bhannus, jastai budget ki thau ko sima. maafi magnus ra pachhi ghar ma bolayera bhetna sakinchha. sambandha jogauna sano kadam nai kaafi hunchha.
chhora ko bihe ko lagi dulahi khojda k herne?

parivar ko pristhabhumi bhanda pani dubai ko swabhab, ruchi ra jiwan ko lakshya mile ki herna jaruri ho. chhora ra keti dubai ko ichchha ra sahamati sabai bhanda mahatwapurna ho. bhetera kura garne samaya dinus. dabab ma gareko bihe le pachhi samasya lyauna sakchha.
bihe pachhi pani padhai jaari rakhna chahanchhu

bihe agadi nai yo kura ghar ra jiwan sathi sanga spasta garnus. padhai ko samaya ra ghar ko kaam ko yojana sangai banaunus. jiwan sathi ko sahayog sabai bhanda thulo sahara ho. padhai le pura parivar lai faida hunchha bhanne kura bujhaunus.
bihe garna paisa chhaina, dabab chha

bihe thulo ra mahango hunu jaruri chhaina, sano ra sadharan bihe pani ramro hunchha. parivar sanga imandar bhayera budget ko kura garnus. sapat liyera thulo bhoj garnu bhanda pachhi ko jiwan ko lagi bachat ramro. dubai pariwar ko sahamati ma sano karyakram gari sakinchha.
sasu le mero khana ma sadhai khot lagaunu hunchha

unko salah ma ramro kura linus ra "tapai ko tarika siknu chahanchhu" bhannus, kahile kahi sangai pakaunus. sabai kura ma sahamat hunu pardaina, shanta bhayera afno tarika pani bhannus. shrimaan sanga yo kura garnus, tara jhagada banaunu bhanda samadhan ma dhyan dinus.
shrimaan le raksi khayera ris garchhan

unko ris ra raksi ko samaya ma bahas nagarnus, afno suraksha pahila. shanta bela ma kura garnus ra raksi ghataune ki chhodne sahayog ko barema bhannus. kut pit ki dhamki bhaye aafantu, prahari (100) ki mahila sahayog sanstha sanga turuntai sahayog magnus. tapai ra bachcha ko suraksha sabai bhanda mahatwapurna.
dai bhauju sanga basda jhagada hunchha

ghar ko kharcha ra kaam ko bhag spasta lekhit tay garnus, dherai jhagada yahi bata hunchha. sano kura ma sahanshil rahanus. thulo asahamati bhaye ghar ka thulo ko bichma basera kura garnus. sambhav bhaye chhuttai basnu pani sambandha jogaune bato hunasakchha.
budha buwa ko sampatti ko kagaj milaune

sabai jagga ra ghar ko lalpurja, naksa ra kar tireko rasid ek thau ma rakhnus. buwa ko ichchha anusar sabai santan sanga basera kura garnus. kanuni prakriya ko lagi wakil ra malpot karyalaya sanga salah linus. sabai kagaj ko photocopy ra scan surakshit rakhnus.
buwa ko mrityu pachhi k k kagaj milaunu parchha?

dukha ko bela kagaj ko kura garo hunchha, bistarai garnus. pahila wada karyalaya ma mrityu darta garnus. bank khata, sampatti, pension ra bima ko lagi tyo darta ko praman chahinchha. kun kaam pahila garne bhanne wada karyalaya ki jankaar sanga sodhnus.
pension ko paisa nikalna samasya

pension aaune bank ki karyalaya ma gayera parichaya patra ra pension patra dekhaunus. jiwit praman (life certificate) jasta kagaj niyamit bujhaunu parne hunasakchha, sodhnus. budhabudhi lai sahayog garna parivar ko sadasya sangai jaanus.
buwa lai budhyauli ma eklo lagchha, k garne?

unlai sano jimmewari dinus, jastai bagaincha herne ki nati natini lai katha sunaune. tole ka budhabudhi ko samuha ma judna sahayog garnus. hapta ma kehi samaya unko sath ma ghumne ki chiya khane garnus. unko anubhav ra salah sodhnus, unlai mahatwapurna mahsus hunchha.
bidesh bata farkera gaun ma k garne?

tapai le bidesh ma sikeko sip, jastai mistri, khana pakaune ki machine chalaune, ko prayog garna sakinchha. bachat ko thorai bhag le sano byabasaya suru garnus, sabai lagani ek palta nagarnus. krishi, pashupalan ki sewa ko kaam ko barema sthaniya palika ko yojana bujhnus.
barsha ma pahiro jaane thau ma ghar chha

barsha suru hunu agadi ghar mathi ko jamin ma chira paryo ki, rukh dhalkiyo ki hernus. pani bagne nali sapha rakhnus. lagatar pani parda ra jamin bata awaj aaye surakshit thau ma sarnus. sthaniya palika ra chhimeki sanga aakasmik yojana banaunus.
baadhi aaune dar, terai ma ghar

mahatwapurna kagaj ra aushadhi plastic ma bandera uchai ma rakhnus. aakasmik jhola tayar rakhnus: torch, pani, khaja ra phone charger. khola ko pani badhdai gaye prashasan ko suchana sunnus ra chhito surakshit thau jaanus. baadhi ko pani ma hidera ki gadi chalayera tarnu khatarnak hunchha.
bijuli chamkida bahira chhu, k garne?

khulla chaur, rukh muni ra pani najik nabasnus. sakesamma pakki ghar ki gadi bhitra pasnus. ghar bhitra bijuli ko saman ko plug nikalnus ra dhara ko pani prayog kehi bera nagarnus. chatyang parda phone ma lamo kura nagarnus.
hiundo ma pahad ma bato chiplo, kasari jaane?

ramro talo bhayeko jutta lagaunus ra bistarai sano paila ma hidnus. bihana sabere hiu ki tusaro jameko bela bato ma nahidnus. lauro prayog garnus. gadi chalaunu parda bistarai ra brake bistarai lagaunus.
ghar ma pani ko tanki safa kasari garne?

tanki khali garera bhitra ko maila bahira nikalnus. sapha brush ra pani le dhunus, ani chlorine ki bleach ko halka ghol le dhoyera ramrari pakhalnus. sukaera matra pani bharnus. barsha ma kamti 2 palta safa garnus ra dhakkan sadhai chhopnus.
kitchen ko chimney ma tel jamyo

chimney ko filter nikalera taato pani ra sabun ma 30 minet bhijaunus. naram brush le ragadera pakhalnus ra sukaunus. mahina ma ek palta safa garda tel jamdaina. bijuli ko bhag ma pani napasos bhanera plug nikalera matra safa garnus.
kapada bata daag kasari hataune?

daag lagne bittikai chiso pani le pakhalnus, taato pani le kehi daag pakka banauchha. tel ko daag ma sabun ki dish wash ragadera kehi bera rakhnus. chiya ko daag ma kagati ra nun prayog garna sakinchha. mahango kapada bhaye dry clean ma dinus.
jutta bata gandha aauchha

jutta ghaam ma sukaunus ra bhitra alikati baking soda chharkera raati bhari rakhnus, bihana jhatkaunus. din din moja fernus. 2 jodi jutta palo palo lagaunus. jutta dhuna milne bhaye mahina ma ek palta dhunus.
ghar ko bhitta ma bachcha le kalam le lekhyo
