Talk regularly, but focus on quality more than hours. Share small daily things, plan visits when you can, and be honest about worries. Trust and clear communication matter most.
my child won't eat vegetables. what can I do?

Offer small amounts often without pressure, and eat vegetables yourself in front of them. Mix vegetables into foods they like, such as momo filling, fried rice or paratha. Let them help wash or choose vegetables, which makes them more curious to try.
how much screen time is ok for kids?

Many experts suggest little or no screen time for children under 2, and about 1 hour a day of good content for ages 2 to 5. For older children, set clear limits and make sure screens don't replace sleep, play and homework.
how can I help my child with homework without doing it for them?

Sit nearby and ask guiding questions like "What do you think comes next?" instead of giving answers. Help them plan the work in small parts, and praise effort. Let them make mistakes and correct them together.
how can I take care of my elderly grandparents?

Make sure they take their medicines on time and get regular health check-ups. Keep floors dry and well lit to prevent falls, and spend time talking with them every day. Small things like eating together mean a lot.
what vaccines does a pet dog need?
Dogs usually need vaccines against rabies and common diseases like distemper and parvovirus. A vet can give you the right schedule; rabies vaccination is especially important in Nepal.
what should I pack for a trek in Nepal?

Pack warm layers (thermal, fleece, down jacket), a rain jacket, good walking shoes, a hat, gloves and sunglasses. Bring water purification tablets, a small first aid kit, sunscreen, snacks and a headlamp. Keep your bag light.
lovely weather today, isn't it?
It sounds lovely! A nice day is perfect for a walk or some time outside. Do you have any plans?
what's your favourite food?
I don't eat, but I know many people love momo and dal bhat! What's your favourite?
I love playing football
That's great! Football is fun and keeps you fit. What position do you usually play?
I'm going to Pokhara next week!
How exciting! You could go boating on Phewa Lake, watch the sunrise from Sarangkot, and visit the World Peace Pagoda. Are you going for holiday or work?
I feel stressed at work
I'm sorry it's been stressful. Try to take short breaks, list your tasks in order of importance, and talk to your manager if the workload is too much. What is stressing you most right now?
can you recommend a good book?

It depends on what you like! For Nepali literature, "Muna Madan" by Laxmi Prasad Devkota is a classic. For English readers, "The Alchemist" by Paulo Coelho is short and easy to read. What kind of books do you enjoy?
"ASAP" ko meaning k ho?
"ASAP" ko full form "as soon as possible" ho, arthat sakesamma chhito. jastai: "Call me ASAP" bhaneko sakesamma chhito phone garnus.
e.g. ra i.e. ko farak bhana
"e.g." ko arth "udaharan ko lagi" ho: "fruits, e.g. apple". "i.e." ko arth "arthat" ho, jasle thik ke bhaneko bhanera spashta garchha: "the capital, i.e. Kathmandu".
palindrome bhaneko k ho?
"palindrome" bhaneko ulto ra sulto dubai tira bata padhda ustai hune shabda ya sankhya ho, jastai "madam", "level" ra 121.
RSVP ko arth k ho?
"RSVP" bhaneko "kripaya jawaf dinus" ho. nimto patra ma yo lekhieko chha bhane aaunu hunchha ki hudaina bhanera jaankari dinu parchha.
OTP bhaneko k ho? bank le pathayo
"OTP" bhaneko "One-Time Password", arthat ek choti matra chalne code ho. yo code kasailai pani nabhannus, bank ko manchhe bhanne lai pani.
GDP bhaneko k ho simple ma
"GDP" bhaneko desh ma ek barsa ma utpadan bhayeka sabai saman ra sewa ko jamma mulya ho. yasle desh ko arthatantra kati thulo chha bhanne dekhauchha.
NGO ko full form?
"NGO" ko full form "Non-Governmental Organization" ho, arthat gaira sarkari sanstha.
"FYI" ko arth?
"FYI" bhaneko "for your information", arthat "tapai ko jaankari ko lagi" ho.
"etc." kahile lekhne?
"etc." suchi ko antma "ra yasto aru" bhanne arth ma lekhinchha. jastai: "pen, pencil, eraser, etc."
BMI kasari nikalne?
"BMI" nikalna tauil (kg) lai uchai (meter) ko varga le bhag garnus. jastai 1.6 meter ko manchhe ko 1.6 x 1.6 = 2.56 hunchha, ani tauil lai 2.56 le bhag garne.
what's a synonym for "important"?
Synonyms for "important" include significant, essential, major and vital.
another word for "help"
Other words for "help" are assist, support and aid.
synonym of "difficult"?
Synonyms of "difficult" are hard, tough and challenging.
give me a word that means "very happy"
Words meaning "very happy" include delighted, overjoyed, thrilled and ecstatic.
what is a word for "very tired"?
"Exhausted" means very tired. "Worn out" is a more casual way to say it.
what's a word for a very big fear?
"Terror" or "dread" means a very great fear. A "phobia" is a strong, lasting fear of something specific, like heights.
what does "phobia" mean?
A phobia is a strong, often unreasonable fear of something, like spiders, heights or closed spaces.
what is the word for fear of heights?
The fear of heights is called acrophobia.
what is the opposite of "always"?
The opposite of "always" is "never".
opposite of "strong"
The opposite of "strong" is "weak".
what's the opposite of "success"?
The opposite of "success" is "failure".
opposite of "remember"
The opposite of "remember" is "forget".
what is the opposite of "push"?
The opposite of "push" is "pull".
opposite of "borrow"?
The opposite of "borrow" is "lend".
what does "deadline" mean in office?
A deadline is the latest time or date by which work must be finished. Example: "The report deadline is 5 p.m. Friday."
what does "overtime" mean
Overtime is work done beyond your normal working hours, and it is often paid at a higher rate.
what is a salary slip?
A salary slip (pay slip) is a document from your employer that shows your pay for a month, including any deductions like tax or provident fund.
what does "resign" mean?
To resign means to officially leave your job by your own choice. A resignation letter tells your employer the date you will leave.
what is a promotion at work
A promotion is when you are moved to a higher position at work, usually with more responsibility and more pay.
what's an internship
An internship is a short period of work, often for students or new graduates, to gain experience in a field. It may be paid or unpaid.
What is the difference between a resume and a CV?
In many countries they mean the same. Where they differ, a resume is a short 1 to 2 page summary for a job, and a CV is longer and lists your full academic and work history.
how many players are in a football team?
A football (soccer) team has 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper.
How many players in a cricket team?
A cricket team has 11 players on the field.
how many players in volleyball?
A volleyball team has 6 players on the court at a time. Volleyball is the national game of Nepal.
how often are the Olympic Games held?
The Summer Olympic Games are held every 4 years. The Winter Olympics are also held every 4 years, two years apart from the Summer Games.
how long is a football match?
A football match has two halves of 45 minutes each, so 90 minutes in total, plus extra time added for stoppages.
what is a marathon?
A marathon is a long-distance running race of 42.195 km (about 26.2 miles).
what does "abundant" mean?
"Abundant" means more than enough, in large amounts. Example: "Water is abundant in Nepal's rivers during the monsoon."
meaning of accurate
"Accurate" means correct and exact, without mistakes. Example: "Check that your answers are accurate."
What does "adapt" mean?
"Adapt" means to change so you fit a new situation. Example: "Students quickly adapt to a new school."
admire meaning
"Admire" means to respect and like someone or something very much. Example: "I admire my teacher's patience."
what does affordable mean
"Affordable" means cheap enough for people to buy. Example: "The shop sells affordable shoes."
What is the meaning of "annual"?
"Annual" means happening once every year. Example: "Our school holds an annual sports day."
approximate meaning?
"Approximate" means close to the real number but not exact. Example: "The approximate distance is 200 km."
what does artificial mean
"Artificial" means made by people, not natural. Example: "artificial flowers made of plastic".
meaning of attitude
"Attitude" means the way you think and feel about something, which shows in how you act. Example: "She has a positive attitude."
what does "aware" mean?
"Aware" means knowing or noticing something. Example: "Are you aware of the new rules?"
what is a benefit
A benefit is a good result or advantage you get from something. Example: "Exercise has many health benefits."
meaning of brief
"Brief" means short in time or words. Example: "Please give a brief answer."
capable meaning in english
"Capable" means having the skill or ability to do something. Example: "She is capable of leading the team."
what does cautious mean?
"Cautious" means careful to avoid danger or mistakes. Example: "Be cautious when crossing the road."
define challenge
A challenge is something difficult that tests your ability. Example: "Learning to drive was a challenge for me."
what is a citizen
A citizen is a person who legally belongs to a country and has its rights and duties. Example: "Every citizen should obey the law."
collapse meaning
"Collapse" means to fall down suddenly. Example: "Many old buildings collapsed in the earthquake."
what does "community" mean?
A community is a group of people living in the same area or sharing something in common. Example: "Our community cleaned the river together."
meaning of complex
"Complex" means having many parts, so it is hard to understand. Example: "The machine has a complex design."
what does confirm mean
"Confirm" means to say or show that something is true or definite. Example: "Please confirm your booking by phone."
consider meaning?
"Consider" means to think carefully about something. Example: "I will consider your idea."
what does constant mean
"Constant" means happening all the time or not changing. Example: "The constant noise kept me awake."
contribute meaning
"Contribute" means to give something, like money, time or ideas, to help. Example: "Everyone contributed to the festival."
What does convenient mean?
"Convenient" means easy, useful or suitable for you. Example: "The shop is convenient because it is near my house."
crucial meaning
"Crucial" means extremely important. Example: "Sleep is crucial before an exam."
what does decline mean?
"Decline" can mean to go down ("Sales declined this year") or to politely say no ("She declined the offer").
meaning of delicate
"Delicate" means easily damaged or needing gentle care. Example: "Flower petals are delicate."
what does "depend" mean
"Depend" means to need someone or something for support. Example: "Plants depend on sunlight." It is used with "on".
define destroy
"Destroy" means to damage something so badly that it cannot be used. Example: "The flood destroyed the bridge."
what does determine mean
"Determine" means to find out or decide something. Example: "The test will determine your level."
discover meaning?
"Discover" means to find something for the first time. Example: "Scientists discovered a new species of frog."
what does efficient mean
"Efficient" means working well without wasting time, money or energy. Example: "LED bulbs are more efficient than old bulbs."
meaning of encourage
"Encourage" means to give someone confidence or support to do something. Example: "My parents encourage me to study."
what does essential mean?
"Essential" means absolutely necessary. Example: "Water is essential for life."
estimate meaning
"Estimate" means to guess an amount or size carefully, without exact measuring. Example: "I estimate the trip will take 3 hours."
What is evidence?
Evidence is facts or signs that show something is true. Example: "The police found evidence at the scene."
familiar meaning
"Familiar" means well known to you. Example: "His face looks familiar."
what does flexible mean
"Flexible" means able to bend easily, or able to change plans easily. Example: "My work hours are flexible."
meaning of genuine
"Genuine" means real and true, not fake. Example: "This is a genuine leather bag." / "She showed genuine care."
what does gradual mean?
"Gradual" means happening slowly, step by step. Example: "There was a gradual change in the weather."
hazard meaning
A hazard is something that can cause danger or harm. Example: "Wet floors are a hazard."
what does identical mean
"Identical" means exactly the same. Example: "The twins wore identical shirts."
ignore meaning?
"Ignore" means to pay no attention to something or someone on purpose. Example: "Don't ignore the warning signs."
what is an impact?
An impact is a strong effect or influence, or the force of one thing hitting another. Example: "Social media has a big impact on young people."
meaning of independent
"Independent" means not controlled by or depending on others. Example: "She became independent after getting a job."
what does inevitable mean
"Inevitable" means certain to happen and impossible to avoid. Example: "Change is inevitable."
influence meaning
"Influence" means the power to affect how someone thinks or acts. Example: "Friends have a strong influence on teenagers."
what does initial mean?
"Initial" means at the beginning, first. Example: "My initial plan was to go by bus." Also, your initials are the first letters of your names.
inspire meaning
"Inspire" means to fill someone with the wish or idea to do something good. Example: "Her story inspired me to work harder."
what does intense mean
"Intense" means very strong or extreme. Example: "The heat in the terai can be intense in Jestha."
meaning of maintain
"Maintain" means to keep something in good condition or at the same level. Example: "Maintain your bike to keep it safe."
major and minor meaning
"Major" means big or important; "minor" means small or less important. Example: "a major problem" vs "a minor injury".
what does modify mean?
"Modify" means to change something slightly to improve it. Example: "We modified the plan after the rain."
motivate meaning
"Motivate" means to give someone a reason or energy to do something. Example: "Good marks motivate me to study more."
what does neglect mean
"Neglect" means to not give enough care or attention. Example: "Don't neglect your health."
numerous meaning
"Numerous" means very many. Example: "Nepal has numerous rivers and lakes."
what does obtain mean?
"Obtain" means to get something, often with effort. Example: "You must obtain a permit for the trek."
meaning of occur
"Occur" means to happen. Example: "Earthquakes occur often in the Himalayan region."
what does ordinary mean
"Ordinary" means normal, not special. Example: "It was an ordinary day."
participate meaning?
"Participate" means to take part in an activity. Example: "All students participated in the quiz."
What does "permanent" mean?
"Permanent" means lasting forever or for a very long time. Example: "a permanent job".
what does precise mean
"Precise" means very exact and careful. Example: "Give me the precise time."
meaning of predict
"Predict" means to say what will happen in the future. Example: "It is hard to predict the weather a month ahead."
prevent meaning
"Prevent" means to stop something from happening. Example: "Washing hands helps prevent illness."
what does previous mean?
"Previous" means coming before, earlier. Example: "I met him the previous day."
what is a priority
A priority is something more important than other things. Example: "My family is my first priority."
prohibit meaning
"Prohibit" means to officially not allow something. Example: "Smoking is prohibited in public places."
what does rapid mean
"Rapid" means very fast. Example: "There has been rapid growth in the city."
meaning of recover
"Recover" means to get well again or to get something back. Example: "He recovered from the flu in a week."
what does relevant mean?
"Relevant" means connected to what is being discussed. Example: "Please ask relevant questions."
rely meaning
"Rely" means to trust or depend on someone or something. Example: "You can rely on me." It is used with "on".
what does remote mean
"Remote" means far away from towns and people. Example: "Humla is a remote district."
require meaning
"Require" means to need. Example: "This job requires computer skills."
what is a resource
A resource is something useful that people can use, like water, forests, money or skills. Example: "Water is Nepal's biggest natural resource."
reveal meaning?
"Reveal" means to show or tell something that was hidden or secret. Example: "The results will be revealed tomorrow."
rural vs urban
"Rural" means about the countryside and villages; "urban" means about cities and towns. Example: "Many people move from rural areas to urban areas for work."
what does scarce mean
"Scarce" means not enough, hard to find. Example: "Water becomes scarce in the dry season."
meaning of significant
"Significant" means important or large enough to be noticed. Example: "There was a significant improvement in her marks."
what does similar mean?
"Similar" means almost the same, but not exactly. Example: "Our bags are similar in colour."
strategy meaning
A strategy is a careful plan to reach a goal. Example: "We need a good strategy to win the match."
what does sufficient mean
"Sufficient" means enough. Example: "Is the food sufficient for 10 people?"
survive meaning
"Survive" means to continue to live, especially after danger. Example: "Camels can survive many days without water."
what is a tradition
A tradition is a custom or belief passed down from older people to younger ones. Example: "Receiving tika from elders in Dashain is a tradition."
transform meaning?
"Transform" means to change completely. Example: "A caterpillar transforms into a butterfly."
what does unique mean
"Unique" means the only one of its kind. Example: "Nepal's flag is unique because it is not rectangular."
meaning of vary
"Vary" means to be different or to change. Example: "Prices vary from shop to shop."
what does vital mean
"Vital" means absolutely necessary or very important. Example: "Oxygen is vital for life."
what is wealth
Wealth means a large amount of money, property or valuable things. Example: "Health is more important than wealth."
what does "brave" mean
"Brave" means ready to face danger or pain without showing fear. Example: "The brave firefighter saved the child."
meaning of "calm"
"Calm" means peaceful and not worried or excited. Example: "Stay calm during an earthquake."
what does "careless" mean?
"Careless" means not paying enough attention, so mistakes happen. Example: "A careless driver can cause accidents."
"cheerful" meaning
"Cheerful" means happy and positive. Example: "She is always cheerful in the morning."
what does "clumsy" mean
"Clumsy" means moving in an awkward way, often dropping or hitting things. Example: "I'm so clumsy, I broke another cup."
meaning of "courage"
"Courage" means the ability to do something difficult or frightening. Example: "It takes courage to speak the truth."
what does "cruel" mean?
"Cruel" means causing pain or suffering to others on purpose. Example: "It is cruel to hit animals."
"eager" vs "anxious"
"Eager" means excited and wanting to do something. "Anxious" means worried. Example: "I'm eager to start my new job, but a little anxious too."
what does "fierce" mean
"Fierce" means strong, aggressive or very intense. Example: "a fierce tiger", "fierce competition".
"gentle" meaning?
"Gentle" means kind, calm and soft, not rough. Example: "Be gentle with the baby."
what does "greedy" mean
"Greedy" means wanting more than you need, especially food or money. Example: "The greedy man never shared his food."
meaning of "humble"?
"Humble" means not proud, not thinking you are better than others. Example: "Despite his success, he stayed humble."
what does "loyal" mean
"Loyal" means always supporting and staying true to someone. Example: "Dogs are loyal to their owners."
what does "mature" mean?
"Mature" means fully grown, or behaving in a sensible adult way. Example: "She is very mature for her age."
"modest" meaning
"Modest" means not talking proudly about your own abilities, or not large. Example: "He is modest about his success." / "a modest house".
what does "patient" mean as an adjective?
As an adjective, "patient" means able to wait calmly without getting angry. As a noun, a patient is a person getting medical care.
meaning of "polite"
"Polite" means having good manners and respect for others. Example: "It is polite to say thank you."
what does "rude" mean
"Rude" means not polite, showing no respect. Example: "It's rude to interrupt someone."
"selfish" meaning?
"Selfish" means caring only about yourself and not about others. Example: "Don't be selfish, share your toys."
what does "shy" mean
"Shy" means nervous or uncomfortable around other people, especially new people. Example: "He was too shy to sing on stage."
what does "stubborn" mean?
"Stubborn" means not willing to change your opinion or plan. Example: "My little brother is stubborn about bedtime."
"talented" meaning
"Talented" means having a natural ability to do something well. Example: "She is a talented painter."
what does "thoughtful" mean
"Thoughtful" means kind and caring about others' needs, or thinking deeply. Example: "It was thoughtful of you to bring tea."
meaning of "trustworthy"
"Trustworthy" means someone you can trust to be honest and do the right thing.
what does "wise" mean?
"Wise" means having good judgement from knowledge and experience. Example: "My grandfather gives wise advice."
"abundant" ko meaning nepali ma
"abundant" bhaneko prasasta ya dherai matra ma bhayeko. jastai: "Fruits are abundant in summer" bhaneko garmi ma phalphul prasasta hunchha.
"accurate" bhaneko k ho?
"accurate" bhaneko thik ra sahi, galti nabhayeko. jastai: "an accurate answer" bhaneko sahi uttar.
"affordable" ko matlab?
"affordable" bhaneko kinna sakine, arthat mahango nabhayeko. jastai: "affordable price" bhaneko kinna sakine mulya.
"convenient" ko nepali arth
"convenient" bhaneko suvidhajanak ya sajilo. jastai: "The bus is convenient for me" bhaneko bus mero lagi suvidhajanak chha.
"crucial" bhaneko?
"crucial" bhaneko atyanta mahatwapurna. jastai: "This exam is crucial" bhaneko yo pariksha dherai mahatwapurna chha.
"encourage" ko arth k?
"encourage" bhaneko protsahan dinu ya hausala badhaunu ho. jastai: "My teacher encourages me" bhaneko mero shikshak le malai hausala dinuhunchha.
"essential" bhaneko k ho?
"essential" bhaneko anivarya, nabhai nahune. jastai: "Water is essential" bhaneko pani nabhai hudaina.
"genuine" ko meaning bhanidinus
"genuine" bhaneko sakkali, nakkali nabhayeko. jastai: "genuine gold" bhaneko sakkali sun.
"ignore" ko nepali?
"ignore" bhaneko bewasta garnu ya dhyan nadinu ho. jastai: "Don't ignore your health" bhaneko aafno swasthya ko bewasta nagara.
"inevitable" bhaneko k?
"inevitable" bhaneko tarna nasakine, hunai parne. jastai: "Change is inevitable" bhaneko parivartan tarna sakidaina.
"maintain" ko arth?
"maintain" bhaneko kunai kura lai ramro awastha ma rakhirakhnu ya kayam rakhnu ho. jastai: "maintain good health" bhaneko ramro swasthya kayam rakhnu.
"neglect" bhaneko k ho nepali ma
"neglect" bhaneko hela garnu ya chahine jati dhyan nadinu ho. jastai: "Don't neglect your studies."
"prevent" ko matlab bhana
"prevent" bhaneko rokthaam garnu, hunu agadi nai roknu ho. jastai: "Vaccines prevent diseases" bhaneko khop le rog rokchha.
"priority" ko meaning?
"priority" bhaneko praathamikta, arthat sabai bhanda pahila garnu parne mahatwapurna kura. jastai: "Safety is our priority."
"remote" bhaneko k ho?
"remote" bhaneko durgam ya tadha ko thau. jastai: "a remote village" bhaneko durgam gaun. TV ko "remote" bhaneko tadha bata chalaune yantra ho.
rural ra urban ko farak
"rural" bhaneko gramin (gaun sanga sambandhit) ra "urban" bhaneko sahari (sahar sanga sambandhit) ho.
"scarce" ko arth k hunchha?
"scarce" bhaneko durlabh ya abhav bhayeko, chahine jati napaine. jastai: "Water is scarce in the dry season."
"tradition" lai nepali ma k bhanchha?
"tradition" lai nepali ma parampara bhaninchha. jastai dashain ma tika lagaune parampara.
"unique" ko meaning nepali ma
"unique" bhaneko anautho, arthat tyasto arko nabhayeko. jastai: "Nepal's flag is unique."
"wise" bhaneko k?
"wise" bhaneko buddhiman ra anubhavi, ramro salah dina sakne. jastai: "a wise old man".
"loyal" ko arth
"loyal" bhaneko bafadar ya imandar sathi jasto sadhai saath dine. jastai: "Dogs are loyal animals."
"stubborn" bhaneko k ho?
"stubborn" bhaneko jiddi, aafno kura nachhodne. jastai: "He is very stubborn."
"clumsy" ko matlab
"clumsy" bhaneko lathra-lathro garne, sajilai chij khasaune ya thokkine. jastai: "I'm clumsy, I dropped my phone again."
"thoughtful" ko nepali arth bhana na
"thoughtful" bhaneko arko ko khyal garne, bichar puryaune. jastai: "Thank you, that was very thoughtful of you."
"courage" bhaneko k ho?
"courage" bhaneko sahas ho, darlagdo ya garo kaam garna sakne himmat. jastai: "It takes courage to say sorry."
use "although" and "however" in examples

"Although it was late, we kept working." / "It was late. However, we kept working." "Although" joins two parts in one sentence, while "however" usually starts a new sentence and is followed by a comma.
what is the difference between "therefore" and "because"?
"Because" gives the reason: "I stayed home because I was sick." "Therefore" gives the result: "I was sick; therefore, I stayed home."
words to use instead of "very good"
You can say excellent, great, wonderful, outstanding or superb, depending on how strong you want it to be.
better word for "very bad"?
Try terrible, awful, horrible or dreadful.
what's a better word for "very big"
You can use huge, enormous, giant, massive or vast.
another way to say "very small"
You can say tiny, minute (my-NYOOT), little or miniature.
a stronger word for "very hungry"?
"Starving" or "famished" means very hungry.
better word for "very cold"
"Freezing" or "icy" means very cold.
what word means "very hot"?
"Boiling", "scorching" or "sweltering" can mean very hot, for example "a scorching summer day".
what's a word for "very scared"?
"Terrified" means very scared.
what is a word for "very angry"
"Furious" means very angry.
what's a word for "very clean"?
"Spotless" means very clean, with no dirt at all.
what is a word for "very fast"?
"Rapid" or "speedy" means very fast. You can also say "lightning fast".
better word for "very tired"
"Exhausted" means very tired.
Sita bought 3 notebooks at 45 rupees each and a pen for 20 rupees. How much did she spend?
Sita spent 155 rupees.
A farmer has 240 kg of rice and sells 3/8 of it. How much rice is left?
The farmer has 150 kg of rice left.
A bus leaves Kathmandu at 7:30 am and reaches Pokhara at 2:00 pm. How long is the journey?
The journey takes 6 hours and 30 minutes.

Hari is 23 years old.
The sum of two numbers is 50. One of them is 18. What is the other?
The other number is 32.
A rectangle has an area of 72 square meters and a length of 9 m. What is its width?
The width is 8 meters.
5 kg of potatoes cost 275 rupees. How much do 8 kg cost?
8 kg of potatoes cost 440 rupees.
A shopkeeper buys a bag for 1200 rupees and sells it at 25% profit. What is the selling price?
The selling price is 1500 rupees.
A school has 480 students and 45% are girls. How many boys are there?
There are 264 boys.
A car uses 8 liters of petrol per 100 km. How much petrol for 350 km?

What is the simple interest on 25000 rupees at 8% per year for 3 years?

A tap fills a tank at 20 liters per minute. How long to fill a 1000-liter tank?
It takes 50 minutes to fill the tank.
Ram walks 2.5 km to school and back home every school day. How far does he walk in 6 days?
Ram walks 30 km in 6 days.

messages.content: A rope 15 m long is cut into pieces of 75 cm. How many pieces?
You get 20 pieces.
The average of 5 numbers is 24. What is their sum?
The sum of the 5 numbers is 120.
6 workers finish a job in 10 days. How long would 4 workers take, working at the same speed?
4 workers would take 15 days.
What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3:00?
At 3:00 the angle between the hands is 90 degrees.
messages.think: each hour mark is 360 / 12 = 30 degrees apart. 3 x 30 = 90.

messages.content: The price of milk went up from 80 to 100 rupees per liter. What is the percent increase?
The price increased by 25%.
In a class of 35, two-fifths are boys. How many girls are there?
There are 21 girls.
A train goes at 90 km/h for 2 hours 20 minutes. How far does it travel?

messages.content: A phone costs 15000 rupees. There is a 10% discount, then 13% VAT on the new price. What is the final price?
The final price is 15255 rupees.
Laxmi saves 250 rupees every week. How many weeks to save 4000 rupees?
She needs 16 weeks.
A cake is cut into 12 equal pieces and 5 are eaten. What fraction is left?
7/12 of the cake is left.
Kabita read 30 pages on Monday, 45 on Tuesday and 25 on Wednesday. How many pages in total?

A tea packet has 250 g. How many packets make 2 kg?
8 packets make 2 kg.
At night it was -4 degrees and in the day it was 11 degrees. What is the difference?
The difference is 15 degrees.

messages.content: A square garden has a perimeter of 64 m. What is the length of one side, and the area?
Each side is 16 m, and the area is 256 square meters.
3 pencils and 2 erasers cost 50 rupees. A pencil costs 10 rupees. How much is one eraser?
One eraser costs 10 rupees.
Bimala earns 18000 a month and spends 13500. What percent does she save?
She saves 25% of her income.
How many seconds are there in 2.5 minutes?
There are 150 seconds in 2.5 minutes.
How many kattha are in 2 bigha?
2 bigha is 40 kattha.
Write 1 ropani 8 aana in aana only.
1 ropani 8 aana is 24 aana.
A cyclist rides 18 km in 45 minutes. What is the speed in km per hour?
The speed is 24 km per hour.
messages.think: 45 minutes is 3 parts of 15 minutes, so in 15 minutes: 18 / 3 = 6 km. 60 minutes is 4 parts: 4 x 6 = 24.

messages.content: A father is 40 and his son is 10. In how many years will the father be twice as old as the son?
In 20 years, when the father is 60 and the son is 30.
messages.think: try 20 years: father 40 + 20 = 60, son 10 + 20 = 30, and 2 x 30 = 60. it works.

messages.content: A shop gives 2 free packets for every 10 you buy. If I buy 30, how many packets do I get?
You get 36 packets (30 bought + 6 free).

messages.content: A shop is open from 9 am to 6 pm, 6 days a week. How many hours is it open each week?

messages.content: For Dashain I bought 3 kurtas at 1200 rupees each and 2 pairs of shoes at 1800 each. Total?
You spent 7200 rupees in total.
A dozen bananas cost 120 rupees. How much do 30 bananas cost?

We used 3/4 of a 2 liter bottle of milk. How many ml are left?
500 ml of milk is left.
A bus ticket costs 650 rupees. A group of 7 gets a 10% discount. What do they pay?

100 sweets are shared equally among 8 children. How many does each get and how many are left?
Each child gets 12 sweets, and 4 sweets are left over.
A book has 320 pages. I have read 40% of it. How many pages are left?
192 pages are left.
A tank that is 3/5 full holds 300 liters. What is its full capacity?

On a map, 1 cm = 2 km. Two villages are 4.5 cm apart on the map. What is the real distance?

A worker is paid 1200 rupees a day. He works 22 days and gets a 2000 rupee bonus. Total pay?

A plant is 10 cm tall and grows 1.5 cm every week. How tall after 8 weeks?

3 bulbs of 10 watts each are on for 6 hours a day. How many units in 30 days?

messages.content: One bus leaves every 12 minutes and another every 18 minutes. They leave together at 8:00. When will they next leave together?
They will leave together again after 36 minutes, at 8:36.
messages.think: LCM of 12 and 18: multiples of 18 are 18, 36. 36 / 12 = 3, so 36 is the LCM.

messages.content: I have 24 apples and 36 oranges. What is the largest number of baskets I can make so each basket has the same mix?
You can make 12 baskets, each with 2 apples and 3 oranges.
messages.think: HCF of 24 and 36: 12 divides both (24 / 12 = 2, 36 / 12 = 3), and no larger number does.

messages.content: 15% of 60 students were absent. How many were present?
51 students were present.
Cement and sand are mixed in the ratio 1:4. For 25 bags in total, how many bags of each?
Use 5 bags of cement and 20 bags of sand.

messages.content: I bought a watch for 400 and sold it for 460. What was my profit percent?
Your profit was 15%.
Convert 145 minutes into hours and minutes.
145 minutes is 2 hours and 25 minutes.
If 1 January is a Monday, what day is 15 January?

messages.content: How many days are there from 10 May to 25 May, counting both days?
There are 16 days, counting both 10 May and 25 May.
I have 5 notes of 500 rupees and 7 notes of 100 rupees. How much money is that?

Your change is 375 rupees.
A taxi charges 100 rupees to start plus 40 rupees per km. What is the fare for 7 km?
The fare is 380 rupees.

messages.content: What is the perimeter of a triangle with sides 7 cm, 8 cm and 9 cm?

Using pi = 22/7, what is the circumference of a circle with radius 7 cm?

messages.content: A water tank is 2 m long, 1.5 m wide and 1 m deep. How many liters can it hold?
The tank holds 3000 liters.

messages.content: Interest is 1% per month. How much interest on 50000 rupees for 6 months?

How many kg are 12 bags of cement of 25 kg each? How many quintals is that?

The bus carries 700 students in 5 days.
A shirt is marked 1600 rupees and sold at 1200. What is the discount percent?
The discount is 25%.
If 8 pens cost 96 rupees, how many pens can I buy with 180 rupees?
You can buy 15 pens.
A runner runs 400 m laps. How many laps for 10 km?

messages.content: A box has 6 rows of 8 chocolates. 15 are eaten. How many are left?
33 chocolates are left.
A man buys 2.5 kg of meat at 700 rupees per kg. How much does he pay?

The bus fare is 45 rupees each way. How much for a person going to work and back for 26 days?

A cricket team scored 48, 63 and 75 runs in three matches. What is the average score?

A tree was planted 7 years ago when it was 1.2 m tall. Now it is 8.9 m. How much did it grow each year on average?
It grew 1.1 meters per year on average.
There are 4 shelves with 28 books each and I give away 19 books. How many books remain?
93 books remain.
If it is 11:40 now, what time will it be after 1 hour 35 minutes?
It will be 1:15.
What time was it 2 hours 50 minutes before 9:10?
It was 6:20.

messages.content: A wall needs 1500 bricks. 6 people each carry 125 bricks. How many more bricks are needed?
750 more bricks are needed.
Anita scored 18 out of 25 in a test. What is her percentage?
Anita scored 72%.
A shop sells juice at 60 rupees a glass. On Saturday it sold 85 glasses. How much money did it make?
The shop made 5100 rupees.
A family uses 15 liters of water per person per day. There are 5 people. How much in a week?

messages.content: What number is 3 more than twice 17?
The number is 37.

Which is more: 3/4 of 200 or 2/3 of 210?
3/4 of 200 (which is 150) is more than 2/3 of 210 (which is 140).
A bag of rice is 30 kg. A family eats 750 g a day. How many days will it last?
The rice will last 40 days.
What is 125% of 80?
A number is increased by 20% to become 360. What was the original number?
The original number was 300.
The ratio of red to blue balls is 2:7. There are 14 red balls. How many blue?
There are 49 blue balls.
7 notebooks cost 455 rupees. What is the cost of 1 notebook?
One notebook costs 65 rupees.
A man walks 5 km north, then 3 km south. How far is he from the start?
He is 2 km north of where he started (he walked 8 km in total).
what is the sum of all angles in a rectangle?
The angles of a rectangle add up to 360 degrees.
messages.think: a rectangle has 4 right angles. 4 x 90 = 360.

messages.content: Can you show me how to find 15% of a number quickly in my head?
Find 10% by moving the decimal one place left, then add half of that for 5%. For 15% of 260: 10% is 26, 5% is 13, so 15% is 26 + 13 = 39.
what's a quick way to multiply by 5?
Multiply by 10 and then halve the answer. For 5 x 48: 48 x 10 = 480, and half of 480 is 240.
easy trick to multiply by 11 for two-digit numbers
Add the two digits and put the sum in the middle. For 11 x 36: 3 + 6 = 9, so the answer is 396. If the sum is 10 or more, carry the 1: 11 x 57 = 627.
how do I check if my addition is right?
Subtract one number from the total and see if you get the other number. If 345 + 278 = 623, then 623 - 278 should be 345.

dang lumbini pradesh ma parchha. lumbini pradesh ko rajdhani deukhuri pani dang mai chha.

solukhumbu koshi pradesh ma parchha. sagarmatha ra namche bazar yahi jilla ma chhan.

kailali sudurpashchim pradesh ma parchha. pradesh ko rajdhani godawari pani kailali mai chha.

barpak kun jilla ma ho?

mechi dekhi mahakali bhaneko k ho?

nepal kun mahadesh ma parchha
nepal asia mahadesh ma parchha. yo dakshin asia ko desh ho.

nepal lai bhaugolik rup le 3 bhag ma baadinchha: himali, pahadi ra terai kshetra. uttar ma himal, bich ma pahad ra dakshin ma samthar terai chha.
terai lai annako bhandar kina bhanchhan?
terai ko jamin samthar ra urbar chha, tyasaile yaha nepal ko dherai dhan, gahu ra makai falchha. dherai anna utpadan hune bhayeko le yaslai annako bhandar bhaninchha.
kun bhag ma sabai bhanda dherai manchhe baschhan, himal, pahad ki terai?

nepal ko sabai bhanda dherai bhubhag kun kshetra le ogatchha?
nepal ko sabai bhanda dherai bhubhag pahadi kshetra le ogatchha. kathmandu ra pokhara jasta upatyaka pani pahadi kshetra mai parchhan.
himali kshetra kasto hunchha?

bhitri madhesh bhaneko k ho?
bhitri madhesh bhaneko chure ra mahabharat dada ko bich ma parne samthar upatyaka ho. chitwan, dang ra surkhet bhitri madhesh ka udaharan hun.

nepal ko rajdhani kathmandu ho. sarkar, sansad ra dherai thula karyalaya kathmandu mai chhan.

palpa ko dhaka k ho?
dhaka palpa tira haat le bunine rangin kapda ho. dhaka topi nepali poshak ko pahichan ho.

bhairahawa najik ko naka belahiya ho. pari pattiko bharat ko bazar sunauli ho.

machhapuchhre ko uchai kati ho?

saptagandaki ma kun kun nadi parchhan?

narayani nadi kaha baata banchha?

shaligram kun nadi ma paainchha?

pashupatinath kun nadi ko kinar ma chha?

arun nadi kina bishesh manninchha?

tamor nadi kun jilla bata bagchha?

seti nadi pokhara ma kasto dekhinchha?

trishuli nadi kun kaam ko lagi prasiddha chha?

marsyangdi nadi kaha bata bagchha?

budhi gandaki nadi kun himal najik bagchha?

bheri nadi kun nadi ma misinchha?

rapti nadi chitwan ma kaha bagchha?

kamala nadi kun thau tira bagchha?

kankai nadi kun jilla ma parchha?

nepal ka nadi haru kun disha tira bagchhan?
nepal ka dherai nadi uttar bata dakshin tira bagchhan. himal bata suru bhayera pahad ra terai hudai bharat pugchhan ra antma ganga ma misinchhan.
hiu bata pani paune nadi lai k bhanchhan?

chure bata suru hune nadi kasta hunchhan?

rara tal kati thulo chha?

gosaikunda rasuwa jilla ma, langtang rastriya nikunja bhitra chha. janai purnima ko din dherai bhakta yaha snan garna jaanchhan.
gosaikunda ko katha k ho?

himtal bhaneko k ho?

nepal ko pahilo ramsar kshetra kun ho?

annapurna sanrakshan kshetra kina bishesh chha?

krishnasar mriga kaha paainchha?

patale chhango kaha chha?

tatopani kina tato hunchha?

khumbu himnadi kaha chha?

himnadi bhaneko k ho?

hiu rekha bhaneko k ho?

devghat kaha parchha?

tribeni dham kaha chha?

nadi milne thau lai k bhanchhan?

kanchanjunga ko arth k ho?
kanchanjunga ko arth "hiu ka 5 khajana" bhanne bujhinchha. yasko 5 wata mukhya chuchura bhayeko le yo naam aayeko manninchha.
makalu himal kasto aakar ko chha?

manaslu ko arth k ho?

sabai bhanda aglo pradesh kun ho, matlab sagarmatha kun pradesh ma?

langtang kaha parchha?

dhaulagiri ra annapurna ko bich ma kun nadi bagchha?

what is the height of mount everest

Which is the longest river of Nepal?
The Karnali is the longest river in Nepal. It starts in Tibet, flows through western Nepal and becomes the Ghaghara in India.

Rara Lake in Mugu district is the biggest lake in Nepal. It lies at about 2990 meters inside Rara National Park.
which was the first national park of nepal?
Chitwan National Park was Nepal's first national park, set up in 1973. It is famous for one-horned rhinos and Bengal tigers.
who first climbed everest
Tenzing Norgay Sherpa and Edmund Hillary were the first to reach the top of Everest, on 29 May 1953.

nepal ma kati wata bishwa sampada chhan?

kathmandu upatyaka ka sampada ma k k parchhan?

pahad ma nadi kina chhito bagchhan?

pahiro kina jaanchha?

tal ra pokhari ma k farak chha?

sabai bhanda uchai ma bhayeko nepal ko nikunja kun?

hiun chituwa kaha baschha?
hiun chituwa himal ko chiso ra chattan bhayeko uchcha thau ma baschha. nepal ma yo dolpa, mustang, manang ra khumbu jasta himali kshetra ma paainchha.
habre kaha paainchha?
habre (red panda) nepal ko purbi ra madhya pahadi jangal ma, khas gari bans bhayeko chiso jangal ma paainchha. yasle dherai jaso bans ko paat khanchha.
jharal k ho?
jharal (himalayan tahr) himali bhiralo chattan ma basne jangali bakhra jasto janawar ho. yasko ruwa lamo ra baklo hunchha.
naur kasto janawar ho?
naur (blue sheep) himal ko uchcha ghaase maidan ma basne janawar ho. hiun chituwa ko mukhya shikar naur nai ho.
kasturi mriga kina shikar garinchha?
kasturi mriga ko bhale ko pet najik kasturi bhanne sugandhit padartha hunchha, jun mahango bikchha. tyasaile yasko gaira kanuni shikar hunchha, tara yo sanrakshit janawar ho.
salak kun janawar ho?
salak (pangolin) sharir bhari kada khata bhayeko, kamila ra dhamira khane janawar ho. dar laagda yo dalla jasto gol banchha.
barahsinga kaha dherai paainchha?
barahsinga (swamp deer) shuklaphanta rastriya nikunja ma sabai bhanda dherai paainchha. yasko singa ma dherai hanga hunchhan.
arna bhaneko k ho?
arna bhaneko jangali bhaisi ho. nepal ma arna mukhya rup ma koshi tappu wanyajantu arakshya ma paainchha.
what is the third highest mountain in the world?
Kanchenjunga is the third highest mountain in the world, at 8586 meters. It is on the border of Nepal and Sikkim, India.
How many of the 14 highest peaks are in Nepal?
8 of the 14 peaks over 8000 meters are in Nepal. They include Everest, Kanchenjunga, Lhotse and Makalu.
what is a glacier
A glacier is a huge mass of ice that moves very slowly over land. It forms where more snow falls each year than melts.
shey phoksundo tal ko pani kasto rang ko hunchha?
shey phoksundo tal ko pani gahiro niilo ra firoji (hariyo-niilo) rang ko dekhinchha. tal gahiro ra sapha bhayeko le yasto rang dekhinchha.
begnas tal kaha chha?
begnas tal pokhara upatyaka ko purbi bhag ma chha. phewa bhanda yo shanta chha ra machha palan pani hunchha.
nepal ma jwalamukhi chha?
chhaina, nepal ma kunai jwalamukhi chhaina. nepal ma bhukampa aauchha, tara jwalamukhi chhaina.
nepal ma kina bhukampa aaundachha?
nepal bharatiya ra eshiyali bhubhag ka plate milne thau ma parchha. yi plate thokkiyera tanab jamma hunchha ra achanak chhutda bhukampa aauchha.
2072 ko bhukampa kahile gayo?
2072 sal ko thulo bhukampa baisakh 12 gate (25 april 2015) ma gayo. yasko kendrabindu gorkha jilla ko barpak najik thiyo.
dharahara kasle banayeko ho?
purano dharahara bhimsen thapa le 1832 tira banayeka thiye. 2072 ko bhukampa ma yo dhalyo ra pachhi naya dharahara banaiyo.
hiundo ma himal ma kina dherai hiu parchha?
himal ma uchai dherai bhayeko le hawa ekdam chiso hunchha. badal ko pani chiso bhayera pani ko satta hiu ko rup ma khaschha.
uchai ma gayo bhane kina sas pherna garo hunchha?
uchai ma hawa patalo hunchha, tyasaile ek choti sas ferda kam oxygen bhitra pasdachha. bistarai uklera ra pani dherai piyera sharir lai bani basna dinu parchha.
lekali rog bhaneko k ho?
lekali rog bhaneko uchcha thau ma chhito uklada oxygen kam bhayera laagne bimari ho. tauko dukhne, wakwaki ra sas fulne yasko lakshan hun; ramro upachar bhaneko tala orlanu ho.
tarai ko jangal ma kun rukh dherai hunchha?
terai ra chure ko jangal ma sal (sakhuwa) ko rukh dherai hunchha. sal ko kath baliyo hune bhayeko le ghar banauna prayog garinchha.
lali gurans kahile ra kaha fulchha?
lali gurans basanta ritu ma, khas gari chaitra-baisakh tira pahad ra lekh ko jangal ma fulchha. tyo bela dada nai rato dekhinchha.
yarsagumba kaha paainchha?
yarsagumba himal ko uchcha ghaase maidan ma paainchha, jastai dolpa ra darchula. yo kira ra chyau milera baneko jadibuti ho ra mahango bikchha.
chitwan ma kun nadi haru bagchhan?
chitwan ma narayani ra purbi rapti mukhya nadi hun. rapti nikunja ko uttar ma ra narayani pashchim tira bagchha.
sagarmatha chadhna kun mahina ramro mauka hunchha?
sagarmatha chadhna sabai bhanda dherai manchhe may mahina ma prayas garchhan. monsoon suru hunu agadi hawa ali shanta hune chhoto samaya hunchha.
nepal ko sabai bhanda thulo sanrakshan kshetra kun?
nepal ko sabai bhanda thulo sanrakshan kshetra annapurna sanrakshan kshetra ho. yo kaski, lamjung, manang, mustang ra myagdi ma failiyeko chha.
pokhara ko kun dada bata sundar himal dekhinchha?
pokhara ko sarangkot dada bata annapurna, machhapuchhre ra dhaulagiri ko sundar drishya dekhinchha. bihana ghaam ulaeko herna dherai manchhe jaanchhan.
shanti stupa pokhara ma kaha chha?
pokhara ko shanti stupa phewa tal ko dakshin pattiko dada ma chha. tyaha bata tal, sahar ra himal sangai dekhinchhan.
kathmandu bata himal dekhine thau kun kun hun?
kathmandu najik nagarkot, chandragiri ra dhulikhel bata ramro himal dekhinchha. sapha mausam ma bihana sabai bhanda ramro drishya hunchha.
mount everest chadhna kati din lagchha?
sagarmatha chadhna sadharan tarika le lagbhag 6 dekhi 9 hapta lagchha. sharir lai uchai ma bani basauna base camp ra mathi ka camp ma bistarai aaudai jaanda samaya lagchha.
kun nadi ma rafting dherai garinchha?
nepal ma trishuli, bhote koshi, seti, sunkoshi ra karnali nadi ma rafting dherai garinchha. trishuli kathmandu ra pokhara dubai bata najik bhayeko le sabai bhanda lokpriya chha.
pani ghatta k ho?
pani ghatta bhaneko khola ko bagne pani le chalaune paramparik jaato ho. yasle makai, gahu ra kodo pisna maddat garchha.
nepal ma pahilo jalvidyut kendra kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo jalvidyut kendra pharping ho, jun 1911 ma baneko thiyo. yasko kshamata 500 kilowatt thiyo.
jalvidyut kasari banchha?
jalvidyut ma bagne pani le turbine ghumauchha ra turbine le generator ghumayera bijuli nikalchha. nepal ma dherai nadi bhayeko le dherai jaso bijuli yahi tarika le banchha.
mathillo tamakoshi jalvidyut ayojana kaha chha?
mathillo tamakoshi jalvidyut ayojana dolakha jilla ma chha. yasko kshamata 456 megawatt chha.
chure lai kina jogaunu parchha?
chure ko mato kamjor hunchha, rukh katiye bhane pahiro ra badhi badhchha. chure le terai ko jamin muni pani pani bharna maddat garchha, tyasaile yaslai jogaunu jaruri chha.
nepal ko rastriya phool kun ho?
nepal ko rastriya phool lali gurans ho. yo basanta ritu ma pahad ka jangal ma rato bhayera fulchha.
hamro rastriya charaa ko naam k ho?
nepal ko rastriya charaa danfe ho. bhale danfe ko pwankh niilo, hariyo ra rato jasta chamkila rang ka hunchhan.
rastriya janawar kun ho nepal ko?
nepal ko rastriya janawar gai ho. hindu dharma ma gai lai laxmi ko rup mani puja garinchha.
nepal ko rastriya rang k ho?
nepal ko rastriya rang simrik (crimson) ho. nepal ko jhanda ko rato bhag pani simrik rang ko hunchha.
nepal ko rastriya khel kun ho
nepal ko rastriya khel volleyball ho. sarkar le 2017 (2073 sal) ma volleyball lai rastriya khel ghoshana gareko ho.
nepal ko jhanda kasto chha?
nepal ko jhanda simrik rang ko duita tribhuj mathi-tala jodera baneko ho ra yasko kinar niilo chha. mathillo tribhuj ma chandrama ra tallo ma surya chha.
nepal ko jhanda ma k bishesh chha?
nepal ko jhanda sansar ko ekmatra charkune nabhayeko rastriya jhanda ho. yo duita tribhuj milayera baneko chha.
jhanda ma surya ra chandrama kina chha?
jhanda ko surya ra chandrama le nepal surya ra chandrama jasto lamo samaya samma rahos bhanne kamana janauchhan. chandrama le shanta swabhav ra surya le dridhata pani janauchha bhanne bhanai chha.
jhanda ko niilo kinar le k janauchha?
jhanda ko niilo kinar le shanti janauchha. simrik rang le nepali ko bahaduri ra rastriya rang janauchha.
hamro rastriya gaan kun ho?
nepal ko rastriya gaan "sayaun thunga phulka" ho. yo 2064 sal (2007) dekhi rastriya gaan ko rup ma gaine gariyeko chha.
rastriya gaan kasle lekheko?
rastriya gaan "sayaun thunga phulka" byakul maila le lekheka hun. unko wastabik naam pradeep kumar rai ho.
rastriya gaan ko sangeet kasle bhareka hun?
rastriya gaan ko sangeet ambar gurung le bhareka hun. uni nepal ka prasiddha sangeetkar thiye.
rastriya nishan ma k k chha?

nepal ko rastriya nishan ma sagarmatha, hariyo pahad, pahelo terai, nepal ko naksa ra mahila-purush le haat milayeko chitra chha. yasko waripari lali gurans ko mala ra tala rastriya bhanai lekhieko chha.
"janani janmabhumishcha swargadapi gariyasi" ko arth k ho?
yasko arth "aama ra janmabhumi swarga bhanda pani mahan chhan" bhanne ho. yo nepal ko rastriya nishan ma lekhieko bhanai ho.
nepal ko mudra k ho?
nepal ko mudra nepali rupiya ho. nepal rastra bank le note ra sikka jari garchha.
nepal rastra bank kahile sthapana bhayo?
nepal rastra bank 2013 sal (1956) ma sthapana bhayo. yo nepal ko kendriya bank ho.
nepal ko sarkari kaam ko bhasa kun ho?
nepal ko sarkari kaam ko bhasa nepali ho, jun devanagari lipi ma lekhinchha. sambidhan le nepal ma boline sabai matribhasa lai rastra bhasa maneko chha.
nepal ko janasankhya kati chha?
2078 sal (2021) ko janaganana anusar nepal ko janasankhya lagbhag 2 crore 91 lakh thiyo. janaganana prayek 10 barsa ma garinchha.
nepal ma kun sambat chalchha?
nepal ma sarkari kaam ko lagi bikram sambat chalchha. yo english sal bhanda lagbhag 56 barsa 8 mahina aghi chha.
nepali naya barsha kahile parchha?
nepali naya barsha baisakh 1 gate parchha. yo english calendar anusar april mahina ko bich tira pardachha.
nepal sambat kasle suru gareka hun?
nepal sambat sankhadhar sakhwa le suru gareka hun. unle sabai ko rin tiridiyera naya sambat chalayeko katha prasiddha chha.
nepal ma arthik barsha kahile suru hunchha?
nepal ma arthik barsha shrawan 1 gate bata suru hunchha ra asar masanta ma sakinchha. sarkar ko budget pani yahi barsha ko lagi banchha.
nepal ma kati wata mahina hunchhan ra naam?
nepali patro ma 12 mahina hunchhan: baisakh, jestha, asar, shrawan, bhadra, ashwin, kartik, mangsir, poush, magh, falgun ra chaitra.
nepal ko ritu kati wata chhan?
nepali paramparama 6 ritu manchhan: basanta, grishma, barsha, sharad, hemanta ra shishir. prayek ritu lagbhag 2 mahina ko hunchha.
aadhunik nepal ko ekikaran kasle gare?
aadhunik nepal ko ekikaran gorkha ka raja prithvi narayan shah le gare. unle saana saana rajya haru milayera thulo nepal banaye.
prithvi narayan shah le kathmandu kahile jite?
prithvi narayan shah le 1825 sal (1768) ma indra jatra ko bela kathmandu jite. tyas pachhi kathmandu nepal ko rajdhani banyo.
dibya upadesh kasko ho?
dibya upadesh prithvi narayan shah ko upadesh ho. yasma unle nepal lai "duita dhunga bich ko tarul" bhanera china ra bharat sanga santulit sambandha rakhna salah diye.
rastriya ekata diwas kahile manainchha?
rastriya ekata diwas poush 27 gate manainchha. yo din prithvi narayan shah ko janma jayanti ho.
rana shasan kati barsa chalyo?
rana shasan 104 barsa chalyo. 1903 sal ko kot parba dekhi suru bhayera 2007 sal ma prajatantra aaye pachhi sakiyo.
rana shasan kasle suru gare?
rana shasan jung bahadur rana le suru gare. 1903 sal ko kot parba pachhi uni shaktishali pradhanmantri bhaye.
prajatantra diwas kahile ho?
prajatantra diwas falgun 7 gate ho. 2007 sal falgun 7 ma rana shasan ko anta bhayera nepal ma prajatantra ko ghoshana bhayeko thiyo.
panchayat byabastha kahile suru bhayo?
panchayat byabastha 2017 sal ma raja mahendra le suru gare. 2046 sal ko jana andolan pachhi yo byabastha antya bhayo.
nepal ganatantra kahile bhayo?
nepal 2065 sal jestha 15 gate (28 may 2008) ma sangiya loktantrik ganatantra bhayo. sambidhan sabha ko pahilo baithak le rajtantra antya gareko thiyo.
ganatantra diwas kun din parchha?
ganatantra diwas jestha 15 gate parchha. 2065 sal ko yahi din nepal ganatantra ghoshana bhayeko thiyo.
nepal ko sambidhan kahile jari bhayo?
nepal ko hal ko sambidhan 2072 sal asoj 3 gate (20 september 2015) ma jari bhayo. yo sambidhan sabha le baneko pahilo sambidhan ho.
sambidhan diwas kahile hunchha?
sambidhan diwas asoj 3 gate manainchha. 2072 sal ko yahi din nepal ko sambidhan jari bhayeko thiyo.
nepal ko pahilo rashtrapati ko hun?
nepal ko pahilo rashtrapati dr. ram baran yadav hun. uni 2065 sal (2008) ma rashtrapati bhaye.
pahilo mahila rashtrapati ko thiin?
nepal ki pahili mahila rashtrapati bidya devi bhandari hun. uni 2072 sal (2015) ma rashtrapati baneki thiin.
pahilo upa rashtrapati ko hun?
nepal ka pahila upa rashtrapati paramananda jha hun. uni 2065 sal ma upa rashtrapati bhaye.
ganatantra pachhi ko pahilo pradhanmantri ko?
ganatantra pachhi ka pahila pradhanmantri pushpa kamal dahal "prachanda" hun. uni 2065 sal (2008) ma pradhanmantri bhaye.
nepal ko pahilo nirvachit pradhanmantri ko hun?
nepal ka pahila janata le chuneko pradhanmantri bishweshwar prasad (b.p.) koirala hun. uni 2015 sal ko chunab pachhi pradhanmantri bhaye.
pahilo mahila pradhan nyayadhish ko?
nepal ki pahili mahila pradhan nyayadhish sushila karki hun. uni 2073 sal (2016) ma pradhan nyayadhish baneki thiin.
pratinidhi sabha ki pahili mahila sabhamukh ko?
nepal ki pahili mahila sabhamukh onsari gharti magar hun. uni 2072 sal (2015) ma sabhamukh baneki thiin.
char shahid ko ko hun?
nepal ka char shahid shukraraj shastri, dharma bhakta mathema, dashrath chand ra gangalal shrestha hun. rana shasan biruddha ladda unlai 1997 sal ma mrityudanda diyiyo.
shahid diwas kahile manainchha?
shahid diwas magh 16 gate manainchha. desh ko lagi jyan dine shahid haru lai yo din samjhinchha.
nepal kahile united nations ma pasyo?
nepal 1955 (2012 sal) ma sanyukta rashtra sangh ko sadasya bhayo. nepal ko sena le dherai desh ma shanti sena ma kaam gareko chha.
nepal kahilyai kasaiko upanivesh bhayo?
bhayena, nepal kahilyai kunai desh ko upanivesh banena. nepal ko lagi yo garva ko kura ho.
sugauli sandhi kahile bhayo?
sugauli sandhi 1816 ma nepal ra east india company bich bhayo. yo sandhi pachhi nepal le aafno thulo bhubhag gumayo.
nalapani ko ladai ma ko prasiddha chhan?
nalapani ko ladai ma balbhadra kunwar prasiddha chhan. thorai sipahi le dherai thulo angreji sena lai lamo samaya samma rokeka thiye.
bhakti thapa kun ladai ko lagi prasiddha chhan?
bhakti thapa deuthal ko ladai ko lagi prasiddha chhan. budheshkal ma pani uni angreji sena sanga bahaduri sath ladera shahid bhaye.
aadikavi kasari bhaninchha?
bhanubhakta acharya lai aadikavi bhaninchha. unle ramayan lai sabai le bujhne saral nepali bhasa ma lekhe.
bhanu jayanti kahile manainchha?
bhanu jayanti asar 29 gate manainchha. yo aadikavi bhanubhakta acharya ko janma din ho.
mahakavi ko hun nepal ka?
nepal ka mahakavi laxmi prasad devkota hun. unko "muna madan" sabai bhanda lokpriya nepali khanda kavya madhye ek ho.
muna madan kasle lekhe?
"muna madan" laxmi prasad devkota le lekheka hun. yasma madan lhasa jada muna lai chhodera jane karun katha chha.
shirish ko phool kasko upanyas ho?
"shirish ko phool" parijat ko upanyas ho. yo upanyas le madan puraskar jiteko thiyo ra aaja pani dherai padhinchha.
madan puraskar k ho?
madan puraskar nepali sahitya ko sabai bhanda pratishthit puraskar madhye ek ho. yo prayek barsa ramro nepali pustak lai diinchha.
araniko ko hun?
araniko 13 au shatabdi ka nepali kalakar ra bastukar hun. unle china ko beijing ma seto stupa banayeka thiye.
dharahara ra sundhara kasle banaye?
dharahara ra sundhara bhimsen thapa le banaye. uni 1863 dekhi 1894 sal samma nepal ka mukhtiyar thiye.
gautam buddha kaha janmeka hun?
gautam buddha nepal ko lumbini (rupandehi jilla) ma janmeka hun. unko bachpan ko naam siddhartha gautam thiyo.
buddha ka aama buwa ko thiye?
gautam buddha ka buwa raja shuddhodhan ra aama maya devi thiin. uni kapilvastu rajya ka rajkumar thiye.
buddha lai gyan kaha prapta bhayo?
buddha lai bharat ko bodh gaya ma pipal ko rukh muni dhyan gardai gyan prapta bhayo. tyo rukh lai bodhi briksha bhaninchha.
lumbini ko ashok stambha k ho?
ashok stambha maurya samrat ashok le lumbini ma gadeko dhunga ko khamba ho. yasma lekhieko abhilekh le lumbini nai buddha ko janmasthal ho bhanne pramanit garchha.
maya devi mandir kaha chha?
maya devi mandir lumbini ma chha. yo buddha janmeko thau ma baneko mandir ho.
kumari ko hun?
kumari lai jiwit devi maninchha. kathmandu ko kumari newar shakya samudaya ki saani keti hunchhin ra basantapur ko kumari ghar ma baschhin.
gorkha sainik kina prasiddha chhan?
gorkha sainik bahaduri ra imandari ko lagi sansar bhari prasiddha chhan. 1815 dekhi nai nepali yuva british sena ma bharti hudai aayeka chhan.
khukuri k ho?
khukuri bhaneko bango dhar bhayeko nepali chhuri ho. yo gorkha sainik ko pahichan ho ra ghar ma kath kaatna pani prayog hunchha.
nepali puruse rastriya poshak k ho?
nepali purush ko paramparik rastriya poshak daura suruwal ho. yasma dhaka topi ra istakot pani lagaune chalan chha.
namaste ko arth k ho?
namaste ko arth "tapai bhitra ko ishwar lai ma namaskar garchhu" bhanne bujhinchha. haat jodera namaste garnu nepali abhivadan ko tarika ho.
dashain kati din samma manainchha?
dashain 15 din samma manainchha. ghatasthapana dekhi suru bhayera kojagrat purnima ma sakinchha.
dashain ko pahilo din lai k bhanchhan?
dashain ko pahilo din lai ghatasthapana bhaninchha. yo din kalash sthapana garera andhyaro kotha ma jamara rakhinchha.
jamara k ho ra kasari ugauchhan?
jamara jau ya makai ko pahelo biruwa ho. ghatasthapana ko din bij rakhera ghaam napasne kotha ma ugauchhan, tyasaile yo pahelo hunchha.
fulpati kahile parchha?
fulpati dashain ko saatau din parchha. yo din phool, paat ra jamara bhitra lyayera puja garinchha.
dashain ma tika kun din lagaunchhan?
dashain ma tika vijaya dashami ko din, arthat dashau din lagainchha. thula haru bata tika, jamara ra aashirwad linchhan.
dashain ma kun devi ko puja garinchha?
dashain ma durga bhawani ko puja garinchha. durga le mahishasur rakshyas mathi jit gareko khushi ma dashain manaune bishwas chha.
dashain ko antim din kun ho?
dashain ko antim din kojagrat purnima ho. yo din laxmi ko puja garera raati jagram basne chalan chha.
dashain ma ping kina khelchhan?
dashain ma bans ra dori le thulo ping banayera sabai umer ka manchhe ramailo garchhan. yo dashain ko ramailo ra bhetghat ko paramparik khel ho.
tihar kati din ko hunchha?
tihar 5 din ko hunchha, tyasaile yaslai yamapanchak pani bhaninchha. kaag, kukur, gai, goru ra bhai lai kramashah puja garinchha.
tihar ko pahilo din kasko puja garinchha?
tihar ko pahilo din kaag ko puja garinchha, jaslai kaag tihar bhaninchha. kaag lai yamaraj ko doot maninchha.
kukur tihar ma k garchhan?
kukur tihar ma kukur lai tika lagayera phool ko mala lagauchhan ani mitho khana khuwauchhan. kukur lai imandar sathi ra yamaraj ko doot maninchha.
laxmi puja kahile hunchha?
laxmi puja tihar ko tesro din, kartik aunsi ma hunchha. yo din bihana gai ko puja ra beluka dhan ki devi laxmi ko puja garinchha.
tihar ma diyo kina balchhan?
laxmi puja ko raati laxmi lai ghar ma swagat garna ghar bhari diyo ra batti balinchha. ujyalo ghar ma laxmi aauchhin bhanne bishwas chha.
deusi bhailo bhaneko k ho?
deusi bhailo tihar ma ghar ghar gaera geet gaune ra naachne parampara ho. ghar ka manchhe le chamal, phalphul ra paisa dinchhan ani aashirwad paunchhan.
bhai tika ma kun phool chahinchha?
bhai tika ma makhamali phool ko mala chahinchha. makhamali chhitto naoilaune bhayeko le bhai ko aayu lamo hos bhanne kamana garinchha.
bhai tika ma kati rang ko tika lagauchhan?
bhai tika ma didi bahini le bhai lai saptarangi (7 rang ko) tika lagaidinchhan. bhai haru le pani didi bahini lai tika lagaidinchhan.
mha puja kasle manauchhan?
mha puja newar samudaya le tihar ko chautho din manauchhan. yo aafno sharir ko puja garne parba ho ra yahi din nepal sambat ko naya barsha suru hunchha.
chhath parba ma kasko puja garinchha?
chhath ma surya ra chhathi maiya ko puja garinchha. bratalu le nadi ya pokhari ma ubhiyera dubdai gareko ra ugdai gareko surya lai argha dinchhan.
chhath kahile parchha?
chhath kartik shukla shashthi ma parchha, arthat laxmi puja ko 6 din pachhi. madhesh ma yo sabai bhanda thulo parba madhye ek ho.
chhath ma thekuwa k ho?
thekuwa chhath ma chadhaine prasad ho. yo gahu ko pitho, guliyo ra ghiu milayera baneko kada roti ho.
teej ma mahila haru k garchhan?
teej ma hindu mahila haru brata basera shiva-parvati ko puja garchhan ra rato luga lagayera naachgaan garchhan. pati ko lamo aayu ra sukhi parivar ko kamana garinchha.
dar khane din bhaneko k ho?
dar khane din teej ko agilo din ho. yo din didi bahini bhela bhayera mitho khana khanchhan ra bholi ko brata ko tayari garchhan.
rishi panchami kahile parchha?
rishi panchami teej ko 2 din pachhi parchha. yo din mahila haru snan garera saptarishi ko puja garchhan.
janai purnima ma k garinchha?
janai purnima ma janai lagaune le naya janai fereinchha ra arulai haat ma raksha bandhan (doro) baadhinchha. dherai ghar ma yo din kwati khane chalan chha.
kwati kun parba ma khanchhan?
kwati janai purnima ko din khaine chalan chha. 9 kisim ka gedagudi bhijayera tusa umraera pakaine yo jhol swasthya ko lagi ramro maninchha.
gai jatra kina manaunchhan?
gai jatra ma barsa bhitra parivar ko sadasya gumaune haru le gai ya gai ko bhes ma bachcha lai sahar ghumauchhan. yo din hasya ra byangya ko madhyam bata dukha bisaune chalan pani chha.
gai jatra kahile parchha?
gai jatra janai purnima ko bholi palta parchha. kathmandu, patan ra bhaktapur ma yo dherai dhumdhamsanga manainchha.
krishna janmashtami ma k garchhan?
krishna janmashtami ma bhagwan krishna ko janma utsav manainchha. dherai manchhe brata baschhan ra patan ko krishna mandir ma raatbhari bhajan gaunchhan.
indra jatra kaha manainchha?
indra jatra mukhya rup ma kathmandu ko basantapur ma manainchha. yo bela kumari ko rath tanine ra lakhe naach dekhaine garinchha.
lakhe naach k ho?
lakhe naach newar sanskriti ko masked dance ho, jasma lakhe ko daraune mukhundo lagayera naachinchha. indra jatra ma lakhe naach dherai dekhinchha.
ghode jatra kaha hunchha?
ghode jatra kathmandu ko tundikhel ma hunchha. yo din sena le ghoda daudaune ra kartab dekhaune garchha.
maha shivaratri ma k garinchha?
maha shivaratri ma bhagwan shiva ko puja garinchha ra pashupatinath ma lakhau bhakta ra sadhu jamma hunchhan. raati aago taapne chalan pani chha.
shivaratri ko din kun diwas pani manainchha?
maha shivaratri ko din nepali sena diwas pani manainchha. yo din tundikhel ma sena ko karyakram hunchha.
holi lai nepali ma arko k bhanchhan?
holi lai fagu purnima pani bhaninchha. yo falgun purnima ma rang ra abir khelera manainchha.
pahad ra terai ma holi ekai din hunchha?
hudaina, pahad ma holi fagu purnima ko din manainchha ra terai ma tyasko bholi palta manainchha. tyasaile nepal ma holi 2 din manaine chalan chha.
maghe sankranti ma k k khanchhan?
maghe sankranti ma ghiu, chaku, til ko laddu, tarul ra sakhar khand khanchhan. yi khana le jado ma sharir lai nyano ra shakti dinchha bhanne bishwas chha.
maghi parba kasko ho?
maghi tharu samudaya ko mukhya parba ho, jun magh 1 gate manainchha. tharu samudaya le yaslai naya barsha ko rup ma manauchhan.
shree panchami ma kasko puja hunchha?
shree panchami ma bidya ki devi saraswati ko puja hunchha. yo din saana bachcha lai akshar sikauna suru garne chalan chha.
ram navami ma k ho?
ram navami bhagwan ram ko janma din ho. yo chaitra shukla navami ma parchha ra janakpur ma dherai bhakta jamma hunchhan.
bibaha panchami kina manainchha?
bibaha panchami ram ra sita ko bibaha ko samjhana ma manainchha. janakpur ma yo din bibaha ko jhanki dekhaune thulo utsav hunchha.
buddha jayanti kahile parchha?
buddha jayanti baisakh purnima ko din parchha. yo din buddha ko janma, gyan prapti ra mahaparinirvan tinai ko samjhana garinchha.
tamu lhosar kahile parchha?
tamu lhosar poush 15 gate parchha. yo gurung samudaya ko naya barsha ho.
sonam lhosar kasko parba ho?
sonam lhosar mukhya rup ma tamang samudaya ko naya barsha ho. yo magh shukla pratipada ma parchha.
gyalpo lhosar kun samudaya le manauchhan?
gyalpo lhosar sherpa samudaya le mukhya rup ma manauchhan. yo falgun shukla pratipada tira parchha.
ubhauli ra udhauli k ho?
ubhauli ra udhauli kirat samudaya (rai, limbu, yakkha, sunuwar) ka parba hun. ubhauli baisakh purnima ma ra udhauli mangsir purnima ma manainchha ra sakela naach naachinchha.
sakela naach kasto hunchha?
sakela naach ma manchhe gol ghero banayera dhol ra jhyamta ko taal ma naachchhan. naach ma kheti, charaa ra prakriti ko nakkal garine chalan chha.
yomari punhi ma k khanchhan?
yomari punhi ma yomari khanchhan. yo mangsir purnima ma newar samudaya le manaune parba ho.
bisket jatra kaha manainchha?
bisket jatra bhaktapur ma nepali naya barsha ko bela manainchha. rath tanne ra lingo thadyaune yo jatra ko mukhya kaam ho.
rato machhindranath ko jatra kaha hunchha?
rato machhindranath ko rath jatra lalitpur (patan) ma hunchha. yo jatra jawalakhel ma bhoto jatra sanga sakinchha.
bhoto jatra ma k dekhauchhan?
bhoto jatra ma rato machhindranath ko rath bata ratna jadit bhoto (kot jasto luga) charai tira dekhaunchhan. yo bela rashtrapati pani upasthit hune chalan chha.
asar 15 lai k bhanchhan?
asar 15 lai rastriya dhan diwas bhaninchha. yo din khet ma ropain garera dahi chiura khane chalan chha.
shrawan 15 ma kun khana khanchhan?
shrawan 15 lai kheer khane din bhaninchha. dudh ra chamal ko kheer pakayera parivar sangai khanchhan.
kuse aunsi lai k bhanchhan?
kuse aunsi lai buwa ko mukh herne din bhaninchha. yo din chhora chhori le buwa lai mitho khana ra uphar dinchhan.
aama ko mukh herne din kahile ho?
aama ko mukh herne din baisakh krishna aunsi (mata tirtha aunsi) ma parchha. yo din aama lai mitho khana ra uphar dinchhan, aama nahune le mata tirtha ma snan garchhan.
naag panchami ma k garinchha?
naag panchami ma ghar ko dhoka mathi naag ko chitra tasera puja garinchha. naag le ghar lai jogauchhan ra pani parna maddat garchhan bhanne bishwas chha.
gathemangal k ho?
gathemangal (ghanta karna) newar samudaya le manaune parba ho. yo din ghanta karna rakshyas ko putala banayera jalaune ra kharab kura bhagaune chalan chha.
nepal ma christmas ma bida hunchha?
hunchha, nepal ma christmas (december 25) ma sarkari bida dinchhan. nepal ma dherai dharma ka parba ma bida dine chalan chha.
madal kasto baja ho?
madal dui tira chhala tanieko lamo dholak jasto nepali baja ho. lok geet ra naach ma madal sabai bhanda dherai bajainchha.
sarangi kun samudaya ko baja ho?
sarangi paramparik rup ma gandharva (gaine) samudaya le bajaune taar bhayeko baja ho. uni gaun gaun ghumdai sarangi bajayera geet ma kura sunauthe.
panche baja kahile bajinchha?
panche baja bibaha ra shubha karya ma bajinchha. 5 wata baja milayera bajaune bhayeko le yaslai panche baja bhaninchha.
dohori geet bhaneko k ho?
dohori geet ma keta ra keti ka duita samuha le prashna ra uttar gardai pala pala gaunchhan. yo nepali lok sangeet ko lokpriya rup ho.
mithila chitrakala kaha ko ho?
mithila chitrakala janakpur ra mithila kshetra ko ho. paramparik rup ma mahila haru le ghar ko bhitta ma rangin chitra banauchhan.
pashmina kasto kapda ho?
pashmina himali kshetra ko chyangra bakhra ko ekdam naram ruwa bata baneko kapda ho. yo halka ra nyano hunchha, tyasaile mahango bikchha.
lokta kagaj kasari banchha?
lokta kagaj lokta bhanne jhadi ko bokra bata haat le banainchha. yo baliyo hunchha ra dherai barsa samma bigrindaina.
lungta ma kati rang hunchhan?
lungta (prayer flag) ma 5 rang hunchhan: niilo, seto, rato, hariyo ra pahelo. hawa ma udda yasma lekhieka prarthana charai tira failinchhan bhanne bishwas chha.
chautari k ho?
chautari bato ko chheu ma baatoghatu lai aaram garna banaieko dhunga ko thadi ho. dherai jaso yaha pipal ra bar ko rukh ropieko hunchha.
thangka k ho?
thangka bauddha dharma sanga sambandhit kapda ma banaieko dharmik chitra ho. yasma buddha, mandala ra devi devta ka chitra hunchhan.
nepal ma sabai bhanda thulo parba kun ho?
nepal ma sabai bhanda thulo parba dashain ho. sarkari karyalaya ra school ma lamo bida hunchha ra dherai manchhe ghar farkinchhan.
lichhavi kaal ko sabai bhanda purano abhilekh kaha chha?
nepal ko sabai bhanda purano mitiyukta abhilekh changunarayan mandir ma chha. yo lichhavi raja mandev ko pala ma lekhieko ho.
kathmandu durbar kshetra ko arko naam k ho?
kathmandu durbar kshetra lai hanuman dhoka durbar kshetra pani bhaninchha. pahile yaha rajdarbar thiyo ra kumari ghar pani yahi najik chha.
narayanhiti durbar aile k ho?
narayanhiti durbar aile sangrahalaya ho. ganatantra pachhi purano rajdarbar lai janata le herna milne sangrahalaya banaiyo.
nyatapola mandir kaha chha?
nyatapola mandir bhaktapur ko taumadhi chowk ma chha. yo 5 tala ko pagoda shaili ko mandir ho.
swayambhu lai bandar mandir kina bhanchhan?
swayambhunath ma dherai bandar baschhan, tyasaile bideshi le yaslai "monkey temple" bhanchhan. yo kathmandu ko pashchim ko dada ma bhayeko bauddha stupa ho.
bauddhanath stupa kina prasiddha chha?
bauddhanath nepal ko sabai bhanda thula stupa madhye ek ho. yaha tibbati bauddha sanskriti ka gumba ra bhakta dherai dekhinchhan.
changunarayan mandir kasko mandir ho?
changunarayan mandir bhagwan vishnu ko mandir ho. yo bhaktapur jilla ko dada ma chha ra lichhavi kaal dekhi ko itihas bokeko chha.
patan ko krishna mandir kasari baneko chha?
patan ko krishna mandir dhunga le baneko shikhar shaili ko mandir ho. yo patan durbar kshetra ma chha ra krishna janmashtami ma yaha dherai bhid hunchha.
janaki mandir kasko samjhana ma baneko?
janaki mandir sita (janaki) ko samjhana ma baneko ho. yo janakpur ma chha ra seto sangamarmar jasto dekhine sundar mandir ho.
gorkha durbar kaha ho?
gorkha durbar gorkha bazar mathi ko dada ma chha. prithvi narayan shah yahi janmeka ra hurkeka thiye.
nuwakot durbar kina prasiddha chha?
nuwakot durbar prithvi narayan shah le banayeko 7 tale durbar ho. unle jiwan ko antim samaya nuwakot mai bitaye.
rani mahal kaha chha?
rani mahal palpa jilla ma kali gandaki nadi ko kinar ma chha. khadga shumsher le aafni rani ko samjhana ma banayeko bhayeko le yaslai "nepal ko taj mahal" bhanchhan.
tilaurakot kina mahatwapurna chha?
tilaurakot kapilvastu jilla ma chha ra yahi purano kapilvastu rajya ko durbar thiyo bhanne manninchha. siddhartha gautam le yahi bachpan bitayeka thiye.
What is the national bird of Nepal?
The national bird of Nepal is the danfe, also called the Himalayan monal. The male has bright, shiny feathers of many colours.
what is the national animal of nepal
The national animal of Nepal is the cow. It is respected and worshipped in Hindu culture.
Who unified Nepal?
King Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha unified modern Nepal in the 18th century. He conquered Kathmandu in 1768.
When did Nepal become a republic?
Nepal became a federal democratic republic on 28 May 2008 (Jestha 15, 2065). The monarchy ended that day.
What is special about Nepal's flag?
Nepal's flag is the only national flag in the world that is not a rectangle. It is made of two stacked triangles with a moon and a sun.
Where was Buddha born?
Buddha was born in Lumbini, in Rupandehi district of Nepal. His childhood name was Siddhartha Gautam.
How many days does Tihar last?
Tihar lasts 5 days. Crows, dogs, cows and oxen are honoured, and the festival ends with Bhai Tika.
what happens on vijaya dashami?
On Vijaya Dashami, the tenth day of Dashain, elders put tika and jamara on younger family members and give blessings. Families visit relatives to receive tika.
dashain ma naya luga kina lagauchhan?
dashain barsa ko sabai bhanda thulo parba bhayeko le sabai le naya luga lagayera khushi manauchhan. naya luga lagayera thula haru sanga tika thapna jaane ramro chalan maninchha.
dashain ma changa kina udauchhan?
dashain ko bela aakash sapha ra hawa ramro hune bhayeko le changa udaune chalan chha. changa udayera pani nadine bhanne bhagwan lai sandesh pathaune lok bishwas pani chha.
laxmi kasko devi hun?
laxmi dhan ra sampatti ki devi hun. tihar ma laxmi puja garera ghar ma sukha ra samriddhi aaos bhanne kamana garinchha.
saraswati kasko devi?
saraswati bidya, sangeet ra kala ki devi hun. bidyarthi haru shree panchami ma unko puja garchhan.
tihar ma okhar kina phorinchha?
bhai tika ma didi bahini le dhoka ma okhar phodera bhai lai naramro kura bata jogaune kamana garchhan. yo yamaraj bata bhai lai bachaune paramparik bishwas sanga jodiyeko chha.
tihar ma ghar ma rangoli kina banauchhan?
tihar ma laxmi lai swagat garna dhoka ra aagan ma rangin rangoli banauchhan. dhoka dekhi bhitra samma laxmi ko paila pani rangin mato le banaine chalan chha.
sel roti kasari banchha?
sel roti chamal ko pitho, guliyo ra ghiu milayera baneko ghol lai taato tel ma gol ghumayera taarera banchha. tihar ra dashain ma yo nabani hudaina.
tij ma kun rang ko luga dherai lagauchhan?
teej ma mahila haru dherai jaso rato rang ko sari ra cholo lagauchhan. rato rang lai shubha ra saubhagya ko rang maninchha.
ghatasthapana ma kun disha ma kalash rakhchhan?
dherai ghar ma ghatasthapana ko kalash puja kotha ma rakhinchha ra purohit le saait herera sthapana garchhan. disha ra bidhi ghar anusar farak huna sakchha.
nepal ma kati jaat jati chhan?
nepal ma 100 bhanda badhi jaat jati ra bhasa chhan. yo nepal lai bividhata le bhariyeko desh banauchha.
newar samudaya ko mukhya basobas kaha?
newar samudaya ko mukhya basobas kathmandu upatyaka ma chha. newar haru le kathmandu, patan ra bhaktapur ko mandir, kala ra sanskriti banayeka hun.
tharu samudaya mukhya rup ma kaha baschhan?
tharu samudaya mukhya rup ma terai ka jilla ma baschhan, jastai dang, bardiya, kailali ra chitwan. tharu haru ko maato ko ghar ra kheti ko gyan prasiddha chha.
sherpa samudaya kaha baschhan?
sherpa samudaya mukhya rup ma himali kshetra, khas gari solukhumbu ma baschhan. himal chadhne kaam ma sherpa haru sansar bhari prasiddha chhan.
dal bhat tarkari lai santulit khana kina bhanchhan?
dal bhat tarkari ma bhat bata shakti (carbohydrate), dal bata protein ra tarkari bata vitamin ra khanij paainchha. tyasaile yo dherai poshak tatva bhayeko santulit khana ho.
momo ko suruwat kaha bata bhayeko ho?
momo tibbati khana bata aayeko manninchha ra nepal ma newar samudaya le yaslai lokpriya banayeka hun. aaja momo nepal bhari sabai bhanda man parne khaja madhye ek ho.
sel roti kasari banauchhan?
sel roti chamal lai bhijayera pisera guliyo ra ghiu milayeko ghol bata banchha. ghol lai taato tel ma gol aakar ma khasalera taarinchha.
gundruk k bata banchha?
gundruk tori, rayo ya mula ko hariyo paat lai kuhayera (fermentation) ghaam ma sukayera banchha. yo dherai samaya samma rakhna sakinchha ra jhol ya achar banauna prayog hunchha.
sinki bhaneko k ho?
sinki bhaneko mula lai kaatera kuhayera ra sukayera baneko khana ho. yo gundruk jastai amilo hunchha ra jhol banauna prayog garinchha.
dhido k ko pitho bata banchha?
dhido kodo, fapar ya makai ko pitho lai umaleko pani ma chalaudai pakayera banchha. pahadi ra himali kshetra ma dhido dherai khaine paramparik khana ho.
yomari kasto khana ho?
yomari chamal ko pitho ko bahira ra bhitra chaku ya khuwa bhareko bafayeko newari mithai ho. yo mangsir purnima ko yomari punhi ma bishesh gari banainchha.
bara k ko banchha?
newari bara mas (kalo dal) lai bhijayera pisera baneko ghol bata tawa ma pakaieko roti jasto khana ho. kahile kahi yasma anda pani rakhinchha.
chatamari lai k bhanchhan?
chatamari chamal ko pitho bata baneko patalo newari roti ho. yasmathi masu, anda ya tarkari rakhera pakaune bhayeko le kati jana yaslai "newari pizza" bhanchhan.
juju dhau kaha ko prasiddha ho?
juju dhau bhaktapur ko prasiddha dahi ho. maato ko kataura ma jamayeko yo dahi gadha ra guliyo hunchha.
thakali khana kina prasiddha chha?
thakali khana mustang ko thak khola kshetra ko thakali samudaya ko dal bhat ho. jimbu le jhaneko dal, ghiu, achar ra masu sangai mitho swad ko lagi yo prasiddha chha.
chhurpi k bata banchha?
chhurpi chauri ya yak ko dudh bata baneko kada chij ho. dherai samaya chapaudai khana sakine bhayeko le himali kshetra ma lokpriya chha.
sukuti bhaneko k ho?
sukuti bhaneko sukayeko masu ho. masu lai tukra pari ghaam ya aago ma sukauchhan, ani masala halera bhutera ya achar banayera khanchhan.
aloo tama ma k k hunchha?
aloo tama ma aalu, tama (bans ko tusa lai kuhayera baneko amilo chij) ra bori jasta gedagudi halera banaieko jhol hunchha. yo amilo ra piro swad ko nepali tarkari ho.
kheer kasari banchha?
kheer dudh ma chamal ra guliyo halera bistarai pakayera banchha. kati jana yasma alaichi, kaju ra kismis pani halchhan.
lapsi bata k k banchha?
lapsi bata achar, titaura (candy) ra mitho amilo jam jasto chij banchha. lapsi nepal ko pahad ma paine amilo phal ho.
thukpa kasto khana ho?
thukpa chauchau jasto noodles, tarkari ra masu bhayeko taato jhol (soup) ho. yo himali kshetra ra tibbati sanskriti bata aayeko khana ho.
chiura kasari banchha?
chiura dhan lai bhijayera bhutera kutera chepto banaieko chamal ho. yo hatar ma khana sakine halka khaja ho.
samay baji bhaneko k ho?
samay baji newar samudaya ko paramparik khana ko thal ho. yasma chiura, bara, anda, masu, bhatmas, aduwa ra achar jasta kura sangai rakhinchha.
chhoila k ho?
chhoila newari khana ho, jasma masu lai aago ma polera masala, tel ra lasun halera piro banaiinchha. yo dherai jaso chiura sanga khaine chalan chha.
sekuwa kaha ko famous chha?
dharan ko sekuwa dherai prasiddha chha. sekuwa ma masu lai masala lagayera kaath ko aago ma polinchha.
jeri swari kahile khanchhan?
jeri swari kathmandu tira bihana ko nasta ma khaine chalan chha. jeri guliyo chasni ma dubayeko mithai ho ra swari maida ko roti ho.
anarasa ra kasaar ma k farak?
anarasa chamal ko pitho ra guliyo bata baneko taareko roti ho, jasma til pani tasinchha. kasaar bhane bhutayeko chamal ko pitho ra chaku milayera baneko laddu ho.
masyaura k ho?
masyaura dal ko pitho ra tarkari milayera saana dalla banayera sukayeko khana ho. yaslai pachhi tarkari jhol ma pakayera khanchhan.
maghe sankranti ma tarul kina khanchhan?
tarul jamin muni falne kanda ho, jun maghe sankranti ma ghiu ra chaku sangai khaine parampara chha. jado ma yasle sharir lai shakti dinchha bhanne bishwas chha.
sisnu khana ramro ho?
ho, sisnu ko komal tusa bata baneko jhol poshilo maninchha ra yasma khanij tatva dherai hunchha. chhuda tokne bhayeko le panja lagayera tipnu parchha.
niuro k ho?
niuro bhaneko unyu jaati ko biruwa ko komal tusa ho. barsha ko suru tira pahad ma paine yo tarkari mitho ra poshilo maninchha.
jimbu kun kaam ma aauchha?
jimbu himali kshetra ma paine sukayeko ghaans jasto masala ho. yaslai ghiu ma tataera dal jhanna prayog garinchha, khas gari thakali khana ma.
timur kasto masala ho?
timur saano gol masala ho, jasle jibro jhanjhanaunchha. yo achar ra chhoila ma dherai prayog hunchha.
mohi k ho?
mohi bhaneko dahi lai mathera ghiu-nauni chhuttyai sake pachhi baki rahane patalo pani jasto peya ho. garmi ma mohi piyu bhane sharir chiso hunchha bhanchhan.
makai bhatmas kahile khaine chalan chha?
bhuteko makai ra bhatmas hiundo ko kurakani ra chiya sangai khaine lokpriya khaja ho. yasma protein ra shakti dubai paainchha.
carbohydrate le sharir lai k dinchha?
carbohydrate le sharir lai shakti dinchha. bhat, roti, aalu, makai ra dhido carbohydrate ka mukhya srot hun.
protein kina chahinchha?
protein le sharir badhauna ra ghau ya mamsapeshi marmat garna maddat garchha. dal, gedagudi, anda, dudh, machha ra masu ma protein dherai hunchha.
chillo (fat) khanu naramro ho?
thorai chillo sharir lai chahinchha, kinabhane yasle shakti dinchha ra kehi vitamin sosna maddat garchha. tara dherai ghiu, tel ra taareko khana le mutu ra tauil lai haani garchha.
vitamin A ko kami le k hunchha?
vitamin A ko kami le raati ramro nadekhne rog (rataundi) laagna sakchha. gajar, farsi, hariyo saag ra pahelo phal ma vitamin A paainchha.
vitamin C kun phal ma dherai hunchha?
