garden of dreams (swapna bagaicha) kathmandu ko thamel najik chha. yo rana kaal ma banaieko sundar bagaicha ho.
thamel kina prasiddha chha?
thamel kathmandu ko paryatak kshetra ho, jaha hotel, restaurant ra trekking ka saman bechne pasal dherai chhan. bideshi paryatak dherai jaso yaha baschhan.
asan bazar kaha ho?
asan kathmandu ko purano byaparik bazar ho, jun indrachowk ra kathmandu durbar kshetra najik chha. yaha masala, kapda ra gharelu saman paainchha.
nagarkot kina jaanchhan?
nagarkot kathmandu upatyaka ko purbi dada ho, jaha bata sapha mausam ma himal ko lamo shrinkhala ra surya udaeko dekhinchha. kathmandu bata lagbhag 1-2 ghanta ko yatra ho.
chandragiri ma k chha?
chandragiri kathmandu ko dakshin-pashchim ko dada ho, jaha cable car bata pugna sakinchha. mathi bhaleshwor mahadev ko mandir ra himal ko drishya chha.
godawari kaha parchha kathmandu tira?
kathmandu upatyaka ko godawari lalitpur jilla ma parchha. yaha rastriya banaspati udyan (botanical garden) chha.
kirtipur kina prasiddha chha?
kirtipur kathmandu najik ko purano newar sahar ho. tribhuvan bishwabidyalaya ko mukhya kshetra pani kirtipur mai chha.
bungmati ra khokana kina chinchhan?
bungmati ra khokana lalitpur ka purano newar gaun hun. khokana tori ko tel pelne paramparik kaam ko lagi prasiddha chha.
sankhu kaha chha?
sankhu kathmandu jilla ko purbi bhag ma bhayeko purano newar bazar ho. bajrayogini mandir sankhu najik ko dada ma chha.
panauti kina prasiddha?
panauti kavrepalanchok jilla ko purano newar sahar ho, jaha roshi ra punyamati nadi milchhan. yo purana mandir ra galli ko lagi prasiddha chha.
nepal ko sabai bhanda lamo jhulunge pul kaha chha?
yo kura pakka ra aadhunik sankhya sahit bhanna ma sure chhaina. nepal ma dherai lamo jhulunge pul chhan, ra naya pul baninda record pani badlina sakchha.
kun thau lai "pahad ko rani" bhanchhan?
"pahad ko rani" bhanne upama nepal ma bishesh gari palpa ko tansen ra purbi pahad ka kehi sahar lai pani diine gareko suninchha. yo aadhikarik naam bhane haina.
bandipur kina paryatak ko man parne thau ho?
bandipur ma purano newar ghar, dhunga bichhayeko galli ra himal ko drishya chha. yaha gadi rokieko bazar le shanta wataran dinchha.
siddha gufa kaha chha?
siddha gufa tanahun jilla ma bandipur najik chha. yo nepal ka thula gufa madhye ek ho ra bhitra chunadhunga ka sundar aakar chhan.
mahendra gufa kaha chha?
mahendra gufa pokhara ko uttari bhag ma chha. yo chunadhunga ko gufa ho ra najikai chamero gufa (bat cave) pani chha.
world peace pagoda kati wata chhan nepal ma?
nepal ma lumbini ra pokhara dubai thau ma bishwa shanti stupa chhan. pokhara ko stupa phewa tal mathi ko dada ma chha.
lumbini ma kun kun desh ka gumba chhan?
lumbini ko gumba kshetra ma china, japan, thailand, myanmar, germany, korea jasta dherai desh le aafno shaili ma gumba banayeka chhan. yo kshetra lai japan ka kenzo tange le design gareka thiye.
janakpur ma kun kun pokhari prasiddha chhan?
janakpur ma gangasagar, dhanushsagar ra aru dherai pokhari prasiddha chhan. chhath ma yi pokhari ko ghat ma thulo bhid hunchha.
dhanusha dham kina prasiddha chha?
dhanusha dham dhanusha jilla ma chha. ramayan anusar ram le shiva ko dhanush bhachda tyasko tukra yahi khaseko bhanne bishwas chha.
tilaurakot ra kapilvastu sambandhit chha?
chha, tilaurakot kapilvastu jilla mai parchha ra yaslai purano kapilvastu rajya ko rajdhani ko bhagnavashesh maninchha. siddhartha gautam le 29 barsa samma yahi bitayeka thiye bhanne bishwas chha.
devdaha kina mahatwapurna chha?
devdaha rupandehi jilla ma chha ra yaslai maya devi ko maita maninchha. buddha sanga sambandhit tirtha sthal madhye yo pani ek ho.
ramgram stupa kina bishesh chha?
nawalparasi (parasi) ko ramgram stupa ma buddha ko asthi rakhieko bishwas chha. yo ajhai khotalieko nabhayeko stupa bhanera chinchha.
tansen ko rani mahal ko arko naam?
palpa ko rani mahal lai "nepal ko taj mahal" pani bhaninchha. yo kali gandaki nadi ko kinar ma chha.
ilam ko kanyam kina jaanchhan?
kanyam ilam jilla ko chiya bagan ra hariyo dada bhayeko ramro ghumne thau ho. yaha bata chiya bagan ko sundar drishya dekhinchha.
sandakpur kaha chha?
sandakpur ilam jilla ko uttari bhag ma, nepal-bharat simana ma bhayeko uchcha dada ho. yaha bata kanchanjunga ra sagarmatha dubai dekhinchhan.
bhedetar kina prasiddha chha?
bhedetar dhankuta jilla ko dharan najik ko dada ho. chiso mausam ra terai ko sundar drishya ko lagi manchhe ghumna jaanchhan.
dhankuta kina prasiddha chha?
dhankuta purbi pahad ko sundar bazar ho, jun suntala ra shanta mausam ko lagi chinchha. pahile yo purbi bikas kshetra ko kendra pani thiyo.
koshi tappu ma kun mahina ma charaa dherai dekhinchhan?
koshi tappu ma jado ko mahina (mangsir dekhi falgun) ma prawasi charaa sabai bhanda dherai dekhinchhan. charaa herna bihana sabai bhanda ramro samaya ho.
shey phoksundo ko lagi kun jilla jaanu parchha?
shey phoksundo tal herna dolpa jilla jaanu parchha. juphal samma hawaijahaj ra tyaha bata kehi din paidal hidera pugna sakinchha.
khaptad jana kun bata najik?
khaptad rastriya nikunja bajhang, bajura, achham ra doti ko bich ma chha. dherai yatri doti ko jhigrana ya bajhang ko chainpur tira bata paidal jaanchhan.
rara jana kasari jaane?
rara tal jana dherai jaso talcha (mugu) ko hawai maidan samma udera tyaha bata kehi ghanta paidal hidinchha. sadak bata pani jumla hudai pugna sakinchha.
jomsom ko hawa kina dherai chalchha?
kali gandaki ghati ma diuso ghaam le tatayeko hawa ghati bhitra bata chhito bagchha. tyasaile jomsom ma diuso tej hawa chalchha ra hawaijahaj bihanai udchhan.
marpha kina prasiddha chha?
marpha mustang jilla ko syau ra syau bata baneka utpadan ko lagi prasiddha gaun ho. seto dhunga ka ghar ra sapha galli yasko pahichan ho.
kagbeni kaha chha?
kagbeni mustang jilla ma kali gandaki nadi ko kinar ma chha. mathillo mustang jane bato yahi bata suru hunchha.
tatopani (myagdi) ma k chha?
myagdi ko tatopani ma prakritik taato pani ko kunda chhan, jaha trekker ra sthaniya manchhe nuhauna jaanchhan. yo annapurna kshetra ko bato ma parchha.
ghandruk kina prasiddha chha?
ghandruk kaski jilla ko thulo gurung gaun ho. annapurna ra machhapuchhre ko drishya ra gurung sanskriti ko lagi yo prasiddha chha.
sirubari kina chinchha?
syangja ko sirubari nepal ko pahilo gharbas (homestay) gaun madhye ek ho. yaha paryatak sthaniya ghar ma basera gurung sanskriti anubhav garchhan.
gharbas (homestay) bhaneko k ho?
gharbas bhaneko paryatak sthaniya parivar ko ghar ma basera unko khana, sanskriti ra jiwan shaili najik bata anubhav garne byabastha ho. yasle gaun ko aamdani badhauchha.
nepal ma kun mahina ma paryatak dherai aauchhan?
nepal ma sharad (asoj-kartik) ra basanta (falgun-baisakh) ma paryatak dherai aauchhan. yo bela aakash sapha ra mausam ramro hunchha.
trek garda kun kura ma dhyan dinu parchha?
trek garda bistarai uklanus, dherai pani piunus ra uchai ma 1 din ma dherai mathi nasarnus. tauko dukhne, wakwaki lagne lakshan dekhiye mathi najanus, tala orlanus.
TIMS card bhaneko k ho?
TIMS card bhaneko nepal ma trekking garne paryatak ko jaankari rakhne card ho. yasle bipad ma trekker khojna ra surakshya ma maddat garchha.
mountain flight bhaneko k ho?
mountain flight bhaneko kathmandu bata bihanai hawaijahaj ma udera sagarmatha sahit himal najik bata hereko 1 ghanta jati ko udaan ho. trek garna nasakne manchhe pani yasari himal herna sakchhan.
nepal ko sabai bhanda purano mandir kun ho?
nepal ko sabai bhanda purano mandir kun ho bhanne kura ma itihaskar ko ekmat chhaina. changunarayan ko lichhavi kaal ko abhilekh bhane nepal ko purano mitiyukta abhilekh ho.
nepal ma kati wata rastriya nikunja chhan?
nepal ma 12 wata rastriya nikunja chhan, jastai chitwan, bardiya, sagarmatha, langtang, rara, shey phoksundo, khaptad, makalu barun, shivapuri nagarjun, banke, parsa ra shuklaphanta.
banke rastriya nikunja kina banaiyo?
banke rastriya nikunja bardiya sanga jodiyera baagh ra aru janawar lai thulo surakshit kshetra dina banaiyo. yo banke jilla ma chha.
parsa rastriya nikunja kaha chha?
parsa rastriya nikunja madhesh ra bagmati pradesh ko simana najik, chitwan rastriya nikunja ko purba ma chha. pahile yo wanyajantu arakshya thiyo.
langtang ko gaun 2072 ko bhukampa ma k bhayo?
2072 ko bhukampa ma langtang gaun mathi bata aayeko thulo pahiro ra hiu ko pahiro le pura dabiyo. dherai manchhe ko jyan gayo ra pachhi gaun lai feri banaiyo.
nepal ko pahilo hawaijahaj sanstha kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo rashtriya hawaijahaj sanstha royal nepal airlines ho, jun 1958 ma sthapana bhayo. aaja yaslai nepal airlines bhaninchha.
kathmandu ko ring road kati lamo chha?
kathmandu ring road lagbhag 27 kilometer lamo chha. yo kathmandu ra lalitpur ko waripari ghumne mukhya sadak ho.
kathmandu ko ring road kasko sahayog ma baneko ho?
kathmandu ring road china ko sahayog ma baneko ho, ra pachhi yasko bistar pani china kai sahayog ma bhayo.
mugling kina mahatwapurna chha?
mugling chitwan ko trishuli ra marsyangdi nadi ko dobhan najik ko bazar ho. kathmandu, pokhara ra narayangadh jane bato yahi bata chhuttinchha.
narayangadh kaha chha?
narayangadh chitwan jilla ko bharatpur sahar ko bhag ho ra narayani nadi ko kinar ma chha. purba-pashchim rajmarg ra mugling jane bato yahi bata jodinchha.
dhulikhel bata kun rajmarg jaanchha?
dhulikhel bata araniko rajmarg china ko simana tira ra b.p. rajmarg sindhuli hudai terai tira jaanchha.
bardibas kina mahatwapurna chha?
bardibas mahottari jilla ma chha, jaha b.p. rajmarg ra purba-pashchim rajmarg milchhan. kathmandu bata purba jane dherai gadi yahi bata jaanchhan.
hetauda ma kun udyog prasiddha chha?
hetauda audyogik kshetra ko lagi chinchha ra pahile yaha cement udyog ra kapda udyog thiye. yo bagmati pradesh ko rajdhani pani ho.
butwal ra bhairahawa ko bich kati tadha?
butwal ra bhairahawa (siddharthanagar) dubai rupandehi jilla ma chhan ra bich ma lagbhag 20-25 km ko doori chha. yo sadak dherai byasta rahanchha.
biratnagar ko jute mill kina prasiddha?
biratnagar jute mill nepal ko pahilo thulo udyog maninchha, jun 1936 ma sthapana bhayeko thiyo. yasle biratnagar lai audyogik sahar ko pahichan diyo.
nepal ko pahilo jalvidyut kendra kaha chha?
nepal ko pahilo jalvidyut kendra pharping ma chha, jun 1911 ma suru bhayeko thiyo. pharping kathmandu ko dakshin bhag ma parchha.
kulekhani jalvidyut ko bishesh kura k ho?
kulekhani jalvidyut nepal ko pahilo ra lamo samaya samma ekmatra jalashaya (reservoir) bhayeko jalvidyut ayojana ho. sukkha mausam ma pani yasle bijuli nikalna maddat garchha.
nepal ko pahilo cable car kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo aadhunik yatri cable car manakamana cable car ho, jun 1998 ma suru bhayeko thiyo. yo prithvi rajmarg ko kurintar bata manakamana mandir samma jaanchha.
what is the highest pass on the Annapurna Circuit?
Thorong La is the highest pass on the Annapurna Circuit, at about 5416 meters. It connects Manang with Muktinath in Mustang.
which was Nepal's first university?
Tribhuvan University, founded in 1959 (2016 BS), was Nepal's first university. Its main campus is in Kirtipur.
what is the first newspaper of nepal
Gorkhapatra, first published in 1901, is Nepal's first newspaper. It is still published today.
when did Radio Nepal start?
Radio Nepal started in 1951 (Chaitra 2007 BS). It was the first radio station in Nepal.
How many national parks does Nepal have?
Nepal has 12 national parks, including Chitwan, Bardiya, Sagarmatha, Langtang and Rara.
where is the golden temple in nepal?
The Golden Temple, or Hiranya Varna Mahavihar, is in Patan (Lalitpur). It is a Buddhist monastery with a gold-coloured roof.
what is in budhanilkantha?
Budhanilkantha has a large stone statue of Lord Vishnu lying on a bed of snakes in a pond. It is in the northern part of Kathmandu.
kathmandu ko kun dada bata cable car chadhna paainchha?
kathmandu ko chandragiri dada ma cable car chadhna paainchha. thankot najik bata cable car suru hunchha.
nepal ma samudri satah bhanda sabai bhanda tala ko thau?
nepal ko sabai bhanda hocho thau jhapa ko kechana kalan ho, jun samudri satah bhanda mathi nai chha. nepal ma samudri satah bhanda tala ko kunai thau chhaina.
kun jilla lai "nepal ko syau ko bhandar" bhanchhan?
mustang ra jumla dubai syau ko lagi prasiddha chhan, ra mustang ko marpha syau ko utpadan ko lagi dherai chinchha. kun lai "bhandar" bhanne bhanne aadhikarik naam bhane chhaina.
pokhara ma begnas ra rupa tal kun nagarpalika ma parchhan?
begnas ra rupa tal pokhara mahanagarpalika kai bhag ma parchhan. yi tal sahar ko purbi bhag ma chhan.
devi's fall ko nepali naam k ho?
devi's fall lai nepali ma patale chhango bhaninchha. pokhara ko yo jharna ko pani jamin muni harauchha.
tal barahi mandir kun devi ko ho?
tal barahi mandir barahi devi (durga ko rup) ko mandir ho. yo phewa tal ko bich ko tapu ma chha.
gorkha durbar bata kun himal dekhinchha?
gorkha durbar bata sapha mausam ma manaslu ra ganesh himal shrinkhala ka himal dekhinchhan. durbar dada mathi bhayeko le gorkha bazar pani tala dekhinchha.
palpa ko srinagar dada kina jaanchhan?
palpa ko srinagar dada tansen bazar mathi ko sallo ko jangal bhayeko dada ho. yaha bata himal ko lamo shrinkhala ra tansen bazar ko drishya dekhinchha.
mahendranagar ko arko naam k ho?
mahendranagar lai aile bhimdatta nagarpalika bhaninchha. yo kanchanpur jilla ko sadarmukam ho.
gaddachauki naka kaha chha?
gaddachauki naka kanchanpur jilla ma, nepal ko sudur pashchim ko bharat jane naka ho. purba-pashchim rajmarg ko pashchimi antya pani yahi najik parchha.
nepal ko pahilo mahila doctor ko hun?
yo prashna ko pakka uttar ma sure chhaina, tyasaile galat naam bhanna chahanna. nepal ko swasthya itihas ko pustak ya pratishthit srot ma herda pakka thaha hunchha.
nepal ko pahilo mahila sansad ko hun?
yo kura ma ma pakka chhaina, tyasaile naam bhanna sakdina. nepal ko sansad ko itihas sambandhi sarkari srot ma yo jaankari herna sakinchha.
pashupatinath ma kati dhoka chhan mul mandir ko?
pashupatinath ko mul mandir ko charai tira 4 wata chandi ka dhoka chhan. mandir pagoda shaili ko chha ra chhana sun le jalayeko chha.
pashupatinath mandir ma ko pasna paauchhan?
pashupatinath ko mul mandir bhitra paramparik niyam anusar hindu ra hindu dharma sanga sambandhit dharma manne manchhe matra pasna paauchhan. aru paryatak le bagmati pari bata mandir herna sakchhan.
aarya ghat kaha chha?
arya ghat pashupatinath najik bagmati nadi ko kinar ma chha. yaha hindu haru ko antim sanskar garinchha.
guhyeshwori mandir kaha chha?
guhyeshwori mandir pashupatinath najik bagmati nadi ko kinar ma chha. yo shakti peeth madhye ek ho.
swayambhu ma kati wata sidhi chhan bhanchhan?
swayambhu ko purbi bato ma lamo dhunga ko sidhi chha, jaslai dherai le 365 sidhi bhanchhan. yo bato chadhda bandar haru dherai dekhinchhan.
swayambhu ko stupa ma k chitra hunchha?
swayambhu ko stupa ko charai tira buddha ka aankha kopieka chhan. bich ma naak jasto dekhine chinha nepali ank 1 jasto chha, jasle ekata janauchha bhanchhan.
bauddha stupa ma lhosar ma k hunchha?
lhosar ma bauddha stupa ma hajarau manchhe jamma hunchhan, puja garchhan, diyo balchhan ra paramparik naach gaan garchhan. stupa ko waripari kora (parikrama) garne chalan chha.
kora bhaneko k ho?
kora bhaneko stupa ya gumba ko waripari ghadi ko suiro ghumne disha ma ghumdai prarthana garne bauddha parampara ho. bauddhanath ra swayambhu ma kora garne manchhe dherai dekhinchhan.
maane (prayer wheel) kina ghumauchhan?
maane ma "om mani padme hum" jasta mantra lekhieka hunchhan. bauddha bishwas anusar maane ghumauda mantra padhe jasto punya milchha.
madhumeh (diabetes) bhaneko k ho?
madhumeh bhaneko ragat ma chini (glucose) ko matra lamo samaya samma badhi rahane rog ho. sharir le insulin ramrari banauna ya prayog garna nasakda yo hunchha.
madhumeh ka lakshan k k hun?
madhumeh ka sadharan lakshan: dherai tirkha lagne, dherai pisab aaune, thakai, ghau dhilo niko hune ra kaaran bina tauil ghatne. yasto bhaye ragat ko chini jaanch garaunus.
type 1 ra type 2 madhumeh ma k farak chha?
type 1 ma sharir le insulin banauna nai sakdaina, yo dherai jaso saano umer ma dekhinchha. type 2 ma insulin ramrari kaam gardaina, yo badhi tauil, kam byayam ra umer sanga dherai jodiyeko hunchha.
madhumeh hunabata kasari bachne?
santulit khana, chini ra maida kam, niyamit byayam ra tauil niyantran garda type 2 madhumeh ko khatara dherai ghatchha. 40 barsa pachhi niyamit jaanch garaunu ramro hunchha.
khali pet ma ragat ko chini kati hunu samanya ho?
khali pet ma ragat ko chini lagbhag 70 dekhi 100 mg/dL samanya maninchha. duita jaanch ma 126 ya badhi aayo bhane doctor le madhumeh bhanna sakchhan.
uchcha raktachap lai "silent killer" kina bhanchhan?
uchcha raktachap le dherai jaso kunai lakshan dekhaudaina, tara bistarai mutu, mirgaula ra dimag lai noksan garchha. tyasaile lakshan nabhaye pani niyamit BP jaanch garnu parchha.
pressure (BP) ghataauna k garne?
khana ma nun kam garnus, niyamit hidnus, chhurot ra raksi chhodnus ra tauil milaunus. doctor le aushadhi diyeko bhaye niyamit khanus, aafai nachhodnus.
heart attack ka lakshan k hun?

heart attack ma chhati ma thichieko jasto dukhai hunchha, jun haat, ghaanti ya bangara samma failina sakchha. pasina aaune ra sas pherna garo hune pani hunchha; yasto bhaye turuntai ambulance bolaunus.
stroke (pakshaghat) ka lakshan kasari chinne?
stroke chinna FAST samjhanus: Face (anuhar ek tira dhalkinu), Arm (eutai haat kamjor), Speech (bolai laraborne) ra Time (turuntai aspatal). jati chhito upachar, tyati ramro.
cancer bhaneko k ho?
cancer bhaneko sharir ka koshika niyantran bina badhera gaanth banaune ra aru ang ma failina sakne rog ho. chadai pattaa lagaye dherai cancer ko upachar sambhab hunchha.
chhurot le kun kun cancer lagauna sakchha?
chhurot le phokso, mukh, ghaanti, khana nali ra pisab thaili ko cancer ko khatara badhauchha. chhurot chhodda jun sukai umer ma pani swasthya ma fayada hunchha.
HIV kasari sarchha?
HIV asurakshit yon samparka, sankramit ragat, eutai suiro ko prayog ra sankramit aama bata bachcha ma sarna sakchha. condom ko prayog ra naya suiro le khatara ghatauchha.
HIV kun kura bata sardaina?
HIV haat milauda, angalo halda, sangai khana khada, eutai charpi prayog garda ra laamkhutte le tokda sardaina. tyasaile HIV bhayeka manchhe sanga bhedbhav garnu hudaina.
HIV ra AIDS ma k farak chha?

HIV euta virus ho, jasle sharir ko rog sanga ladne shakti kamjor banauchha. upachar nagare lamo samaya pachhi yasle AIDS bhanne gambhir awastha lyauchha; aushadhi le HIV bhayeka manchhe lamo ra swastha jiwan bachna sakchhan.
hepatitis B bata kasari bachne?
hepatitis B bata bachna sabai bhanda ramro upaya khop ho. yo virus ragat, asurakshit yon samparka ra aama bata bachcha ma sarchha, ra liver lai noksan garchha.
kamalpitta (jaundice) bhaneko k ho?
kamalpitta ma ragat ma bilirubin badhera chhala ra aankha ko seto bhag pahelo hunchha. yo dherai jaso liver ko samasya ko lakshan ho, tyasaile doctor lai dekhaunu parchha.
raktaalpata (anemia) bhaneko k ho?

raktaalpata bhaneko ragat ma haemoglobin kam hunu ho, jasle sharir ma oxygen kam pugchha. thakai, anuhar fusro hune ra chhitai sas fulne yasko lakshan hun; falam (iron) bhayeko khana le maddat garchha.
gaand (goiter) kina aauchha?
khana ma iodine ko kami bhaye ghaanti ko thyroid granthi sunnera gaand aauchha. iodine yukta nun khane bani le nepal ma gaand dherai ghateko chha.
ratandho kun bhitamin ko kami le hunchha?
ratandho (raati ramro nadekhne) vitamin A ko kami le hunchha. gajar, farsi, hariyo saag ra pahelo phalphul ma vitamin A paainchha.
scurvy rog k ho?
scurvy vitamin C ko kami le hune rog ho, jasma gija bata ragat aaune, ghau dhilo niko hune ra thakai lagne hunchha. amilo phal, amala ra hariyo tarkari le yasbata bachauchha.
rickets rog kina hunchha?
rickets bachcha ma vitamin D ra calcium ko kami le hune rog ho, jasle haddi kamjor ra khutta bango banauchha. bihana ko ghaam ra dudh jasta khana le yasbata bachauna maddat garchha.
kwashiorkor bhaneko k ho?
kwashiorkor saano bachcha ma protein ko dherai kami le hune kuposhan ho. yasma pet phulne, khutta sunnine ra kapal ko rang badalinne hunchha.
nimonia (pneumonia) bhaneko k ho?
nimonia phokso ko sankraman ho, jasma khoki, jworo ra sas ferna garo hunchha. saano bachcha ra budha-budhi lai yo khatarnak huna sakchha, tyasaile chhito doctor kahan janu parchha.
jhada-pakhala lageko bachcha lai k garne?

bachcha lai jeevan jal (ORS) ra jhol kura dherai dinus, ra khana ra aama ko dudh nachhodnus. doctor ko salah anusar zinc chakki pani dinchhan; bachcha dherai sust bhaye ya ragat dekhiye turuntai aspatal laijaanus.
pet ma juka kasari parchha?

fohor haat le khana khada ra ramrari nadhoyeko tarkari khada juka ka anda pet ma pugchhan, ra khali khutta hidda kehi juka (jastai hookworm) ka saana lerva chhala bata pasna sakchhan. doctor ko salah ma juka marne aushadhi khanu ra sarsafai rakhnu parchha.
luto (scabies) kasari sarchha?
luto ekdam saano kira (mite) le lagaune chilaune rog ho, jun sangai sutda ra luga share garda sarchha. ghar ka sabai le sangai aushadhi lagaunu ra luga-ochhyan umalera dhunu parchha.
aankha pakyo (conjunctivitis) bhane k garne?
aankha pakda aankha rato hunchha, kachera aauchha ra chilauchha. aankha nachhunus, haat dhoirahanus, rumal share nagarnus, ra dherai bhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
theula (chickenpox) k ho?
theula virus le lagaune rog ho, jasma jworo aauchha ra jiu bhari pani bhareko chilaune phoka niskinchhan. yo sajilai sarchha, tyasaile niko nahunjel school najanu ramro hunchha.
dadura (measles) bata kasari bachne?
dadura bata bachna khop (MR khop) nai sabai bhanda ramro upaya ho. yo dherai sajilai sarne virus ko rog ho, jasma jworo ra jiu bhari rato daana aauchha.
nepal polio mukta kahile bhayo?
nepal sahit dakshin-purbi asia kshetra lai 2014 ma WHO le polio mukta ghoshana garyo. polio bata bachauna bachcha lai polio ko thopa ra khop diine gariyeko chha.
kushtha rog niko hunchha?
hunchha, kushtha rog (leprosy) bacteria le lagaune rog ho ra aushadhi (MDT) le pura niko hunchha. yo sajilai sardaina, tyasaile birami sanga bhedbhav garnu hudaina.
kala-azar kasari sarchha?
kala-azar baluwa jhinga (sandfly) le tokda sarne rog ho. yasma lamo samaya jworo aaune, tauil ghatne ra phiyo badhne hunchha, ra nepal ko terai ma kahi kahi dekhinchha.
japanese encephalitis kasari lagchha?
japanese encephalitis laamkhutte le sarne virus ko rog ho, jasle dimag ma sujan lyauna sakchha. terai ma barsha ko bela badhi dekhinchha ra yasko khop paainchha.
dhanustankar (tetanus) kasari lagchha?
dhanustankar mato, gobar ya fohor kila jasta saman le baneko ghau bata bacteria pasera lagchha. yasle maansapeshi kasine gambhir rog lyauchha, tara khop le bachauna sakinchha.
bachcha lai BCG khop kina dinchhan?
BCG khop le kshayarog (TB) bata, bishesh gari bachcha lai lagne gambhir TB bata bachauchha. yo khop janma pachhi chadai diinchha.
khop le kasari kaam garchha?
khop le sharir lai rog ko kamjor ya mareko kitanu jasto chinari dinchha. sharir le pahile nai ladne shakti (antibody) banauchha, ra pachhi sakkali kitanu aauda chhitai ladchha.
depression bhaneko k ho?

depression bhaneko dherai hapta samma lagatar udas hune, man parne kura ma ruchi harauna, nidra ra bhok badalinne mansik rog ho. yo kamjori haina, upachar sambhab chha, tyasaile bharosa ko manchhe ra doctor sanga kura garnus.
anxiety (chinta rog) ka lakshan k hun?

anxiety ma dherai chinta lagne, mutu dhadkine, sas chhito chalne, pasina aaune ra nidra nalagne hunchha. bistarai gahiro sas line abhyas, byayam ra paramarshadata (counsellor) sanga kura garda maddat garchha.
CPR kasari dinchhan?

sas nafereko manchhe ko chhati ko bich ma dubai haat rakhera prati minet 100 dekhi 120 ko gati ma jod le thichnus. talim bhaye 30 choti thichepachhi 2 choti sas dinus, ra ambulance aaunjel nachhodnus.
khana ghaanti ma adkiyo bhane k garne?
manchhe khokna sakchha bhane khoki rahan dinus. bolna ra sas ferna sakdaina bhane pith ma 5 choti thappad lagaunus, ani pet ma mathitira 5 choti thichnus (Heimlich), ra chahiye ambulance bolaunus.
pani ma dubeko manchhe lai bachauda k dhyan dine?
aafu pani ma haamfalnu bhanda dori, dandi ya tairaune saman phyaknus. bahira nikalepachhi sas chhaina bhane CPR suru garnus ra turuntai ambulance bolaunus.
kasaile bish khayo bhane k garne?
aafai bantaa garauna nakhojnus, kinabhane kehi bish le farkanda jhan noksan garchha. k khayo tyo bottle ya packet sangai lie turuntai aspatal jaanus.
mauri le tokyo bhane k garne?
chhala ma raheko dank lai nangri ya card le khurkera nikalnus, ani chiso pani ya barf lagaunus. sas ferna garo bhaye ya anuhar sunniye turuntai aspatal jaanus.
khutta markiyo (sprain) bhane k garne?

markeko thau lai aaram dinus, kapada ma bereko barf 15-20 minet lagaunus, patti le halka bandhnus ra khutta mathi rakhnus. dherai sunniye ya tekna nasakiye haddi bhaachiyeko huna sakchha, x-ray garaunus.
sathi achanak behos bhaera ladyo bhane pahila k garne?
manchhe lai sidha sutaunus ra khutta ali mathi uthaunus, kasieko luga khukulo parnus ra hawa aauna dinus. sas nafere ya chhitai hos nafarke ambulance bolaunus.
aankha ma rasayan paryo bhane?
turuntai sapha bagne pani le kamti ma 15 dekhi 20 minet aankha pakhalnus, aankha nadalnus. ani rasayan ko naam sahit aankha ko aspatal jaanus.
aago le poleko thau ma k lagaune?
poleko thau ma turuntai 20 minet jati chiso bagne pani halnus. barf, toothpaste, ghiu ya tel nalagaunus, ra thulo ya gahiro poleko bhaye aspatal jaanus.
chhare rog (epilepsy) ko dauraa ma k garne?

dauraa parda manchhe ko mukh ma kehi pani nahalnus ra jabarjasti nasamatnus. waripari ka kada saman hataunus, tauko muni naram kura rakhnus, ra dauraa sakiyepachhi karwat farkaidinus; 5 minet bhanda lamo bhaye ambulance bolaunus.
madhumeh ko birami ko chini ghatyo bhane k dine?
hos ma chha bhane chini, guliyo juice ya mithai chhitai khuwaunus. behos chha bhane mukh ma kehi nahalnus ra turuntai aspatal laijaanus.
hiu le haat-khutta sunnine (frostbite) bhaye k garne?
sunnieko bhag lai manatato (halka nyano, taato haina) pani ma rakhnus ya kakhi ma rakhera bistarai nyano banaunus. ragadnu hudaina, ra chhitai swasthya sanstha jaanu parchha.
ghau bata dherai ragat bagyo bhane?
sapha kapada ya patti le ghau lai jod le thichirakhnus ra sakiye ghau bhayeko bhag mathi uthaunus. ragat narokiye ya ghau gahiro bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus.
hapta ma kati byayam garnu parchha?
WHO anusar thula manchhe le hapta ma kamti ma 150 minet madhyam byayam (jastai chhito hidne) garnu parchha. balbalika le din ma kamti ma 60 minet khelkud ya byayam garnu ramro hunchha.
kati ghanta sutnu parchha?
thula manchhe lai sadharan rup ma raati 7 dekhi 9 ghanta nidra chahinchha. school jaane bachcha lai 9 dekhi 12 ghanta ra kishor kishori lai 8 dekhi 10 ghanta chahinchha.
din ma kati pani piune?
sabai ko lagi eutai nischit matra hudaina, garmi, kaam ra umer anusar farak parchha. pisab halka pahelo rang ko chha bhane pani pugeko sanket ho.
chhikda ra khokda kina kuhina le chhopne?
chhikda ra khokda niskeka thopa ma kitanu hunchhan. haat le chhopda kitanu haat ma lagera aru saman ma sarchhan, kuhina ya rumal le chhopda rog kam sarchha.
hand sanitizer ma kati alcohol hunu parchha?
kitanu marna hand sanitizer ma kamti ma 60 pratishat alcohol hunu parchha. tara haat fohor dekhiyeko chha bhane saabun pani le dhunu nai ramro hunchha.
himal ma kina sunscreen lagaunu parchha?
uchai ma hawa patalo hune bhayeko le ghaam ko ultraviolet kiran badhi pugchha, ra hiu le pani kiran farkauchha. tyasaile himal ma chhitai chhala polchha, sunscreen ra kalo chashma chahinchha.
earphone le kaan bigarchha?
lamo samaya charko aawaj ma earphone sunda kaan ko sunne shakti sadhai ko lagi kam huna sakchha. awaj adha bhanda tala rakhnus ra bich bich ma kaan lai aaram dinus.
aushadhi ko expiry date kina herne?
expiry date pachhi aushadhi ko asar ghatna sakchha ra kehi aushadhi haanikarak pani huna sakchhan. tyasaile kinda ra khanu agadi miti hernus.
aushadhi bachcha bata kina tadha rakhne?
bachcha le aushadhi lai mithai thanera khana sakchhan, ra thorai matra le pani bish jasto asar garna sakchha. aushadhi aglo ra band daraj ma rakhnus.
paracetamol ko kaam k ho?
paracetamol le jworo ra halka dukhai ghataauchha. tara doctor ya batta ma lekheko matra bhanda badhi khada liver lai gambhir noksan garna sakchha.
mahinawari (menstruation) bhaneko k ho?
mahinawari bhaneko kishori ra mahila ko sharir ma har mahina jasto hune sadharan prakriya ho. thula mahila ma yo chakra dherai jaso 21 dekhi 35 din ko hunchha.
chhaupadi pratha bare kanun k bhanchha?
mahinawari ko bela mahila lai ghar bahira goth ma rakhne chhaupadi kupratha nepal ma kanun le nishedh ra dandaniya apradh ho. mahinawari apavitra haina, sharir ko sadharan prakriya ho.
bishwa swasthya diwas kahile manainchha?
bishwa swasthya diwas har barsa april 7 ma manainchha. 1948 ma yahi din WHO (bishwa swasthya sangathan) ko sthapana bhayeko thiyo.
WHO ko mukhyalaya kaha chha?
WHO (bishwa swasthya sangathan) ko mukhyalaya switzerland ko geneva ma chha. yo sanyukta rashtra sangh ko swasthya sambandhi sanstha ho.
bishwa watawaran diwas kahile ho?
bishwa watawaran diwas har barsa june 5 ma manainchha. yo din watawaran jogauna, rukh ropna ra pradushan ghataauna chetana failaainchha.
prithvi diwas (earth day) kahile manainchha?
prithvi diwas har barsa april 22 ma manainchha. yo din prithvi ra prakriti ko samrakshan bare chetana failaaune din ho.
antarrashtriya mahila diwas kahile parchha?
antarrashtriya mahila diwas har barsa march 8 ma manainchha. yo din mahila ko adhikar, samanta ra yogdan lai samman garne din ho.
majdur diwas kina may 1 ma manainchha?
may 1 lai antarrashtriya shramik (majdur) diwas ko rup ma manainchha. yo din 1886 ma america ko chicago ma 8 ghanta kaam ko maag gardai bhayeko andolan ko samjhana ma manaaune gariinchha.
bishwa pani diwas kahile ho?
bishwa pani diwas har barsa march 22 ma manainchha. yo din sapha pani ko mahattwa ra pani jogaune bare chetana failaainchha.
bishwa AIDS diwas kun din manainchha?
bishwa AIDS diwas har barsa december 1 ma manainchha. yo din HIV bare sahi jankari dina ra HIV bhayeka manchhe prati bhedbhav hataauna manainchha.
dhumrapan nishedh diwas kahile ho?
bishwa surti nishedh diwas (world no tobacco day) har barsa may 31 ma manainchha. yo din chhurot, khaini ra gutkha jasta surtijanya padartha ko haani bare chetana failaainchha.
antarrashtriya matribhasha diwas kahile manainchha?
antarrashtriya matribhasha diwas har barsa february 21 ma manainchha. yo din sabai matribhasha ko samman ra samrakshan ko lagi manainchha; nepal ma 120 bhanda badhi bhasha bolinchhan.
bishwa jansankhya diwas kahile ho?
bishwa jansankhya diwas har barsa july 11 ma manainchha. 1987 ko july 11 ma bishwa ko jansankhya 5 arba pugeko anuman gariyeko thiyo, tyasaile yo din chhaniyo.
antarrashtriya saksharta diwas kahile manainchha?
antarrashtriya saksharta diwas har barsa september 8 ma manainchha. yo din padhai lekhai ko mahattwa ra sabai lai shiksha ko adhikar bare chetana failaainchha.
nepal ma shikshak diwas kahile manainchha?
nepal ma guru purnima ko din lai shikshak diwas ko rup ma manainchha. bishwa bhar bhane october 5 lai bishwa shikshak diwas manainchha.
manav adhikar diwas kahile parchha?
manav adhikar diwas har barsa december 10 ma manainchha. 1948 ko december 10 ma sanyukta rashtra sangh le manav adhikar ko bishwavyapi ghoshana patra paarit gareko thiyo.
bishwa paryatan diwas kahile ho?
bishwa paryatan diwas har barsa september 27 ma manainchha. nepal jasto paryatan ma bhar parne desh ma yo din bishesh karyakram gariinchha.
bishwa khadya diwas kahile manainchha?
bishwa khadya diwas har barsa october 16 ma manainchha. 1945 ma yahi din FAO (khadya tatha krishi sangathan) ko sthapana bhayeko thiyo.
antarrashtriya parvat diwas kahile ho?
antarrashtriya parvat diwas har barsa december 11 ma manainchha. yo din himal pahad ra tyaha basne manchhe ko jiwan, pani ra jaibik bibidhata ko mahattwa samjhaauna manainchha.
bishwa red cross diwas may 8 mai kina?
may 8 red cross ka sansthapak henry dunant ko janma din ho, tyasaile yo din bishwa red cross tatha red crescent diwas manainchha. nepal red cross society ko sthapana 1963 ma bhayeko thiyo.
bishwa malaria diwas kahile hunchha?
bishwa malaria diwas har barsa april 25 ma manainchha. malaria laamkhutte le sarne rog ho, tyasaile jhul ma sutne ra pani jamna nadine bare chetana failaainchha.
bishwa TB diwas march 24 mai kina?

1882 ko march 24 ma robert koch le TB garaune bacteria pattaa lagaeko ghoshana gareka thiye, tyasaile yo din bishwa TB diwas manainchha. nepal ma TB ko upachar sarkari swasthya sanstha ma nishulka paainchha.
gastric (amlapitta) kina hunchha?

pet ma dherai amla (acid) banda ra pet ko bhitri tah ma sujan aauda chhati polne, pet dukhne ra dakaar aaune hunchha. samaya ma khana khanu, piro ra tel kam garnu, ani chiya, raksi ra chhurot ghataunu le maddat garchha.
mirgaula ma pathari kasari banchha?
pisab ma bhayeka khanij (jastai calcium) jamera kada dhunga jasto pathari banchha. kam pani piune bani le yasko khatara badhauchha, tyasaile prashasta pani piunu ramro hunchha.
migraine ra sadharan tauko dukhai ma k farak chha?
migraine ma dherai jaso tauko ko eutai tira dhadkane jasto kada dukhai hunchha, ra ujyalo ra aawaj le jhan dukhauchha. kasai lai ulti aaula jasto pani hunchha; barambar bhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
tonsil sunniyo bhane k hunchha?

tonsil ghaanti ko pachhadi dubai tira hune saana granthi hun. sankraman le sunniye ghaanti dukhne, nilna garo hune ra jworo aaune hunchha; manatato nun pani le kulla garda aaram milchha, dherai bhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
sinus ko samasya bhaneko k ho?
naak waripari ka haddi bhitra hawa bhareko khali thau lai sinus bhanchhan. tyaha sujan ya sankraman bhaye naak thunine, anuhar ra nidhar ma bhaari dukhai ra gadha singhan aaune hunchha.
food poisoning kasari hunchha?

bigreko, basi ya ramrari napakaeko khana ma bhayeka bacteria ra tiniharule banaeko bish le food poisoning hunchha. ulti, pakhala ra pet dukhne hunchha, tyasaile jeevan jal (ORS) piunus ra dherai bhaye aspatal jaanus.
cholesterol bhaneko k ho?
cholesterol ragat ma paaine boso jasto padartha ho, jun sharir lai thorai chahinchha. LDL (naramro cholesterol) badhi bhaye ragat nali ma jamera heart attack ra stroke ko khatara badhauchha.
motiyabindu (cataract) bhaneko k ho?
motiyabindu ma aankha bhitra ko lens bistarai dhamilo hunchha, ra yo dherai jaso budheskaal ma dekhinchha. saano shalyakriya gari dhamilo lens hatayera kritrim lens rakhda feri dekhna sakinchha.
dr. sanduk ruit kina prasiddha chhan?

dr. sanduk ruit nepal ka prasiddha aankha bisheshagya hun, jasle sasto ra chhito garna milne motiyabindu shalyakriya ko bidhi bikas gare. unle tilganga aankha pratishthan sthapana garna maddat gare ra ek lakh bhanda badhi manchhe ko aankha ko jyoti farkaaye.
netra daan (eye donation) kasari garinchha?

mrityu pachhi aankha ko agadi ko paardarshi bhag (cornea) daan garna sakinchha, jasle cornea bigreka manchhe dekhna sakchhan. yo mrityu bhayeko kehi ghanta bhitrai (sakbhar 6 ghanta bhitra) nikalnu parchha.
ragat daan kasle garna sakchha?
nepal red cross anusar 18 dekhi 60 barsa ka, 45 kg bhanda badhi tauil bhayeka swastha manchhe le ragat daan garna sakchhan. ek choti ragat diyepachhi feri dina kamti ma 3 mahina parkhanu parchha.
ragat daan lai kina mahaan kaam maninchha?
ek choti ko ragat daan le durghatana, shalyakriya ra sutkeri ka birami ko jiwan bachauna sakchha. swastha manchhe ko sharir le diyeko ragat kehi hapta bhitrai feri banaauchha.
mahila swasthya swayamsevika ko kaam k ho?

mahila swasthya swayamsevika gaau ra tol ma aama ra bachcha ko swasthya, khop, poshan ra parivar niyojan bare jankari dine ra sadharan sewa pugaaune swayamsevak hun. nepal ma yo karyakram 1988 dekhi suru bhayeko ho ra desh bhar 50 hajar bhanda badhi swayamsevika chhan.
bachcha lai vitamin A capsule kahile khuwainchha?

nepal ma 6 mahina dekhi 5 barsa samma ka bachcha lai barsa ma dui choti (baisakh ra kartik ma) rashtriya abhiyan marfat vitamin A capsule khuwainchha. yasle ratandho ra sankraman bata bachauna maddat garchha.
haattipaile rog kasari lagchha?

haattipaile (filariasis) laamkhutte le tokda sarne saana juka le lagaune rog ho. yasle lasika nali band garera khutta ra haat dherai sunnine banauchha; nepal ma yasko roktham garna saamuhik rup ma aushadhi khuwaune abhiyan chalainchha.
nepal le trachoma rog ma k safalta paayo?

trachoma bacteria le lagaune aankha ko rog ho, jasle upachar nagare andho banauna sakchha. 2018 ma WHO le nepal lai trachoma janaswasthya samasya ko rup ma hataune dakshin-purbi asia kshetra ko pahilo desh ghoshana garyo.
band kotha ma angeetho balera sutna kina khatarnak chha?

band kotha ma koila, daura ya gas baalda carbon monoxide gyaas banchha, jasko rang ra gandha hudaina. yasle sutiraheko manchhe lai thaha napai behos banaera mrityu samma garauna sakchha, tyasaile hawa aaune jhyal khulai rakhnus.
terai ko tubewell ko pani ma arsenic ko samasya k ho?

terai ka kehi jilla ka tubewell ko pani ma prakritik rup mai arsenic bhanne bish paainchha. lamo samaya yasto pani piuda chhala ma daag ra cancer jasta rog lagna sakchha, tyasaile pani jaanch garaera matra piunu parchha.
AQI le k bataauchha?

AQI (hawa gunastar suchak) le hawa kati sapha ya pradushit chha bhanne bataauchha. 0-50 ramro, 101-150 sambedanshil manchhe lai haanikarak, 151-200 sabai lai haanikarak ra 300 mathi ati khatarnak maninchha.
pradushan bhayeko bela kasto mask ramro hunchha?

dhulo ra dhuwa ka sukshma kan (PM2.5) rokna N95 jasta anuhar ma ramrari tasine mask kapada ko mask bhanda dherai ramro hunchha. pradushan dherai bhayeko din bahira ko byayam ghataaunu pani ramro hunchha.
din ma kati nun khanu thik ho?
WHO anusar thula manchhe le din ma 5 gram (lagbhag eutai chiya chamcha) bhanda kam nun khanu parchha. badhi nun le uchcha raktachap ra mutu ko rog ko khatara badhauchha.
din ma kati chini khanu thik ho?

WHO anusar thapeko chini dainik urja ko 10 pratishat bhanda kam, sakiye 5 pratishat (thula manchhe lai lagbhag 25 gram ya 6 chiya chamcha) bhanda kam hunu ramro hunchha. mithai, cold drink ra juice ma dherai lukeko chini hunchha.
iodine bhayeko nun kasari chinne?
nepal ma iodine yukta nun ko packet ma "dui bachcha chhap" ko chinha hunchha. iodine le gaand ra bachcha ko dimag ko bikas ma hune samasya bata bachauchha.
pyaj katda kina aankha bata aansu aauchha?
pyaj katda yasko koshika futera aankha lai polne euta gyaas niskinchha, ra aankha le tyo gyaas pakhalna aansu nikalchha. pyaj lai pahile chiso banaera dhaarilo chakku le katda kam hunchha.
gaadi chadhda kina ulti jasto hunchha?

gaadi chalda aankha ra bhitri kaan le dimag lai gati bare farak farak sanket pathauchhan, ra yo milan nahuda ulti jasto hunchha. agadi basera tadha herne, kitab napadhne ra jhyal kholne garda kam hunchha.
aaisakrim chhito khada kina tauko dukhchha?

dherai chiso kura chhito khada mukh ko taalu chhitai chiso hunchha, ra tyaha ka ragat nali ekkasi khumchine ra failine hunda chhotai tauko dukhchha. bistarai khanu ra jibro taalu ma tasaunu le chhitai thik hunchha.
dherai ber pani ma basda aunla ko chhala kina khumchinchha?
lamo samaya pani ma basda nasa (nerve) le aunla ko chhala muni ka ragat nali khumchyaune hunda chhala ma dharka parchhan. kehi baigyanik ko bichar ma yasle bhijeko kura samatna sajilo banauchha.
recording ma aafno aawaj kina farak sunchha?
bolda hami aafno aawaj hawa bata ra khoppadi ko haddi bata pani sunchhau, jasle aawaj gahiro sunauchha. recording ma hawa bata aayeko aawaj matra hunchha, tyasaile ali patalo ra anautho lagchha.
bhok lagda pet kina gudgud garchha?
pet ra aandra ka maansapeshi le khana, taral ra gyaas lai agadi dhakelda awaj aauchha. pet khali hunda yo awaj thulo sunchha, kinabhane bhitra khana le awaj dabaaudaina.
lamo ber basda khutta kina jhamjhamaunchha?
lamo samaya eutai tarika le basda nasa (nerve) ma thichai parchha ra sanket ramrari jana sakdaina. thichai hatepachhi nasa le feri sanket pathauda sui le ghoche jasto jhamjham hunchha.
dar lagda kina pasina aauchha?
dar ya chinta lagda sharir le adrenaline hormone chhodchha, jasle mutu chhito dhadkaune ra pasina ka granthi lai sakriya banaune garchha. yo khatara ko samna garna sharir ko tayari ho.
sharir ma jworo kina aauchha?
jworo prayah sankraman sanga ladna sharir le aafai tapkram badhaaune prakriya ho. sadharan rup ma 38 degree celsius (100.4 F) ra tyo bhanda mathi lai jworo maninchha.
jaado ma kina naak bata pani bagchha?
chiso hawa lai nyano ra osilo banauna naak le badhi taral banauchha. sanga, chiso hawa ma naak bhitra ko bafa jamera thopa banchha, tyasaile naak bagchha.
manchhe sutda kina ghurchha?
sutda ghaanti ka naram tantu khukulo hunchhan ra sas jada tiniharu kaampera ghurne awaj aauchha. tauil badhi hunu, raksi ra chit parera sutnu le ghurai badhauchha.
aunla futkaunda kina awaj aauchha?
jod bhitra ko chiplo taral padartha ma ekkasi gyaas ko bulbula banda tyo awaj aauchha. ahile samma ko adhyayan anusar aunla futkaunda bath (arthritis) lagne pramaan paaiyeko chhaina.
maansapeshi baundiyo (cramp) bhane k garne?
baundieko maansapeshi lai bistarai tanera (stretch) ra halka maalis garera khukulo banaunus. pani ra nun ko kami le pani cramp aauna sakchha, tyasaile pani prashasta piunus.
sharir ma pani kami bhayeko (dehydration) kasari thaha paaune?
mukh sukne, gadha pahelo pisab, kam pisab aaune, chakkar lagne ra thakai lagne pani kami ka lakshan hun. saano bachcha aansu bina runu ra taalu ko naram bhag dhasnu khatarnak sanket ho.
rugha-khoki ra influenza (flu) ma k farak chha?
dubai virus le lagchhan, tara rugha ma dherai jaso naak bagne ra halka khoki matra hunchha. flu ma ekkasi uchcha jworo, jiu dukhne ra dherai thakai lagchha, ra yasko lagi barsik khop pani paainchha.
BMI kasari nikalchhan?
BMI nikalna tauil (kg) lai uchai (m) ko varg le bhag garinchha: 45 kg ra 1.5 m bhaye 1.5 x 1.5 = 2.25 ra 45 / 2.25 = 20. 18.5 dekhi 24.9 samma ko BMI samanya maninchha.
jumra (lice) kasari hataaune?
jumra tauko ko samparka ra kangiyo, topi share garda sarchha. jumra ko shampoo lagaunus ra bhijeko kapal lai masino kangiyo le niyamit kornus, ani ghar ka aru ko pani jaanch garnus.
dad (ringworm) kira le lagchha?
haina, naam "ringworm" bhaye pani dad kira le haina, fungus (dhusi) le lagne chhala ko rog ho. chhala lai sukkha rakhnu, aafno rumal-luga share nagarnu ra fungus marne malam lagaunu parchha.
chaya (dandruff) kina hunchha?
chaya bhaneko tauko ko chhala ko mareko tah saana tukra ma jharnu ho, ra yasma prayah euta fungus ko bhumika hunchha. chaya hataaune shampoo niyamit lagaunda dherai jaso niyantran hunchha.
kishor umer ma kina dandiphor aauchha?

kishor umer ma hormone badalinda chhala ma tel badhi banchha, ra tel ra mareko chhala le chhidra (pore) band garda dandiphor aauchha. anuhar din ma dui choti halka saabun le dhunus ra dandiphor nafodnus.
mukh bata gandha kina aauchha?
daat, gija ra jibro ma basne bacteria le khana ka tukra kuhaauda gandha aauchha. din ma dui choti brush garnu, jibro sapha garnu ra prashasta pani piunu le gandha ghataauchha.
mukh ma saano ghau (mouth ulcer) aayo bhane k garne?
dherai jaso mukh ko saano ghau 1 dekhi 2 hapta ma aafai niko hunchha; piro ra amilo khana kam garnus ra nun pani le kulla garnus. 3 hapta bhanda badhi samma niko nabhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
ECG bhaneko k ho?
ECG le mutu ko bidyutiya kriyakalap lai rekha ko rup ma record garchha. yasle mutu ko dhadkan ko lay ra heart attack jasta samasya pattaa lagauna maddat garchha.
MRI ra CT scan ma k farak chha?

CT scan le dherai kona bata X-ray lie computer marfat bhitri tasbir banauchha. MRI le X-ray ko satta shaktishali chumbak ra radio tarang prayog garchha, ra dimag jasta naram tantu ko tasbir ramro dinchha.
video x-ray (ultrasound) kasari kaam garchha?

ultrasound le manchhe le sunna nasakne uchcha frequency ko dhwani tarang sharir bhitra pathauchha ra farkeko pratidhwani bata tasbir banauchha. yasma X-ray jasto bikiran hudaina, tyasaile garbhawati ko jaanch ma prayog gariinchha.
ABO ragat samuha kasle pattaa lagaye?
austria ka baigyanik karl landsteiner le 1901 ma ABO ragat samuha pattaa lagaye. yo khoj le ragat chadhaunu surakshit banayo, ra unle 1930 ma nobel puraskar paaye.
polio ko pahilo khop kasle banaye?
america ka jonas salk le polio ko pahilo safal khop banaye, jun 1955 ma surakshit ra prabhabkari ghoshana gariyo. pachhi albert sabin le mukh bata khuwaune polio ko thopa banaye.
insulin kahile pattaa lagaiyo?
1921 ma canada ka frederick banting ra charles best le insulin pattaa lagaye. yo khoj pachhi madhumeh ka birami ko jiwan bachauna sambhab bhayo.
manchhe ko pahilo mutu pratyaropan kahile bhayo?
1967 ma south africa ko cape town ma dr. christiaan barnard le manchhe ko pahilo mutu pratyaropan (heart transplant) gare. yo chikitsa bigyan ko itihas ko thulo ghatana maninchha.
stethoscope kasle banaye?
1816 ma france ka doctor rene laennec le stethoscope banaye. yasle doctor lai mutu ra phokso ko awaj sunera rog pattaa lagauna maddat garchha.
biphar (smallpox) rog kahile unmulan bhayo?
WHO le 1980 ma biphar rog sansar bata pura unmulan bhayeko ghoshana garyo. yo khop ko maddat le manchhe le pura hataayeko pahilo rog ho.
florence nightingale lai kina samjhinchha?

florence nightingale aadhunik nursing ki sansthapak hun, jasle crimean yuddha ma ghaite sipahi ko sewa gardai sarsafai ko mahattwa dekhaain. raati batti lie birami herna jane bhayeko le unlai "lady with the lamp" bhaninchha.
antarrashtriya nurse diwas kahile ho?
antarrashtriya nurse diwas har barsa may 12 ma manainchha. yo din aadhunik nursing ki sansthapak florence nightingale ko janma din ho.
chikitsa shastra ka pita kaslai bhaninchha?

prachin greece ka hippocrates lai chikitsa shastra ka pita bhaninchha. unle rog lai devta ko sraap haina, prakritik kaaran le hune kura bhanera adhyayan garna sikaaye; doctor le line "hippocratic oath" unkai naam ma chha.
DNA ko sanrachana kasle pattaa lagaye?
1953 ma james watson ra francis crick le rosalind franklin ko X-ray tasbir ko maddat lie DNA ko dohoro ghumauro (double helix) sanrachana pattaa lagaye. DNA ma jiv ko banshanugat jankari hunchha.
bacteria pahilo choti kasle dekhe?
netherlands ka antonie van leeuwenhoek le 1670 ko dashak ma aafai baneko microscope le pahilo choti bacteria ra saana jivaanu dekhe. tyasaile unlai sukshmajiv bigyan ka pita bhaninchha.
lekh lagnu (altitude sickness) bhaneko k ho?

lekh lagnu bhaneko uchai ma hawa ma oxygen kam hune hunda sharir le milan garna nasakera hune samasya ho. dherai jaso 2,500 m bhanda mathi tauko dukhne, wakwaki, bhok nalagne, chakkar lagne ra nidra nalagne hunchha.
trek ma lekh lagna bata kasari bachne?
bistarai uklinus: 3,000 m mathi din ma sutne uchai 300 dekhi 500 m bhanda badhi nabadhaunus, ra har 3-4 din ma ek din aaram garnus. prashasta pani piunus ra raksi nakhanus.
trek ma lekh lageko lakshan dekhiye k garne?
lakshan dekhiye mathi uklina banda garera aaram garnus. lakshan jhan badhe, aaram ma pani sas fulye ya hidda lartharaye turuntai tala jharnus, kinabhane yo jyan line awastha huna sakchha.
HAPE ra HACE bhaneko k ho?
HAPE bhaneko phokso ma pani jamne ra HACE bhaneko dimag ma sujan aaune lekh lagne ka gambhir rup hun. dubai ma jyan jana sakchha, tyasaile turuntai tala jharnu ra upachar garnu nai mukhya upaya ho.
hachhiu (sneeze) kina aauchha?

naak bhitra dhulo, parag ya chiso hawa le jalan garda sharir le jod le hawa falera tyo kura bahira nikalchha, tyasailai hachhiu bhanchhan. hachhiu ka thopa le rog sarna sakchha, tyasaile kuhina le chhopnus.
aankha ma kasingar paryo bhane k garne?
aankha nadalnus, sapha pani le aankha pakhalnus ra pani bhitrai bistarai aankha jhimkaunus. kehi gadeko jasto lagirahe ya aankha rato bhai rahe aankha ko doctor lai dekhaunus.
jaado ma kina jiu kaampchha?
chiso hunda maansapeshi chhito chhito khumchine ra khukulo hune garchhan, jasle taap utpanna garchha. yo sharir lai nyano rakhne prakritik upaya ho.
chiso hunda rau kina thadiinchha?
chiso hunda ya dar lagda rau ko jara ka saana maansapeshi khumchinchhan ra rau thadiinchha. bakhro rau bhayeka janawar ma yasle rau fulayera nyano rakhna maddat garchha.
kaan ma kira pasyo bhane k garne?
kaan ma sinko, cotton bud ya aunla naghusarnus, kinabhane kira jhan bhitra jana sakchha. tauko dhalkayera kira aafai niskina dinus, naniskiye ya kaan dukhe swasthya sanstha jaanus.
bigauti dudh bachcha lai khuwaunu hunchha?

hunchha, bachcha janmepachhi aama ko pahilo gadha pahelo dudh (bigauti) ma rog sanga ladne tatwa prashasta hunchhan. yo dudh falnu hudaina, bachcha lai janmeko ek ghanta bhitrai khuwaunu ramro hunchha.
garbhawati le falam chakki kina khanu parchha?
garbhawati awastha ma sharir lai badhi ragat chahine hunda falam chakki le raktaalpata bata bachauchha. folic acid le bachcha ko dimag ra merudanda ko bikas ma hune khot bata bachauna maddat garchha.
aama surakshya karyakram ma k sewa paainchha?

nepal ma sarkari swasthya sanstha ma sutkeri garaunda sewa nishulka hunchha ra aama le yatayat kharcha bapat protsahan rakam pani paauchhin. yasle ghar ma hune jokhimpurna sutkeri ghataauna maddat gareko chha.
paropakar prasuti griha kaha chha?
paropakar prasuti tatha stri rog aspatal (prasuti griha) kathmandu ko thapathali ma chha. yo nepal ko pramukh sarkari prasuti aspatal ho.
nepal ma bachcha lai samasya pare kun number ma phone garne?
nepal ma bal helpline 1098 ma nishulka phone garna sakinchha. bachcha haraye, kutpit bhaye ya shoshan bhaye yo number ma khabar garna sakinchha.
mahila hinsa bhaye kaha khabar garne?
rashtriya mahila aayog ko helpline 1145 ma phone garna sakinchha. aapatkal ma turuntai prahari ko 100 number ma phone garnus.
nepal ma sarbajanik thau ma chhurot khana painchha?

paidaina, surtijanya padartha (niyantran ra niyaman) ain 2011 anusar sarbajanik thau, sarbajanik yatayat ra karyalaya ma dhumrapan nishedh chha. chhurot ko packet ma thulo chitra sahitko chetawani pani anivarya chha.
arka ko chhurot ko dhuwa le pani haani garchha?
garchha, arka le chhurot khada niskeko dhuwa sas ma lida pani phokso ko cancer, mutu rog ra bachcha ma dam (asthma) ko khatara badhchha. tyasaile ghar bhitra ra bachcha najik chhurot khanu hudaina.
gutkha ra khaini le k haani garchha?
gutkha ra khaini le mukh ko cancer, gija ko rog ra daat ma daag lagauchha. mukh bhitra seto ya rato daag ra niko nahune ghau dekhiye doctor lai dekhaunus.
fohor pani le kun kun rog lagchha?
fohor pani le jhada-pakhala, haija, typhoid, kamalpitta (hepatitis A ra E) ra juka jasta rog lagauchha. pani umalera, chlorine halera ya filter garera matra piunus.
pani kati ber umalnu parchha?
pani lai kamti ma 1 minet samma khadkhad umalnus. 2,000 m bhanda badhi uchai ma pani kam tapkram mai umalne hunda 3 minet umalnu ramro hunchha.
budheskaal ma haddi kina kamjor hunchha?

umer badhda haddi bata calcium ra aru khanij ghatda haddi patalo ra sajilai bhaachine hunchha, yaslai osteoporosis bhaninchha. calcium ra vitamin D bhayeko khana ra niyamit hidai le haddi balio rakhna maddat garchha.
manchhe le minet ma kati choti sas ferchha?
thula manchhe le aaram ma basda prati minet lagbhag 12 dekhi 20 choti sas ferchhan. saano bachcha ko sas ko gati yo bhanda chhito hunchha.
byayam garda man kina khushi hunchha?
byayam garda dimag le endorphin jasta ramro mahasus garaune rasayan chhodchha. tyasaile niyamit hidne ra khelne bani le tanab ra udasi ghataauna maddat garchha.
chiso pani le nuhauda rugha lagchha?
rugha virus le lagchha, chiso le matra lagdaina. tara jaado ma manchhe band kotha ma najik najik basne hunda virus sajilai sarchha.
kaan ma mail kina banchha?
kaan ko mail le dhulo ra kitanu rokchha ra kaan bhitra ko chhala jogaauchha. kaan ma cotton bud ghusarda mail jhan bhitra dhakelinchha, tyasaile tyasto nagarnus.
sutnu agadi mobile kina naherne?
screen ko ujyalo (bishesh gari nilo ujyalo) le nidra lyaune melatonin hormone ghataauna sakchha. sutnu bhanda kamti ma 30 minet agadi screen banda garda nidra ramro lagchha.
nangra tokna kina hudaina?
nangra muni fohor ra kitanu basne hunda nangra tokda tyo kitanu mukh ma pugchhan ra pet ko rog lagna sakchha. nangra lai chhoto ra sapha rakhnus.
hawa pradushan le kun kun rog lagauchha?
lamo samaya pradushit hawa ma sas lida dam, phokso ko rog, mutu rog ra phokso ko cancer ko khatara badhchha. saano bachcha ra budha-budhi lai yasko asar badhi parchha.
halla (noise) pradushan le k asar garchha?
lagatar charko halla le sunne shakti ghataaune, tanab badhaune, nidra bigarne ra BP badhaune samasya lyauchha. 85 decibel bhanda charko awaj lamo samaya sunnu kaan ko lagi haanikarak maninchha.
ayurveda bhaneko k ho?
ayurveda prachin dakshin asia ko upachar paddhati ho, jasma jadibuti, khana ra jiwanshaili bata swasthya rakhne kura garinchha. nepal ma jadibuti dherai paaine hunda ayurveda ko lamo parampara chha.
kasai lai dudh kina pachdaina?

kehi manchhe ko sharir ma dudh ko chini (lactose) pachaune lactase bhanne enzyme kam banchha, tyasaile dudh khada pet fulne, gudgud garne ra pakhala lagne hunchha. dahi ma lactose kam hune hunda kehi le dahi chai pachaauna sakchhan.
tauko ma chot lagepachhi kun lakshan khatarnak hun?

tauko ma chot lagepachhi barambar ulti, bholau hune, behos hune, eutai aankha ko nani thulo hune ya kaan-naak bata ragat ya pani aaune bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus. yasto lakshan kehi ghanta pachhi pani dekhina sakchhan.
haddi bhaachiyo jasto lagyo bhane k garne?
chot lageko bhag nachalaunus, dandi ra kapada le halka bandhera (splint) sthir rakhnus ra aspatal laijaanus. haddi chhala bahira niskeko bhaye ghau lai sapha kapada le chhopnus.
chiya ra coffee le kina nidra bhagaauchha?
chiya ra coffee ma caffeine hunchha, jasle dimag lai sajag banaune ra thakai ko mahasus ghataaune kaam garchha. beluka dherai piye raati nidra lagna garo hunchha.
kasai lai tadha ko kura kina dhamilo dekhinchha?

najik drishti dosh (myopia) ma aankha bhitra prakash retina bhanda agadi kendrit hunchha, tyasaile tadha ko kura dhamilo dekhinchha. ulto, dur drishti dosh ma najik ko kura dhamilo dekhinchha; sahi lens bhayeko chashma le dubai sapha dekhauchha.
ghaam ma dherai basda chhala kina kalo hunchha?
ghaam ko UV kiran bata jogauna chhala le badhi melanin banauchha, tyasaile chhala kalo hunchha. tara dherai ghaam le chhala polne ra chhala ko cancer ko khatara badhauchha.
dam (asthma) ma k hunchha?
dam ma sas nali sunnine ra sangurine hunda sas ferna garo hunchha ra sitti bajeko jasto awaj aauchha. inhaler le aushadhi sidhai phokso samma puryaune hunda chhitai aaram dinchha.
phaplu ma ang dorje le 3 ropani ma kodo lagaye, ropani ko 120 kg phalyo. jamma kati kg kodo bhayo?
ang dorje ko 3 ropani bata jamma 360 kg kodo phalyo.
marpha ma tsering le 8 kg phapar ko pitho pisayo. ek palta roti banauda 750 gram lagchha. kati palta pugchha, kati baki rahanchha?
pitho 10 palta pugchha ra 500 gram baki rahanchha.
messages.think: 8 kg bhaneko 8000 gram. 750 x 10 = 7500, baki 8000 - 7500 = 500 gram. 500 gram le arko palta pugdaina.

messages.content: bidur ma sarita le strawberry ko 45 box bechin, box ko 350 rupiya. box ra plastic ma 2250 kharcha bhayo. naafa kati?
sarita lai 13500 rupiya naafa bhayo.
panauti tira euta tunnel ma 60 ota golbheda ko bot chhan, euta bot le ausat 4 kg phalyo. kg ko 55 rupiya ma bechda kati aamdani?
tunnel ko golbheda bechda 13200 rupiya aamdani hunchha.
messages.think: jamma golbheda: 60 x 4 = 240 kg. aamdani: 240 x 55 = 13200.

messages.content: charikot bata kiwi ko 7 crate kathmandu pathayo. euta crate ma 18 kg aatchha, kg ko 240 rupiya. jamma kati rupiya aauchha?
7 crate kiwi ko 30240 rupiya aauchha.
ramechhap ma lapsi ko rukh bata 96 kg lapsi tipiyo. 1/4 achar banauna rakhiyo, baki bechiyo. kati kg bechiyo?
72 kg lapsi bechiyo.
chitwan ko ek kisan sanga 14 ota mauri ko ghar chhan. euta ghar bata barsha ma 9 kg maha nikalchha, kg ko 900 rupiya. barsha ko kamai?
maha bata barsha ma 113400 rupiya kamai hunchha.
bajura ka lalbahadur sanga 23 ota bakhra chhan. 3 jana chhora lai barabar dinchhan, baki aafai rakhchhan. euta chhora le kati paunchha?
euta chhora le 7 ota bakhra paunchha, ra lalbahadur sanga 2 ota rahanchhan.
hamro ghar ko tank 1500 litre ko chha. 6 jana ko pariwar, euta jana le din ma 50 litre pani khapat garchha. bhari tank kati din chalchha?
bhari tank 5 din chalchha.
messages.think: din ko khapat: 6 x 50 = 300 litre. 1500 / 300 = 5 din.

messages.content: pipe le minet ma 25 litre bharchha. 2000 litre ko khali tank bharna kati samaya lagchha?
tank bharna 80 minet, arthat 1 ghanta 20 minet lagchha.
chhana ko pani jamma garna hamro 200 litre ka drum chhan. ek jhari ma 750 litre jamma bhayo. kati drum pura bharinchha?
3 ota drum pura bharinchhan ra 150 litre chautho drum ma jaanchha.
messages.think: 200 x 3 = 600, baki 750 - 600 = 150 litre. 150 litre le chautho drum pura bhardaina.

messages.content: office ma din ma 3 jar pani lagchha, jar ko 60 rupiya. 26 din kaam hune mahina ma jar ko kharcha kati hunchha
mahina ma pani ko jar ko kharcha 4680 rupiya hunchha.
6000 litre ko pani ko tanker ko 3000 rupiya liyo. 1000 litre ko kati pareko bhayo?
1000 litre ko 500 rupiya pareko bhayo.
jiri bata lukla samma hidda hamro group lai 6 din lagyo, din ma 7 ghanta hidyau. jamma kati ghanta hidiyo?
jamma 42 ghanta hidiyo.
ghorepani bata bihana 4:45 ma niskiyau, poon hill pugna 1 ghanta 10 minet lagyo. kati baje pugyau?
tapai haru bihana 5:55 ma poon hill pugnubhayo.
messages.think: 4:45 ma 1 ghanta thapda 5:45. ani 10 minet thapda 5:55.

messages.content: gongabu bata pokhara jane bus har 40 minet ma chhutchha. pahilo bus 6 baje bhaye chautho bus kati baje?
chautho bus bihana 8 baje chhutchha.
kathmandu bata mahendranagar jane bus beluka 5 baje chhutyo ra 15 ghanta lagyo. kati baje pugyo?
bus bholi palta bihana 8 baje mahendranagar pugyo.
messages.think: beluka 5 baje dekhi raati 12 baje samma 7 ghanta. baki: 15 - 7 = 8 ghanta. raati 12 baje pachhi 8 ghanta bhaneko bihana 8 baje.

messages.content: SEE ko form bharda euta bidyarthi ko 1200 rupiya lagyo. hamro school ka 64 jana le bhare. jamma kati uthyo?
jamma 76800 rupiya uthyo.
school bus ko mahina ko 1800 lagchha. mero 2 jana bachcha chhan, dosro lai 25% chhut. mahina ma kati tirne?
dubai bachcha ko mahina ma 3150 rupiya tirnu parchha.
campus ma bharna shulka 15000 ra mahina ko 3500 rupiya. pahilo 6 mahina ma jamma kati lagchha?
pahilo 6 mahina ma jamma 36000 rupiya lagchha.
chhori ko lagi 2 jor school uniform kine, jor ko 1450, ani 1 jor jutta 1900 ko. 5000 rupiya diye bhane kati firta?
tapai le 200 rupiya firta paunuhunchha.
rojan ko mahina ko fee 4200, scholarship le aadha tirdinchha. barsha bhari ma rojan ko ghar le kati tirnu parchha?
barsha bhari ma rojan ko ghar le 25200 rupiya tirnu parchha.
messages.think: ghar le tirne aadha: 4200 / 2 = 2100. barsha: 2100 x 12 = 25200.

messages.content: mero data pack 1.5 GB chha. youtube ma 1 ghanta video herda 500 MB khanchha. 1 GB lai 1000 MB maanda kati ghanta herna sakchhu?
tapai 3 ghanta video herna saknuhunchha.
din ko data pack 1 GB ko 49 rupiya, mahina ko 30 GB pack 1100 rupiya. 30 din samma din ko pack kinda kati badhi parchha?
din ko pack kinda 370 rupiya badhi parchha, tyasaile mahina ko pack sasto.
malai 6 GB data thiyo, bahini lai 1/3 hotspot bata diye. aba mero kati GB bachyo?
tapai sanga 4 GB data bachyo.
6 jana ko chiya ma 400 ml dudh lagchha. office ma 30 jana chhan, sabai lai chiya banauna kati dudh chahinchha?
30 jana ko chiya ko lagi 2000 ml, arthat 2 litre dudh chahinchha.
bhoj ma 1 jana lai 50 gram dal pugchha. bratabandha ma 160 jana aaune bhaye kati kg dal chahinchha?
160 jana ko lagi 8 kg dal chahinchha.
hile bazaar ko pasal ma 1 plate aloo dum ma 150 gram aalu lagchha. din ma 80 plate bikchha bhane din ko kati kg aalu chahiyo?
din ma 12 kg aalu chahinchha.
1 kg maida bata 90 ota momo banchha, 1 plate ma 10 ota. 45 plate banauna kati kg maida?
45 plate momo ko lagi 5 kg maida chahinchha.
euta yomari ma 40 gram pitho lagchha. yomari punhi ma 60 ota banaune ho bhane pitho kati?
60 ota yomari ko lagi 2400 gram, arthat 2.4 kg pitho chahinchha.
kotha ko dhalan ma 45 bori cement lagchha re, bori ko 780 rupiya. cement ko matra kharcha kati?
cement ko kharcha 35100 rupiya hunchha.
12 mm ko euta rod lagbhag 10.6 kg ko hunchha re. 50 ota rod ko jamma kati kg?
50 ota rod ko lagbhag 530 kg hunchha.
1 litre paint le 100 sq ft bhitta potinchha. kotha ko bhitta 650 sq ft chha, 2 coat lagaune. kati litre chahinchha?
2 coat ko lagi 13 litre paint chahinchha.
chhana ma 3 lahar jasta pata halne, euta lahar ma 14 pata. pata ko 1150 rupiya bhaye jamma kati?
jasta pata ko jamma 48300 rupiya lagchha.

katha lekhidinus: lobhi manchhe ra sun ko anda dine kukhura, nepali gaun ma

daura ko mutha ko katha, ekata ko lagi

dui sathi ra bhalu ko katha lekhdinu

rukh nakaata bhanne sandesh dine katha

sabai kaam ko ijjat garnu parchha bhanne katha

rohit le aafno sathi ko buwa sadak saphaa garne kaam garnuhunchha bhanera hasyo. tyo raat thulo pani paryo ra rohit ko ghar agadi ko nala thunniyo. bihana sabai bhanda pahila aayera nala kholne tyahi sathi ko buwa hunuhunthyo. rohit le maafi magyo. imandar mehenat ko har kaam ijjat ko layak hunchha.
ghamand nagarnu bhanne katha, uchai ko rukh ra ghaas

write a short story in english about a kind girl in a village, with a lesson

In a small village near Gorkha, Maya shared her umbrella with an old woman at the bus stop. The bus was late, and the rain kept falling. When the bus finally came, the conductor said there was only one seat left. The old woman smiled and offered it to Maya because she had kept her dry. Kindness often comes back to us when we least expect it.
english ma story: a boy who saved money for his mother

Bikash wanted a new football, but he saw his mother sewing her torn shawl every night. For five months he saved the coins he got for running errands. On Teej he gave her a warm new shawl instead of buying the ball. His mother cried and hugged him. Love is shown best in what we give up for others.
pashupatinath ko barema chhoto barnan lekhidinus

pashupatinath kathmandu ma bagmati nadi ko kinar ma raheko bhagwan shiva ko prasiddha mandir ho. yo pagoda shaili ko mandir ho ra yasko chhana sunaulo chha. shivaratri ma desh bidesh bata lakhau bhakta yaha aauchhan. mandir ko chheu ma arya ghat chha jaha antim sanskar garinchha.
swayambhunath ko barema 3-4 line

swayambhunath kathmandu ko pashchim tira ek dada ma raheko purano stupa ho. stupa ma chaar tira buddha ka aankha korieka chhan. yaha dherai bandar bhayeko le bideshi haru yaslai "monkey temple" pani bhanchhan. dada bata kathmandu upatyaka ko sundar drishya dekhinchha.
boudhanath stupa ko barnan

boudhanath kathmandu ma raheko nepal kai sabai bhanda thulo stupa madhye ek ho. seto gumbaj mathi buddha ka aankha ra rangi chang prarthana jhanda dekhinchhan. bhakta haru mane ghumaudai stupa ko parikrama garchhan. lhosar ma yaha bisesh bhid ra ramailo hunchha.
janaki mandir ko barnan lekhdinus

janaki mandir janakpur ma raheko sita mata ko mandir ho. seto rang ko yo thulo mandir durbar jasto dekhinchha ra yasma dherai gumbaj chhan. bibaha panchami ma ram ra sita ko bibaha ko utsav dherai dhumdham sanga manainchha. mandir ko chheu ma pokhari ra mithila kala ko ramro jhalak paainchha.
gosaikunda ko barema barnan

gosaikunda rasuwa jilla ko uchai ma raheko pabitra tal ho. janai purnima ma hajarau tirthayatri yaha nuhauna ra puja garna pugchhan. hiundo ma tal ko pani jamera seto dekhinchha. chheu chhau ma aru sana tal pani chhan ra bato bata himal ko sundar drishya dekhinchha.
tilicho tal ko chhoto barnan

tilicho tal manang jilla ma parchha ra yo sansar kai sabai bhanda uchai ma raheka tal madhye ek ho. yasko pani gahiro nilo rang ko chha ra charai tira hiu le dhakeka himal chhan. tal samma pugna lamo ra chiso paidal yatra garnu parchha. dherai paryatak yaha ko shanti ra sundarata herna aauchhan.
phoksundo tal ko barnan, dolpa ko

shey phoksundo tal dolpa jilla ma parchha ra yo nepal ko sabai bhanda gahiro tal ho. yasko pani firoza jasto nilo-hariyo rang ma chamkinchha. tal shey phoksundo rashtriya nikunja bhitra parchha. tal ko chheu ma purano gaun ra gumba pani chhan.
gorkha durbar ko barema barnan

gorkha durbar gorkha bazaar mathi ko dada ma raheko aitihasik durbar ho. yahi bata prithvi narayan shah le nepal ekikaran ko abhiyan suru garnubhayeko thiyo. durbar ma kaath ko sundar kaam ra gorakhnath ko gufa chha. durbar bata manaslu tira ka himal ra gorkha ko bensi dekhinchha.
hiun chituwa ko barema 3 line

hiun chituwa uchcha himali kshetra ma paine durlabh janawar ho. yasko khairo-seto raun ma kala gola thopla hunchhan ra lamo bakhlo puchhar le chiso ma santulan ra nyano dinchha. yo dherai lukera baschha, tyasaile yasko darshan ekdam kam hunchha.
ek singe gainda ko barema chhoto barnan

ek singe gainda nepal ko chitwan, bardiya ra shuklaphanta jasta nikunja ma paainchha. yasko chhala bakhlo ra baktar jasto dekhinchha ra nak mathi euta sing hunchha. gainda ghaas khane janawar ho ra pani ra hilo ma basna man paraunchha. samrakshan le garda nepal ma yasko sankhya badhdai gayeko chha.
gai ko barema nibandha jasto haina, chhoto barnan
gai nepal ko rashtriya janawar ho. yasle dudh dinchha, jasbata dahi, ghiu ra mohi banchha. gai tihar ma gai lai mala lagai puja garinchha. gaun ma gai ko gobar mal ko roop ma kheti ma prayog hunchha.
ullu ko barema 3 line ko barnan

ullu raati sikaar garne chara ho. yasko thula gola aankha le andhyaro ma pani ramrari dekhchha ra yasle aafno taauko dherai tadha samma ghumauna sakchha. ullu le khet ka musa khayera kisan lai pani sahayog garchha.
indra jatra ko barnan lekhidinus

indra jatra kathmandu ko basantapur ra purano bazaar ma manaine thulo jatra ho. yo jatra ma kumari, ganesh ra bhairav ka rath taanchhan. lakhe naach ra bibhinna mukhaute naach le sahar ramailo hunchha. jatra ko suru ma indra ko dhwaja (lingo) uthainchha.
bisket jatra ko barnan

bisket jatra bhaktapur ma naya barsha ko bela manaine prasiddha jatra ho. bhairav ra bhadrakali ka rath lai sahar ka dui bhag ka manchhe le aafno tira taanchhan. aglo lingo uthaune ra dhalaune parampara yo jatra ko mukhya aakarshan ho. jatra herna desh bidesh bata manchhe aauchhan.

maghe sankranti ko barnan

maghe sankranti magh mahina ko pahilo din manaine parba ho. yo din ghiu, chaku, tarul, sakhar khand ra til ko laddu khane chalan chha. dherai manchhe devghat jasta tirtha ma snan garna jaanchhan. tharu samudaya le yo din lai maghi ko roop ma naya barsha manauchhan.
teej ko barnan lekhidinus

panighatta ko barema kavita

pahilo talab ko khushi ko barema kavita

aasha ko barema 4 line ko kavita

mha puja ko barema kavita, newar sathi ko lagi

teej ma didi haru naachne kavita

nagarkot ko suryodaya ko kavita

namche bazaar ko barema kavita

lukla ko udan ko barema ramailo kavita

muktinath ko yatra ko kavita

koshi tappu ko chara haru ko kavita

messages.content: what is a fuse in a house?
A fuse is a small safety part in the wiring. If too much current flows, it melts and cuts the power to protect the wires and appliances.
tell me more, simply

Each wire in a house can safely carry only a certain amount of current. If too many appliances run at once or a wire is damaged, the current rises and the wire can get hot and start a fire. The fuse has a thin wire that melts first and breaks the circuit, so the power stops. Many houses now use MCB switches, which do the same job and can be switched back on.
